		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryBattleBallJumboChallengeController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_battleball'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		deactive_quest = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		owner_interact_scene = 3,
		activity_start = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	self.is_rejected = false

	self.pivot_pos = {
		yeti_start = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jc_yeti_pos')
		end,
		yeti_steak_offset = function()
			return vector(0, 2.2, 0)
		end,
		steak_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jc_s2_stake_pos')
		end
	}

	self.quest_marker = {
		key = 'main_quest',
		add = function(this, control_data)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.key, control_data)
		end,
		remove = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.key)
		end
	}

	self.character = metatable_helper.inherit({
		spec = {
			princess = 'princess',
			companion_boy = 'companion_boy',
			companion_old = 'companion_old',
		}
	}, function(this, key)
		return get_character(this.spec[key])
	end)

	self.field_object = metatable_helper.inherit({
		spec = {
			shower_interact = 's8_shower_interact',
			shower_gimmick = 'shower_gimmick',
			ballpark_inside_exit = 'ballpark_inside_exit',
		}
	}, function(this, key)
		return get_field_object(this.spec[key])
	end)

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
	})

	self.is_in_zone = {
		promote_steak_challenge = false
	}

	self.jumbo_steak_item = {
		data = {},
		item_spec = {
			steak = {
				id = 21621,
				pos = self.pivot_pos.yeti_start(),
				offset = self.pivot_pos.yeti_steak_offset(),
				layer_order = 2,
			},
			dish = {
				id = 21623,
				pos = self.pivot_pos.yeti_start(),
				offset = self.pivot_pos.yeti_steak_offset(),
				layer_order = 1,
			}
		},
		count = 2,
		create = function(this)
			for key, data in pairs(this.item_spec) do
				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = data.pos + data.offset,
					item_id = data.id,
					spr_scale = 1,
					skip_text = true,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					show_on_character = true,
				})

				quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(item, false)
				item:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Top Effects', data.layer_order, 'Under Effects', -1)

				table.insert(this.data, item)
			end
		end,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			if not table_util.is_empty(this.data) then
				for key, item in pairs(this.data) do
					action(key, item)
				end
			end
		end,
		move = function(this, is_async, pos, offset, data)
			if is_async then
				wait_all_lua(
						function()
							quest_drop_item_util.move_async(this.data[1], pos + offset, data)
						end,
						function()
							quest_drop_item_util.move_async(this.data[2], pos + offset, data)
						end
				)
			else
				this:foreach(function(key, item)
					quest_drop_item_util.move(item, pos + offset, data)
				end)
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if not table_util.is_empty(this.data) then
				this:foreach(function(key, item)
					item:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Top Effects', 0, 'Under Effects', -1)
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
				end)
			end

			this.data = nil
		end
	}

	self.main_quest_id = 7002001

	self.portrait_name = {
		battleball_girl = 'summer_rie_myth',
		battleball_pitcher = 'ninja_leader',
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()

	self.jumbo_steak_item:create()

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	--본 퀘스트는 6섹션 이후부터 진행 가능합니다.
	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress < 7 then
		local owner = self.controller.character.owner
		owner.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_oneline_1_0'
		self.current_state = self.states.deactive_quest
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self.jumbo_steak_item:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and not self.is_in_zone.promote_steak_challenge and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_jc_promote_steak_challenge_event_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.promote_steak_challenge = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:promote_steak_challenge_scene()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local owner = self.controller.character.owner

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, owner) then
			self.current_state = self.states.owner_interact_scene

			sp_util.start_scene(self.owner_interact_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.deactive_quest and
			e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress > 6 then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact
		local owner = self.controller.character.owner
		owner.Interactable.Talk = nil
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:promote_steak_challenge_scene()
	local owner = self.controller.character.owner
	local yeti = self.controller.character.yeti

	local speech_count = 0

	--이벤트 시작_동시 연출
	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and speech_count < 3 do
			--고깃집 주인(down, smile, twohand_idle) : 점보 스테이크 빨리 먹기 챌린지!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'down',
					nil,
					nil,
					{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_1' })

			--고깃집 주인과 인터랙트 시, 고깃집 주인 대사 반복 출력 없음
			if self.current_state ~= self.states.before_interact then
				break
			end

			--고깃집 주인(down, smile, twohand_idle) : 성공하면 1년 내내 고기가 공짜!
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_get_drop_gold_01',
				loop = false,
				play_pos = owner.Position,
				type_priority = 'event',
				player_priority = 'player'
			})

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'down',
					nil,
					nil,
					{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_2' })

			if self.current_state ~= self.states.before_interact then
				break
			end

			if speech_count == 0 then
				--이후 고깃집 주인 머리 위에 서브 퀘스트 마커 출력
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(owner)
				character_util.add_lua_listener(self.controller.character.owner, self)
			end

			--2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(2)

			--고깃집 주인 대사 반복 출력
			speech_count = speech_count + 1
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(yeti, active_state_type.visible)

	local wp = {
		yeti.Position + vector(0, 0, -4),
		yeti.Position + vector(3, 0, -4)
	}

	local speed = 4
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(yeti, wp, speed, nil, self, nil, { run = false })

	local offset = self.pivot_pos.yeti_steak_offset()

	do
		local distance = 4
		local duration = distance / speed
		self.jumbo_steak_item:move(true, wp[1], offset, { duration = duration })
	end

	do
		local distance = 3
		local duration = distance / speed
		self.jumbo_steak_item:move(true, wp[2], offset, { duration = duration })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yeti, true)

	scene_util.set_anim(yeti, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local item_move_dur = 1
	local table_pos = self.pivot_pos:steak_pos()

	self.jumbo_steak_item:move(true, table_pos, vector(0, 0.5, -0.5),
			{ duration = item_move_dur,
			  y_move = function(progress)
				  return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 2
			  end })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_food_02',
		loop = false,
		play_pos = table_pos,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'player'
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(yeti)

	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(yeti, self.pivot_pos.yeti_start(), true)
	wp_util.move_async(yeti, wp, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'down' })

	field_object_util.set_active_state(yeti, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:owner_interact_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local battleball_girl = self.controller.character.battleball_girl_myth
	local battleball_pitcher = self.controller.character.battleball_pitcher_myth
	local owner = self.controller.character.owner

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(owner)
	quest_icon_util.remove(owner)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 뺏음
	local is_pitcher_in = get_user_party():Contains(battleball_pitcher)

	if not self.is_rejected then
		--리에가 고깃집 주인과 인터랙트 시
		--리에와 랜디 아래와 같이 우측으로 1초에 걸쳐 정렬
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_girl, owner.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				2, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_pitcher, owner.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
					2, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--리에(left, idle, idle) : 1년 내내 공기를 공짜로 먹을 수 있다고?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, nil,
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_4', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		--리에(left, idle, cross_arm) : 이거 정말이야?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm', nil,
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_5', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		--고깃집 주인(right, idle, nod 2회 후 idle) : 그럼 정말이고 말고,
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_6')

		--고깃집 주인(right, idle, idle)  : 여기 있는 점보 스테이크를 40초 만에 다 먹을 수만 있다면…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_7')

		--고깃집 주인(right, idle, twohand_idle) : 우리 가게의 고기를 1년 내내 마음껏 먹을 수 있다네!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'right',
				'twohand_idle', nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_8')

		if is_pitcher_in then
			--랜디(down, surprise, idle)
			scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'surprise')
			scene_util.set_direction(battleball_pitcher, direction_constants.down, false)
		end

		--리에(down, surprise, idle) : 저게 금방 말한 그 점보 스테이크야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'down',
				nil, 'surprise',
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_9', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battleball_pitcher)
		end

		--플레이어 캐릭터 서브 퀘스트 시작 배치에서 [C]위치로 이동

		--동시 연출
		--리에(down, smile, idle) 아래로 한 칸 이동 후, 리에(right, smile, idle) 자세로 전환
		--랜디 좌측으로 한 칸 이동(left, smile, idle)

		--동시 연출
		--리에(right, smile, idle) 한 칸 이동
		--랜디(down, smile, idle) 자세로 전환 후, 아래로 한 칸 이동

		--동시 연출
		--리에(right, smile, idle) [C] 위치까지 이동
		--랜디(right, smile, idle) [C] 위치 우측 정렬

		--리에(left, smile, idle)
		--랜디(left, smile, idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_girl, self, 'smile')

		if is_pitcher_in then
			scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'smile')
		end

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_girl, {
			battleball_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			battleball_girl.Position + vector(4, 0, -1),
		}, 7, nil, self, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_pitcher, {
				battleball_girl.Position,
				battleball_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
				battleball_girl.Position + vector(5, 0, -1),
			}, 7, nil, self, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'left' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--0.2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		--동시 연출

		--리에(left, greed, sing) : 이, 이게 점보 스테이크!
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			scene_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], self, 'greed')
			scene_util.set_anim(user_party[i], self, { name = 'sing' })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'left', nil, nil, {
			key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_10', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl
		})

		--0.2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
		party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'smile' })

		--리에, 랜디 [C]위치에서 [D]위치로 이동
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_girl, battleball_girl.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
				7, nil, self, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_pitcher, battleball_pitcher.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
					7, nil, self, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'left' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--0.2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		if is_pitcher_in then
			-- 랜디(right, greed, sing)
			scene_util.set_direction(battleball_pitcher, direction_constants.right, false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'greed')
			scene_util.set_anim(battleball_pitcher, self, { name = 'sing' })
		end

		--리에(right, greed, sing) : 보기만 해도 군침이 싹 도는데!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'right',
				'sing', 'greed',
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_11', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			--랜디(right, idle, cross_arm)
			character_util.remove_emotion(battleball_pitcher)
			scene_util.set_anim(battleball_pitcher, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		end

		--리에(right, ilde, cross_arm) : 이걸 다 먹으면, 고기를 공짜로 1년 내내 먹을 수 있다고?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'right',
				'cross_arm', nil,
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_12', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			-- 랜디(right, awesome, hand_loop)
			scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'awesome')
			scene_util.set_anim(battleball_pitcher, self, { name = 'hold_loop' })
		end

		--리에(right, awesome, hand_loop) : 완전 쵸-럭키잖아!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, 'right',
				'hold_loop', 'awesome',
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_13', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battleball_pitcher)
		end

		party_util.set_direction('left')

		--고깃집 주인(down, idle, idle)  : 정해진 시간에 다 먹을 수 있다면 그렇지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_14')

		--고깃집 주인(down, idle, twohand_idle) : 도전해 보겠는가?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'down',
				'twohand_idle', nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_15')
	else
		--퀘스트가 수락되지 않은 상태에서 고깃집 주인과 재 인터랙트 시.
		--고깃집 주인 인터렉트 시 고깃집 주인 1타일 아래에서부터 우측으로 1열로 정렬한 뒤 up, idle, idle 실행.
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_girl, owner.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
				2, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		if is_pitcher_in then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(battleball_pitcher, owner.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
					2, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		--고깃집 주인(down, idle, twohand_idle) : 도전해 보겠는가?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, 'down',
				'twohand_idle', nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s1_15')
	end

	--액티비티 입장 체크

	--선택지 출력
	--(mercy)잘 먹겠습니다!
	choose_util.play_async({

function local_class:enter()
	character_util.add_lua_listener(self.controller.character.owner, self)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		do
			-- 초기 동적 생성 npc 비활성화
			local is_create
			is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()
			self.place_controller:activate_group(self.dynamic_group_name)
			local place_group = self.place_controller:get_group(self.dynamic_group_name)

			local dynamic_npc_count = 3
			for i = 2, dynamic_npc_count do
				local member = place_group:get_dynamic_member('jc_s2_dynamic_' .. i)
				member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end

		do
			-- 접시 세팅
			local stake_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jc_s2_stake_pos')

			self.controller.dish_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = 21623,
				spr_scale = 1,
				pos = stake_pos,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = true,
				skip_text = true,
				is_fly = true,
			})

			-- 스테이크 덩어리 세팅
			self.stake_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = 21621,
				spr_scale = 1,
				pos = stake_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = true,
				skip_text = true,
			})
		end

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			local owner = self.controller.character.owner
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(owner)
			return
		end

		-- 이전 섹션부터 진행한 거라면 바로 액티비티 시작
		start_coroutine(self.activity_routine, self, false)
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_lua_listener(self.controller.character.owner, self)

	self:dispose_items()

	self.place_controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.character.owner) then
		start_coroutine(self.choose_activity_start, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local owner = self.controller.character.owner
	quest_icon_util.remove(owner)

	-- 정렬
	party_util.align_party(owner.Position, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

			-- 티탄 여성9(right, idle, idle) : 그럼 그렇지.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[6], 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_12')

			-- 일반 남성3(up, idle, idle) : 성공 조건이 너무 허무맹랑하지 않아?
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[2], 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_13')

			-- 꼬마 남성6(left, tired, idle) : 역시 이건 사람이 먹을 수 있는 양이 아니었어.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[5])
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_list[5], self, nil, nil,
					{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_14')
		end

		-- 서큘러 페이드 아웃을 1초에 걸쳐 실행 후 액티비티 시작 전 장소로 돌아감.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_party_leader())

		-- 파티원 다시 활성화
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		for i = 6, 7 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_list[i], active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(dynamic_group_npc)
		character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(npc_list)
		character_util.remove_emotion(owner)
		scene_util.set_anim(owner, self, 'twohand_idle')

		-- 일반 여성2(up, idle, bomb_idle) : 저게 도대체 몇 인분이야?
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[1], self, 'bomb_idle')

		-- 일반 남성3(up, idle,idle) : 역시 다 못 먹을 줄 알았어.
		-- 일반 남성4(up, idle, idle) : 고기 크기를 보니 난 도전할 엄두도 안 나.
		scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[3], 'up', false)

		-- 꼬마 여성5(left, tired, idle) : 저걸 혼자서 다 먹을 수 있는 사람을 없을 거야.
		-- 꼬마 남성6(left, tired, seat) : 보기만 해도 배불러.
		scene_util.set_group_emotion({ npc_list[4], npc_list[5] }, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[5], self, 'seat')

		local active_npc_count = 5
		for i = 1, active_npc_count do
			npc_list[i].Interactable.Talk = 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_oneline_2_' .. i
		end

		party_util.align_party(owner.Position, 'down', 1, 'linear')

		self.stake_item:SetPosition(stake_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0), true)
		self:dispose_stake_piece_item()

		for i = 1, #dynamic_group_npc do
			dynamic_group_npc[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[3], 'left', false)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		field_ui_util.show_default_single_ui()
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(owner)
	end

	-- 시간 다 된거라면 게임오버
	if self.is_time_out then
		-- 게임 오버 연출
		fail_activity_scene()
		return
	end

	-- 패턴 전부 실행
	for i = 1, #self.patten_list do
		local patten = self.patten_list[i]

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		patten.qte(self, patten.value)

		-- 시간 다 된거라면 게임오버
		if self.is_time_out then
			-- 게임 오버 연출
			fail_activity_scene()
			return
		end

		-- 성공 연출 세팅
		patten.end_func(self)
	end

	is_game_acting = false

	-- 고깃집 주인(down, surprise, dle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(owner, self, 'surprise')

	-- 예티 점원(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(yeti, 'down', false)

	-- 일반 여성2(up, idle, success)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[1])
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[1], self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false })

	-- 일반 남성3(up, idle, hold_loop)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[2])
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[2], self, 'hold_loop')

	-- 일반 남성4(up, idle, success)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[3])
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[3], self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false })

	-- 꼬마 여성5(left, awesome, hand_loop)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[4])
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_list[4], self, 'awesome')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[4], self, 'hand_loop')

	-- 꼬마 남성6(left, surprise, success)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[5])
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_list[5], self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_list[5], self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false })

	-- 불량 여성8(down, surprise, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dynamic_group_npc[1])
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_group_npc[1], self, 'surprise')

	-- 일반 여성7(down, awesome, success)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dynamic_group_npc[2])
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_group_npc[2], self, 'awesome')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_group_npc[2], self, { name = 'success', sfx_name = false })

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 액티비티 완료 	UI 출력
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 리에(left, awesome, victory_get 1회 유지) : 입에서 살살 녹는데. 맛있게 잘 먹었다!
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(battleball_girl, '[base]weapon1')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'victory_get', keep = true }, { name = 'awesome', keep = true },
			self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_8'))

	-- 일반 여성2(up, idle, idle) : 이건 식사가 아니야. 승리야
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_loop_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_list[1], self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_9')

	-- 일반 남성3(up, idle, idle, cast2) : 한 입, 한 입이 역사였다…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_list[2], self, nil,
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_10')

	-- 꼬마 여성5(left, surprise, cast2) : 스테이크가 사라지는 마법이었어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_list[4], self, nil, { name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s2_11')

	-- 서큘러 페이드 아웃 후 액티비티 시작 전 장소로 돌아감.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 고기 아이템 dispose
	self:dispose_items()

	-- 파티원이 있을 시 (랜디) 옆에 붙도록
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'left', false)
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], battleball_girl.Position + vector(i, 0, 0))
	end

	-- 불량배 사라지고 사나운개 티탄 여성으로 세팅
	self.place_controller:deactivate_group(self.dynamic_group_name)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_list[6], active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc_list[7], active_state_type.enabled)

	-- ui 다시 숨김
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 카메라 살짝위로
	camera_util.set_position(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 0.5), true)

	-- 엔딩 씬
	self:ending_scene()

	-- 서브퀘스트 완료 후
	-- 점보 스테이크 먹기 관련 NPC는 게임을 나갔다 들어오면 사라짐.
	-- 고깃집 주인, 일반 여성2, 일반 남성3, 일반 남성4, 꼬마 여성5, 꼬마 남성6
	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		character_util.spine_remove_attachment(npc_list[i], '[base]weapon1')
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[i])
	end

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	self.controller:complete_quest({ run_fame_alignment = false })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	field_ui_util.show_default_single_ui()
end

-- 액티비티 성공 후 엔딩
function local_class:ending_scene()
	local owner = self.controller.character.owner
	local yeti = self.controller.character.yeti
	local battleball_girl = get_party_leader()

	local npc_list = {
		self.controller.character.npc_1, self.controller.character.npc_2,
		self.controller.character.npc_3, self.controller.character.npc_4,
		self.controller.character.npc_5, self.controller.character.npc_6,
		self.controller.character.npc_7,
	}

	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_list[i])
	end

	local function throw_vip_card(thrower, target)
		local vip_card_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = thrower.Position,
			target = target.Position,
			item_id = 21625,
			spr_scale = 0.5,
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(thrower, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		quest_drop_item_util.consumed(vip_card_item, target)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 고깃집 주인 리에 좌측 두칸 떨어지도록
	character_util.set_position(owner, battleball_girl.Position - vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(owner, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(owner, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(owner, self, 'cast2')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battleball_girl)
	scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_girl, self, 'smile')
	character_util.set_direction(battleball_girl, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, surprise, cast2) : 아, 아니 이 도전에 성공한다고?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, 'cast2', 'surprise',
			'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_1')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, idle) : 성공하는 사람이 나올 거로 생각하지 않았는데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil, 'tired',
			'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_2')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, idle) : 후우… 여기 성공 보상이네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil, 'tired',
			'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_3')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, throw 후 idle)이 리에의 위치에 0.5초에 걸쳐 고기 자유이용권(1년권)shortstory_bb_mall_vip_card를 던져 준다.
	throw_vip_card(owner, battleball_girl)

	-- 리에(left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 으흠. 부족해. 부족해. 부족해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, 'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep', self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_4'))

	-- 리에(left, attack, twohand_idle) : 이걸로는 부족해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, 'twohand_idle',
			'attack', self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_5'))

	-- 리에(left, attack, twohand_idle) : 훈련을 잘하려면 든든해야 한다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, 'twohand_idle',
			'attack', self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_6'))

	-- 리에(left, smile, sing) : 고기 더 주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, 'sing',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_7'))

	-- 리에(left, left, throw 1회 후 idle)가 고깃집 주인 위치에 0.5초에 걸쳐 고기 자유이용권(1년권)shortstory_bb_mall_vip_card를 던져 준다.
	throw_vip_card(battleball_girl, owner)

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, cross_arm) : 어…? 지금 말이오…?
	scene_util.set_anim(owner, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_8')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, cross_arm) : 지금은 고기가 다 떨어졌소…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_9')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, tired, cross_arm) : 좋은 고기는 바로바로 입고 되는 게 아니라오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_10')

	-- 리에(left, tired, cast) : 1년 동안 고기를 마음껏 먹을 수 있는 거 아녔어?
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'tired')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, { name = 'cast', keep = true },
			nil, self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_11'))

	-- 리에(elft, tired, cast) : 자유이용권은 사용 못 하는 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, nil,
			nil, self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_12'))

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, idle, staff_idle) : 지금만 고기가 다 떨어진 거요.
	scene_util.set_anim(battleball_girl, self, 'staff_idle')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, nil,
			nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_13')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, attack, staff_idle) : 다음에 오면 얼마든지 먹게 해 주리다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, nil, 'staff_idle',
			'attack', 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_14')

	-- 리에(right, tired, cast) : 다음? 다음에 언제?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, nil,
			nil, self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_15'))

	-- 리에(right, tired, cast) : 다음에 왔을 때도 고기가 없으면 못 먹어…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, nil,
			nil, self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_16'))

	-- 리에(left, tired, idle) : 고기가 없다는데 어쩔 수 없지 뭐…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(battleball_girl)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self, nil, nil,
			nil, self:get_bb_girl_speech_param('ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_16_1'))

	camera_util.unset_target()

	local move_end_key = 'jc_s2_move_end'

	-- 리에(right, tired, idle), 랜디(right, tired,idle) 가 우측 방향으로 사라짐
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + vector(15, 0, 0), 3,
				nil, self, move_end_key)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 일반 남성3(up, ilde, idle, shout 말풍선) : 저런 놈들 뻔하지, 뭐. 보나 마나 다음에도 없다고 할걸.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_list[2], 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_17')

	-- 꼬마 여성5(left, attack, idle, shout 말풍선) : 거짓말쟁이 어른이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(npc_list[4], self, nil, nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_18')

	-- 일반 여성2(up, idle, idle, shout 말풍선) : 뭐야, 고기 자유이용권이라며. 사기였어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc_list[1], 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_19')

	scene_util.set_emotion(owner, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump(owner, true)

	-- 일반 여성2 : 이런 가게는 너튜브에 박제해야 해.
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_list[1], self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_list[1], 'right', false)

	-- 손에 mall_phone을 들고 있음
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc_list[1], '[base]weapon1', 'mall_phone')
	character_util.set_anim(npc_list[1], { name = 'bow_idle' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_list[1], 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_20')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, scared, cast) : 저, 정말 지금 고기가 입고가 안 된 것뿐이오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(owner, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			nil, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_21')

	-- 고깃집 주인(right, scared, cast) : 다음에 오면 자유롭게 먹을 수 있소!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(owner, 'ss_battleball_sub_jc_s3_22')

	-- 티탄 여성9 : 팜카페 여러분. 이 가게에서 6개월 아이 입장 거부했어요!
	-- 손에 mall_phone을 들고 있음
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_focus_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_list[6], self, 'attack')

function local_class:last_cutting()
	-- 리에(down, attack, twohand_attack4 1회) 타임 스케일 0.5배속
	local battleball_girl = get_party_leader()
	local stake_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jc_s2_stake_pos')
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(battleball_girl, 'twohand_attack4')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_demon_swing_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(battleball_girl, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 1.45)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_sneak_blood_01')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.25)

	if self.is_time_out then
		return
	end

	-- 온전한 점보 스테이크bb_jumbo_steak_intact  shake 0.03 강도로 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	quest_drop_item_util.shake(self.stake_item, 'steak_shake', 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 온전한 점보 스테이크 위에 fx_dead 출력
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(stake_pos + vector(0, 0.25, 0))

	-- 온전한 점보 스테이크bb_jumbo_steak_intact 제거
	self.stake_item:SetPosition(vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 점보 스테이크 조각(임시)banquet 0.5칸 간격으로 겹쳐서 3개 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	for i = 1, #self.stake_piece_item do
		local stake_piece_item = self.stake_piece_item[i]
		local add_pos = vector((0.5 * i) - 1, 0.1 + (i * 0.1), -(i * 0.075))

		stake_piece_item:SetPosition(stake_pos + add_pos, true)
		stake_piece_item:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', i)
	end

	if self.is_time_out then
		return
	end

	-- 0.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

function local_class:qte_swipe(direction)
	local swipe_type
	local event_listener = {}
	local is_stage_end = false

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			swipe_type = 'up'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			swipe_type = 'right'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			swipe_type = 'down'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			swipe_type = 'left'
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		is_stage_end = true

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	qte_play_util.show_swipe(direction, true, vector(250, 0), 0.85, false)

	while swipe_type ~= direction and not is_stage_end and not self.is_time_out do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:qte_tap(count)
	local tap_count = 0
	local event_listener = {}
	local is_stage_end = false

	local cur_stake_piece = self.stake_piece_item[self.cur_stake_index]

	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			tap_count = tap_count + 1

			-- 화면 터치 시, 점보 스테이크 조각이 0.03 강도로 shake
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_eat_02')
			quest_drop_item_util.shake(cur_stake_piece, 'stake_piece', 0.03, 0.3)
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		is_stage_end = true

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	if count == 1 then
		qte_play_util.show_tap(true, vector(0, 0), 0.85, false)
	else
		qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap(true, vector(0, 0), 0.85, false)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while tap_count < count and not is_stage_end and not self.is_time_out do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:set_stake_piece()
	-- 스테이크 조각
	self.stake_piece_item = {}

	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local stake_piece_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			item_id = 21622,
			spr_scale = 1,
			pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
			show_on_character = true,
			skip_text = true,

		})
		table.insert(self.stake_piece_item, stake_piece_item)
	end
end

-- 스테이크 덩어리 접시 dispose
function local_class:dispose_items()
	if self.stake_item == nil then
		return
	end

	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.stake_item)
	self.stake_item = nil

		skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true),

function local_class:play_custom_speech_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_args)
	self:start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)
	-- 스트링 키로 넣은 경우면 skippable로 간주하고 기본 args 구성
	if type_util.is_string(speech_args) then
		speech_args = {
			key = speech_args,
			skip = true,
		}
	end

	if speech_args.portraitname == nil then
		speech_args.portraitname = self.portrait[character]
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, speech_args)

	self:end_action(character, anim_args, emotion_args)
end

function local_class:start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)
	if dir_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(character, dir_args)
	end

	if anim_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_anim(character, version_holder, anim_args)
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, version_holder, emotion_args)
	end
end

function local_class:end_action(character, anim_args, emotion_args)
	local keep_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'keep', false)
	local upper_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'upper', false)

	local keep_emotion = lua_helper.get_value(emotion_args, 'keep', false)

	if anim_args ~= nil and not keep_anim then
		character_util.remove_anim(character, upper_anim)
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil and not keep_emotion then
		character_util.remove_emotion(character)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBattleBallMainSection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBattleBallMain @
		Comment = 준결승전 시작@
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryBattleBallMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_battleball'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		in_game = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- character
	self.character = self.controller.character

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		camera      = function(inner_state, idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_camera_' .. inner_state .. '_' .. idx)
		end,

		ground_home_base      = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_base_4')
		end,

		locker_room_pivot      = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s11_locker_room_pivot_pos')
		end,
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		normal_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bb_battleball_normal_trail')
		end,

		demonpowergirl_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_demonpowergirl_explosion_weak')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})


	self.mini_game_name = 'BattleBallGame'

	-- 환경음
	self.ambi_sfx = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 캐릭터 배치 컨트롤러 로드 및 초기화
	local is_create
	is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_create('Quest/Etc/CharacterPlaceController/CharacterPlaceController')

	start_coroutine(self.opening_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ambi_sfx)
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--미니게임 디스포즈
	mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.mini_game_name)

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	local demon_inspector = self.character.demon_inspector
	local mad_scientist = self.character.mad_scientist
	local battleball_girl_myth = self.character.battleball_girl_myth
	local battleball_pitcher_myth = self.character.battleball_pitcher_myth
	local manager = self.character.purple_sox_manager

	local teatan_hero = self.character.teatan_hero
	local innuit = self.character.innuit
	local knight = self.character.knight
	local desert_slave = self.character.desert_slave
	local tanker = self.character.tanker
	local ghost_buster = self.character.ghost_buster

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	while not self.place_controller.is_already_initialized do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis == false then
		character_util.spine_remove_attachment(manager, '[base]weapon1')
	end

	--카메라 위치 셋팅
	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.camera(1, 1), 0)

	--카메라 3 크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--화면 페이드 인과 함께 루프 재생, 볼륨 0.6, 페이드 인 믹스 디폴트 값
	self.ambi_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_cf_02', loop = true, volume = 0.6, type_priority = 'event' })

	--화면 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--fade in 완료되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--오딜 (down, smile, idle): 드디어 썸머 배틀볼 토너먼트의 준결승!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_1', 'demon_inspector'))

	--오딜 (down, smile, idle): 바로 퍼플 삭스와 쓰리 데몬즈의 경기가 있겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_2', 'demon_inspector'))

	--그레모리 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)

	--오딜 (right, smile, idle): 쓰리 데몬스, 어떠한 팀인가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_3', 'demon_inspector'))

	--그레모리 (left, idle, idle): 투, 투수력이 아주 강한 팀이죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_4', 'mad_scientist'))

	--화면 페이드 아웃과 함께 루프 뮤트, 페이드 아웃 믹스 2초
	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.ambi_sfx, 2)
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.place_controller:activate_group('s10_battleball_ground_scene')

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	local place_group = self.place_controller:get_group('s10_battleball_ground_scene')
	local demon_powergirl = place_group:get_dynamic_member('demon_powergirl')
	local demon_slayer = place_group:get_dynamic_member('demon_slayer')
	local demon_operator = place_group:get_dynamic_member('demon_operator')
	local battle_ball = place_group:get_dynamic_member('battle_ball')

	--카메라는 파이몬 포커스
	camera_util.move_async(demon_powergirl.Position, 0)

	--카메라 4 크기
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	--화면 페이드 인과 함께 환경음 루프 재생, 페이드 인 믹스 2초
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_blizzard_04', state = 'event', mix = 2, volume = 0.6 })

	--0.5초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--그레모리 말풍선(x:0.8, y:0.8): 쓰, 쓰리 데몬스의 선발 투수인 파이몬 선수는 현재까지 무실점을 기록하고 있습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, nil,
			nil, nil, self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_5', 'mad_scientist', vector(0.8, 0.8)))

	--동시 연출
	--파이몬 (down, attack, boong_attack) 출력
	--파이몬 아래 0.5타일에서 bb_battle_ball(down, idle, throw) 상태로 아래로 스트라이크 존 위치로 0.2초에 걸쳐 이동
	--bb_battle_ball에 fx_bb_battleball_normal_trail 추가
	--공 목적지에 도착하면 출력 제거
	--크로셀(down, smile, clap) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_operator, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_operator, self, 'clap')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_operator, self, 'smile')

	character_util.set_position(battle_ball, demon_powergirl.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	scene_util.set_direction(battle_ball, 'down', false)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(battle_ball, 1, 0.1)

	scene_util.set_direction(demon_powergirl, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_powergirl, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'boong_attack', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '02_normal_slash_01' })

	--shortstory_bb_battle_ball (down, idle, throw) 상태로 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(battle_ball, self, 'throw')

	--bb_battle_Ball에 fx_bb_battleball_normal_trail 출력
	local fx_trail = self.fx.normal_trail():Instantiate(battle_ball.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, battle_ball.Transform)

	local battle_ball_end_pos = self.markers.ground_home_base() + vector(0,0,-0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(battle_ball, battle_ball_end_pos, nil, 0.2)
	fx_trail:Dispose()

	--shortstory_bb_battle_ball 맥스 위치에 도착하면 fx_hit 출력되며 사라짐
	field_object_util.set_active_state(battle_ball, active_state_type.disabled)

	--그레모리 말풍선(x:0.8, y:0.8): 퍼, 퍼플 삭스, 과연 파이몬 선수의 공을 받아낼 수 있을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, nil,
			nil, nil, self:get_speech_param('ss_battleball_main_s10_1_6', 'mad_scientist', vector(0.8, 0.8)))

	--크로셀 (right, idle, idle) 출력

function local_class:get_speech_param(key, portraitname, viewport_pos, skip, type_speed, scale)
	return {
		key = key,
		skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true),
		type_speed = type_speed,

		portraitname = portraitname,

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_game and
			e.Name == self.mini_game_name and

			self.controller:progress_section()

	end

		phone = 's11_oneline_event_2',
		demon_queen = 's11_oneline_event_3',
		mermaid = 's11_oneline_event_5',
		trio = 's11_oneline_event_6',
		entrance = 's11_oneline_event_4',
		ballpark = 's11_oneline_event_7'
	}

	self.typing_text = {
		ui = nil,
		load_async = function(this)
			self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

			yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
					self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
						local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
						this.ui = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
					end)
		end,
		set = function(this)
			this.ui.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
			this.ui.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 0)
			this.ui.Label.fontSize = 64
			this.ui.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
			this.ui.Widget:UpdateAnchors()

			--첫 typing_text alpha 값 초기화
			this.ui.Label.alpha = 0
		end,

		play_narration = function(this, text)
			local text_fade_in_duration = 0.5
			local text_fade_out_duration = 0.5
			local text_maintain_duration = 1.5
			local text_exposure_duration = text_fade_in_duration + text_maintain_duration + text_fade_out_duration
			local text_width = 2000
			local text_speed = 0

			--아래 text_out이 들어가고 중간에 text가 사라지게 되어서 start_coroutine_enumerator로 변경 후 대기시간동안 기다려준다.
			wait_all({
				--typing_text setting
				this.ui:SetTypedText(
						text,
						text_width,
						text_speed,
						text_exposure_duration
				),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					--fade in 대기
					this.fade_typing_text_in(this, this.ui, text_fade_in_duration)

					--노출 시간 대기
					wait_for_sec(text_maintain_duration)

					--fade out 대기
					this.fade_typing_text_out(this, this.ui, text_fade_out_duration)
				end)
			})
		end,
		fade_typing_text_in = function(this, typing_text, duration)
			this:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 1, duration)
		end,
		fade_typing_text_out = function(this, typing_text, duration)
			this:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 0, duration)
		end,
		fade_typing_text = function(his, typing_text, target_alpha, duration)
			local start_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha
			local end_alpha = target_alpha

			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_alpha, end_alpha, function(_, cur_value)
				typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_value
			end)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.ui ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.ui.gameObject)
				this.ui = nil
			end
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local is_create
	is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()

	if not is_create then
		is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_create_character_place_controller()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(function()
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

		local shower_interact = self.field_object.shower_interact
		field_object_util.set_active_state(shower_interact, active_state_type.enabled)
		shower_interact.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local ballpark_inside_exit = self.field_object.ballpark_inside_exit
		field_object_util.set_active_state(ballpark_inside_exit, active_state_type.enabled)
		ballpark_inside_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:locker_room_scene()

		self.current_state = self.states.shower_room_enter_scene
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	music_player_util.stop_bgm_manager()

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.typing_text:dispose()
	self:dispose_shower_fx_list()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.block) then
		start_coroutine(self.block_oneline_event, self)

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.phone) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.bus_scene then
			start_coroutine(self.phone_oneline_event, self)
		end

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.demon_queen) then
		start_coroutine(self.demon_queen_oneline_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.mermaid) then
		start_coroutine(self.mermaid_oneline_event, self)

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.trio) then
		start_coroutine(self.trio_oneline_event, self)

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.entrance) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.bus_scene then
			start_coroutine(self.entrance_oneline_event, self)
		end

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_zone_name.ballpark) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.bus_scene then
			start_coroutine(self.ballpark_oneline_event, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.shower_room_enter_scene or
			self.current_state == self.states.shower_room_interact_scene then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's8_locker_room_zone') then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.locker_room_block_scene, self, 's8_locker_room_zone')

			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.shower_room_enter_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's11_shower_room_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.shower_room_interact_scene

		--노란색 존 진입하면 비강제 연출 진행
		--리에: 오늘 좋았다, 랜디!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.controller.character.battleball_girl_myth,
				{ key = 'ss_battleball_main_s11_oneline_scene', skip = false, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.bleacher_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's11_ballpark_inside_scene_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.ballpark_inside_scene

		start_coroutine(function()
			--동시 연출
			--화면 shake 0.1세기로 0.5초간 출력
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
			--오딜 말풍선 (x:0.8, y: 0.8): 담장을 넘어갑니다!!!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.controller.character.demon_inspector,
					'ss_battleball_main_s11_37_1', false,
					{ viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.8), portraitname = 'demon_inspector' })

			--위 연출 완료되면 다음 연출 진행
			--동시 연출
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_03')
			--화면 shake 0.1세기로 3초간 출력
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 3)
			--관중 함성(x:0.7, y:0.7)[shout 1.5배): 와아아아아아아아!!!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.controller.character.battleball_pitcher_myth,
					{ key = 'ss_battleball_main_s11_38', viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.7),
					  skip = false, scale = 1.5, bubble_type = 'shout' })
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local shower_interact = self.field_object.shower_interact
	local ballpark_inside_exit = self.field_object.ballpark_inside_exit
	local battleball_pitcher_myth = self.controller.character.battleball_pitcher_myth
	local ground_inner = self.field_object.ground_inner

	if self.current_state == self.states.shower_room_interact_scene then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, shower_interact) then
			self.current_state = self.states.bus_scene

			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

				self:shower_interact_scene()

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
			end)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.bus_scene then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, ballpark_inside_exit) then
			self.current_state = self.states.bleacher_scene

			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

				self:bleacher_scene()

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
			end)
		end
	elseif not self.is_interact.exit and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, ballpark_inside_exit) then
		if self.current_state >= self.states.bleacher_scene and self.current_state ~= self.states.done then
			self.is_interact.exit = true

			start_coroutine(function()
				--[GIMMICK]exit_inner 인터렉트 시 비강제 연출 진행
				--리에: 랜디를 찾아야 해.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.controller.character.battleball_girl_myth, self, nil,
						nil, nil,
						{ key = 'ss_battleball_main_s11_37', skip = true, portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_girl })

				self.is_interact.exit = false
			end)
		elseif self.current_state == self.states.done then
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

				--[GIMMICK]exit_inner 인터렉트시 0.5초에 걸쳐 서큘러 페이드 아웃 출력
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
				screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

				self:bleacher_scene_2()
			end)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.ballpark_inside_scene then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, battleball_pitcher_myth) then
			self.current_state = self.states.done

			sp_util.start_scene(self.ballpark_inside_scene, self)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.bus_scene or self.current_state == self.states.done then
		if not self.is_door_interact and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('ground_inner')) then
			self.is_door_interact = true

			--랜디 : 우리 자리는 여기가 아니야!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.controller.character.battleball_pitcher_myth,
					{ key = 'ss_battleball_main_s11_23_2', portraitname = self.portrait_name.battleball_pitcher })

			self.is_door_interact = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:locker_room_scene()
	local manager = self.controller.character.purple_sox_manager
	local knight = self.controller.character.knight
	local battleball_girl_myth = self.controller.character.battleball_girl_myth
	local teatan_hero = self.controller.character.teatan_hero
	local ghost_buster = self.controller.character.ghost_buster
	local tanker = self.controller.character.tanker
	local desert_slave = self.controller.character.desert_slave
	local innuit = self.controller.character.innuit
	local battleball_pitcher_myth = self.controller.character.battleball_pitcher_myth
	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.locker_room()

	--카메라 마리안 포커스
	camera_util.set_position(teatan_hero.Position)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(battleball_girl_myth, active_state_type.enabled)
	battleball_girl_myth.Position = pivot_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(battleball_girl_myth, 'left')

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 fade in
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_battleball/audio:bgm_battleball_lobby', state = 'field', mix = 1, volume = 0.6 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마리안 (left, smile, idle): 그 엄청난 메테오 볼을 내가!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	self:play_custom_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_1')

	--마리안 (left, mad, attack 4회 후 idle): 이렇게 쳐서 완벽한 안타를 만들었다 이말이야~
	self:play_custom_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'attack', count = 4 }, 'mad', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_2')

	--마리안 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 공학자의 근력은 운동 선수 몹지 않다고.
	self:play_custom_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_3')

	--소히 (right, attack, cast2): 그깟 안타 하나로 우쭐 대지 말라고!
	self:play_custom_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_4')

	--동시 연출

	--소히 (right, attack, idle) shake 0.03세기로 지속 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'attack')
	character_util.shake(ghost_buster, 0.03, 999)

	--마리안 (left, doyagao, idle): 그래서 잘나신 과학자께서는 오늘 몇 안타를 치셨나.
	self:play_custom_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'left',
			nil, 'doyagao', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_5')

	--소히 (right, attack, release 2회 후 idle): 계산에 살짝 오차가 있었을 뿐이라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(ghost_buster)
	self:play_custom_speech_action(ghost_buster, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_6')

	--마리안 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 아이구~ 그러셨어요?
	self:play_custom_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_7')

	--소히 (right, attack, idle) (angry) 이모티콘 출력과 shake 0.03세기로 1초간 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	character_util.shake(ghost_buster, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(ghost_buster, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'angry')

	--소히 (right, tired, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(ghost_buster, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ghost_buster, self, 'tired')

	--리에 (right, smile, idle): 감독님 오신다!
	self:play_custom_speech_action(battleball_girl_myth, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_battleball_main_s11_1_8')

	local cam_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	--동시 출력
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 마빈, 퍼플 삭스 감독 중간을 포커스

			end,

				--감독(left, idle, walk) 위와 같은 위치로 3의 속도로 이동

				manager.Position = psm_start_pos
