---@class ClevatessReviveController
local local_class = newclass('ClevatessReviveController')

function local_class:init()
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.request_id = 0
	self.current_marker_name = nil

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		summons = 2,
		wait_summons = 3,
		speech = 4,
		wait_speech = 5,
		heal = 6,
		wait_heal = 7,
		disappear = 8,
		force_disappear = 9,
		wait_disappear = 10,
		nowhere = 11,
	}

	self.dog_info = {
		[direction_constants.left] = {
			offset = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0),
			direction = direction_constants.left
		},
		[direction_constants.right] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0.5, 0),
			direction = direction_constants.right
		},
		[direction_constants.up] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0.5, 0),
			--offset = vector(0, 0.5, -0.5),
			--알리시아 위일 때는 마혈 클레바테스 스파인 왼쪽 (right)로 출력
			direction = direction_constants.right
		},
		[direction_constants.down] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0.5, 0),
			--offset = vector(0, 0.5, 0.5),
			--알리시아 아래일 때는 마혈 클레바테스 스파인 오른쪽 (left)로 출력
			direction = direction_constants.right
		},
	}
	self.update_handler = metatable_helper.inherit({
		priority = CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent,
		callback_name = 'update_frame',
		exist = false,
	}, {
		add = function(this, updater)
			if not this.exist then
				this.exist = true
				update_util.add_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end
		end,

		remove = function(this, updater)
			if this.exist then
				this.exist = false
				update_util.remove_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end
		end,
	})

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
	})

	self.cur_state = self.states.none
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:pre_load(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterConvertEvent), 'on_character_convert_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenPlayEnterEvent), 'on_screen_play_enter_event')

	self.dog = get_character('clevatess_dog')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.dog, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	self.summons_anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.dog, 'summons')
	self.disappear_anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.dog, 'disappear')
	self.heal_term_duration = 0.5
	self.max_heal_count = 3

	self.fx:load_async()

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local leader = self.current_leader

	if leader == nil then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, leader) and
			e.HpBefore <= 1 and
			not self.update_handler.exist then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.cur_state = self.states.summons
		self.speech_routine = false
		self.heal_count = 0
		start_coroutine(self.disable_skills, self)

		self.update_handler:add(self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_character_convert_event(e)
	if e.Type == CS.Oak.CharacterConvertType.Player and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_party_leader()) then
		self.current_leader = get_party_leader()
		character_util.set_immortal(self.current_leader, true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_screen_play_enter_event(e)
	--컷신 들어가는 경우, 강제 종료
	if self.cur_state ~= self.states.none then
		self.cur_state = self.states.force_disappear
	end
end

--TODO 보스전과 겹쳤을 때 예외사항 처리 추가 작업 필요!
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--알리시아 전투 중 체력이 1 남았을 경우 아래 비강제 연출 진행
	local dog = self.dog
	local leader = self.current_leader
	local leader_dir = leader.Direction

	--알리시아 바라보는 방향 반대 위치 0.5타일 y축 0.5 위치

	local change_states = function(state, is_time_reset)
		self.cur_state = state

		is_time_reset = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_time_reset, false)
		self.time_passed = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_time_reset, 0, self.time_passed)
	end

	local fix_pos = function()
		local cur_info = self.dog_info[leader_dir]
		local pos = leader.Position + cur_info.offset
		local dir = cur_info.direction
		character_util.set_position(dog, pos, true)
		scene_util.set_direction(dog, dir, false)
	end

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = dog
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = (leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP // 3) + 1
	heal_info.healEffect = CS.Oak.BasicHealEffect.Instance

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

	if self.cur_state == self.states.summons then
		dog.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
		field_object_util.set_active_state(dog, active_state_type.visible)
		fix_pos()

		--마혈 클레바테스 (shortstory_ct_clevatess_dog)(방향, idle, summons)으로 출력
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'walk4legs')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 999)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_08')
		scene_util.set_anim(dog, self, { name = 'summons', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(dog, 1, 0.1)

		stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				leader, 'speed_cap_persistent', 0, false, false)

		change_states(self.states.wait_summons, true)
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.wait_summons then
		fix_pos()

		if self.time_passed > self.summons_anim_duration then
			change_states(self.states.speech)
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.speech then
		fix_pos()
		--위 연출 완료되면 대사 출력
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.speech_routine = true
			--마혈 클레바테스(방향, idle, idle): 마혈이 있으니 걱정말고 싸워라.(ss_clevatess_main_s5_42 스트링 사용)
			scene_util.set_anim(dog, self, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
			scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(dog, 'ss_clevatess_dead', false)
			self.speech_routine = false
		end)
		change_states(self.states.wait_speech)
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.wait_speech then
		fix_pos()

		if not self.speech_routine then
			change_states(self.states.heal)
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.heal then
		--제거 되면 알리시아 체력 전체 회복(이펙트 출력 O)
		if self.heal_count < 1 then
			music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_04', '02_break_wood_02')
			elseif self.heal_count < 2 then
			music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_04', '02_break_wood_02')
			else
			music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_04', '01_impact_12')
		end

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		self.heal_count = self.heal_count + 1
		change_states(self.states.wait_heal, true)
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.wait_heal then
		fix_pos()

		if self.time_passed > self.heal_term_duration then
			if self.heal_count < self.max_heal_count then
				change_states(self.states.heal)
			else
				change_states(self.states.disappear)
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.disappear then
		--마혈 클레바테스(방향, idle, disappear) 출력
		--scene_util.set_anim(dog, self, { name = 'disappear', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_anim(dog, self, { name = 'disappear', loop = false })

		change_states(self.states.wait_disappear, true)
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.wait_disappear then
		if self.time_passed > self.disappear_anim_duration then
			change_states(self.states.nowhere)
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.nowhere then
		--위 애니메이션 완료되면 마혈 클레바테스 제거
		dog.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dog)
		dog.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true

		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)
		character_util.stop_shake(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				leader, 'speed_cap_persistent')

		change_states(self.states.none)

		self.update_handler:remove(self)
		start_coroutine(self.enable_skills, self)
		return
	elseif self.cur_state == self.states.force_disappear then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(dog)
		local force_heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		force_heal_info.sender = dog
		force_heal_info.target = leader
		force_heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		force_heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.publish_heal(force_heal_info)

		change_states(self.states.disappear, true)
	end

	--예외 사항 처리

	--중간 보스, 최종 보스 클리어시 해당 연출은 중단되고, 마혈 클레바테스는  disappear 애니메이션 출력
end

function local_class:disable_skills()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local manual_touch_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	local controls_to_disable = (CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)
	manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(leader, controls_to_disable)

	--local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	--message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.MythSkillButton)
end

function local_class:enable_skills()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local manual_touch_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(leader)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.MythSkillButton)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class NpcPoolingGroupManager
local local_class = newclass('CTNpcPoolingGroupManager')

---@class NpcPoolingGroupBase
local event_group_base = newclass('CTNpcPoolingGroupBase')

---@class NpcPoolingGroup : NpcPoolingGroupBase
---@field super NpcPoolingGroupBase

---@return NpcPoolingGroupBase
local function make_event_group(name)
	return newclass('CTNpcPoolingGroup' .. name, event_group_base)
end

local event_groups = {
	village_field = {
		npc_group_s2 = make_event_group('village_field_npc_group_s2'),
		npc_group_s4 = make_event_group('village_field_npc_group_s4'),
		npc_group_s5 = make_event_group('village_field_npc_group_s5'),
		npc_group_s6 = make_event_group('village_field_npc_group_s6'),
		npc_group_s7 = make_event_group('village_field_npc_group_s7'),
	}
}

local dispose_actions = {
	speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end
}

local get_position = function(data)
	if type_util.is_table(data) then
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data.pivot) + data.offset
	else
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data)
	end
end

function local_class:init()
	---@type table<string, NpcPoolingGroup>
	self.event_groups = {}

	self.main_quest_id = 7002101

	self.cur_zone_name = ''

	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:initialize()
	local _, npc_pooling_system = global_table_util.try_create_npc_pooling_system()

	local init_event_groups = function(pooling_constants)
		for zone_name, group_constants in pairs(pooling_constants) do
			self.event_groups[zone_name] = {}
			local group_data = event_groups[zone_name]

			for group_name, v in pairs(group_constants) do
				local creator = event_group_base

				if group_data ~= nil then
					creator = group_data[group_name] or event_group_base
				end

				local group = creator(npc_pooling_system, v)
				self.event_groups[zone_name][group_name] = group
			end
		end
	end

	local pooling_constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Clevatess/Common/NpcPoolingGroupConstant')
	npc_pooling_system:init_pools(pooling_constants.pools)
	init_event_groups(pooling_constants.groups)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	for key, v in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for _, group in pairs(v) do
			self:deactivate_group(group)
			group:dispose()
		end

		self.event_groups[key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		return false
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.cur_zone_name == zone_name then
		return false
	end

	local is_contain_zone = false

	for key, _ in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		if key == zone_name then
			is_contain_zone = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not is_contain_zone then
		return false
	end

	self.cur_zone_name = zone_name
	self:reset_group()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_quest_condition_changed(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	self:reset_group(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)

	return true
end

function local_class:reset_group(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	if self.is_pause then
		return
	end

	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	local progress = -1
	local cleared = false

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		progress = main_quest.InnerProgress
		cleared = main_quest.IsComplete
	end

	if overriden_progress ~= nil then
		progress = overriden_progress
	end

	if overriden_cleared ~= nil then
		cleared = overriden_cleared
	end

	local groups_to_init = {}
	local groups_to_dispose = {}

	for key, v in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for group_name, group in pairs(v) do
			local is_activated = group.activated
			local is_valid = key == self.cur_zone_name and group:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)

			if not is_activated and is_valid then
				table.insert(groups_to_init, group)
			elseif is_activated and not is_valid then
				table.insert(groups_to_dispose, group)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_dispose) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_init) do
		self:activate_group(group_name)
	end
end

function local_class:activate_group(group)
	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()
end

function local_class:deactivate_group(group)
	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false
end

---@return NpcPoolingGroup
function local_class:get_group(zone_name, group_name)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if key == group_name and group ~= nil and group.activated then
			return group
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_group_callback(zone_name, group_name, callback)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if key == group_name and group ~= nil then
			group:set_callback(callback)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_group_by_zone_name(zone_name)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if group ~= nil and not group.activated then
			self:activate_group(group)
		end
	end
end

local cleared_value = 'clear'

do
	function event_group_base:init(npc_pooling_system, pooling_constants)
		---@type LuaNpcPoolingSystem
		self.npc_pooling_system = npc_pooling_system

		---@type table<string, LuaNpcPoolHandler>
		self.pooled_npc_handlers = {}

		self.activated = false

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.callback = nil

		if pooling_constants ~= nil then
			self.condition_data = pooling_constants.condition
			self.member_infos = pooling_constants.members
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:dispose()
		self.npc_pooling_system = nil
		self.condition_data = nil
		self.member_infos = nil
	end

	function event_group_base:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)
		if self.condition_data == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.condition_data.progress_infos do
			local info = self.condition_data.progress_infos[i]

			if info.from == cleared_value then
				if cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.to == cleared_value then
				if info.from <= progress or cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.from <= progress and progress <= info.to and not cleared then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	---@return LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:get_handler(name)
		return self.pooled_npc_handlers[name]
	end

	function event_group_base:wait_for_sec(duration)
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

		while self.activated and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:enter()
		if self.member_infos ~= nil then
			for npc_name, npc_info in pairs(self.member_infos) do
				local position = get_position(npc_info.position)
				local handler = self.npc_pooling_system:get_npc_handler(npc_info.key, position, npc_info.direction)

				handler:remove_emotion()
				handler:remove_anim()

				if npc_info.skin_name ~= nil then
					handler:change_skin(npc_info.skin_name)
				end

				if npc_info.anim ~= nil then
					handler:set_anim(self, npc_info.anim)
				end

				if npc_info.emotion ~= nil then
					handler:set_emotion(self, npc_info.emotion)
				end

				if npc_info.add_color ~= nil then
					handler:set_add_color(npc_info.add_color)
				end

				if npc_info.set_attachment ~= nil then
					handler:set_attachment(npc_info.set_attachment)
				end

				if npc_info.talk ~= nil then
					if type_util.is_table(npc_info.talk) then
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk.key, npc_info.talk.sfx)
					else
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk)
					end
				end

				if npc_info.shake ~= nil then

				end

				handler:force_update_spines()

				self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = handler
			end

			if self.callback then
				self:callback()
			end
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:exit()
		for npc_name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			handler:dispose()

			self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = nil
		end
	end

	---@param action fun(name:string, handler:LuaNpcPoolHandler, npc:ICharacter)
	function event_group_base:foreach(action)
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		for name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			action(name, handler, handler:get_npc())
		end
	end

	---@param handler LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:show_stoppable_speech_async(handler, key, data)
		local talker = handler:get_npc()

		if talker == nil then
			return
		end

		if data == nil then
			data = {}
		end

		data.key = key

		handler:add_dispose_action('speech', dispose_actions.speech)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, data)

		if self.activated then
			handler:add_dispose_action('speech', nil)
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:set_callback(callback)
		self.callback = callback
	end
end

		--마을 광장 비강제 이벤트 용
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.is_in_town_square_zone_event and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_town_square_zone') then
			self.is_in_town_square_zone_event = true

			start_coroutine(self.town_square_zone_event, self)

			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		end
	end

	function event:town_square_zone_event()
		--비강제 이동 연출
		--빨간색 존에 진입 시 아래 연출 진행
		local object_c = self.object_data.c.target

		local handler_17 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_17')
		local handler_18 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_18')

		local npc_17 = handler_17:get_npc()
		local npc_18 = handler_18:get_npc()

		local carry_object = function(target_a, target_b, object)
			npc_17.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			npc_18.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			handler_17:set_anim(self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
			handler_17:set_anim(self, 'walk')

			handler_18:set_anim(self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
			handler_18:set_anim(self, 'walk')

			wp_util.move(target_a, target_a.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

			character_util.move_to(object, object.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)

			wp_util.move_async(target_b, target_b.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left', locked_dir = 'left' })

			handler_17:set_anim(self, 'push')

			handler_18:set_anim(self, 'push')

			npc_17.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			npc_18.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end

		--동시 연출
		--7번 NPC (right, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속)) 상태로 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 뒷걸음질 이동
		--c 오브젝트 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 이동
		--8번 NPC (left, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속)) 상태로 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 뒷걸음질 이동
		carry_object(npc_17, npc_18, object_c)

		--위 연출 모두 완료되면 0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--동시 연출
		--7번 NPC (right, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속)) 상태로 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 뒷걸음질 이동
		--c 오브젝트 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 이동
		--8번 NPC (left, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속)) 상태로 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 1초에 걸쳐 뒷걸음질 이동
		carry_object(npc_17, npc_18, object_c)

		--위 연출 완료되면 아래와 같이 출력
		--7번 NPC (right, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속))
		scene_util.shake(npc_17, 0.03, 99999, false)

		--8번 NPC (left, attack, push)(shake(0.03, 지속))
		scene_util.shake(npc_18, 0.03, 99999, false)
	end

	function event:exit()
		local handler_17 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_17')
		local handler_18 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_18')

		local npc_17 = handler_17:get_npc()
		local npc_18 = handler_18:get_npc()

		character_util.stop_shake(npc_17)
		character_util.stop_shake(npc_18)

		do
			--upper 초기화
			local handler_17 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_17')
			local handler_18 = self:get_handler('s2_npc_18')

			handler_17:remove_anim(true)
			handler_18:remove_anim(true)
		end

		--오브젝트 안보이는 곳으로 이동
		for _, value in pairs(self.object_data) do
			local target = value.target
			local default_pos = value.default_pos

			target.Position = default_pos
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self.super:exit()
	end
end

	end

	function event:on_interact_event(e)
		local handler_4_1 = self:get_handler('s6_npc_4_1')
		local handler_4_2 = self:get_handler('s6_npc_4_2')

		local npc_4_1 = handler_4_1:get_npc()
		local npc_4_2 = handler_4_2:get_npc()

		if not self.is_interact_hotel and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc_4_2) then

			start_coroutine(self.hotel_zone_event, self)

			return true

				not self.is_in_hotel_zone and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_hotel_zone') then

			start_coroutine(

						scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4_1, self, nil,
								nil, nil, { key = 'ss_clevatess_s6_oneline_4_1', skip = false })

						self.is_in_hotel_zone = false
					end
			)

			return
		end

				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_town_square_zone') then
			self.is_in_town_square_zone_event = true

			return

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.blacksmith_c()) then
		local blacksmith = self.character.blacksmith_c()

		if self.blacksmith_emoticon_token ~= nil then
			emoticon_util.remove_emoticon(self.blacksmith_emoticon_token)
		end

		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			self.blacksmith_emoticon_token = emoticon_util.show(blacksmith, emoticon_type.happy)
		else
			self.blacksmith_emoticon_token = emoticon_util.show(blacksmith, emoticon_type.silence)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil then
		character_util.add_lua_listener(self.character.blacksmith_c(), self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	if self.leaf_fairy_item ~= nil then
		quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.leaf_fairy_item)
		self.leaf_fairy_item = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		self:leaf_active_setting(true)
	end
end

function local_class:leaf_active_setting(is_active)
	if is_active then
		local sister = self.character.leaf_fairy_sister()
		character_util.set_position(sister, vector(-4.5, 0, 83.5))
		character_util.set_direction(sister, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(sister, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, { name = 'smile' })
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(sister, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(sister, 1, 0)
		sister.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_clevatess_ft_post_3'
		sister.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessForestThiefPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = ShortStoryClevatessForestThief @
		Comment = 도둑 요정이 훔친 물건 의뢰@
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryClevatessForestThiefController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		loaded = 2,
		meet_thief = 3,
		re_interact_blacksmith = 4,
		done = 5,
	}

	self.character = self.controller.character

	self.current_state = self.states.none
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.fx:create_all()

	local progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.controller.main_quest_id)
	if progress ~= nil and progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
		self.current_state = self.states.loaded
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.loaded and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.controller.quest_prefix .. 'meet_thief_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.meet_thief

		sp_util.start_scene(self.meet_thief_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	--on_quest_progressed_event 받은 퀘스트는, CurrentProgress는 이미 바뀐 상태인거임!!
	if e.QuestId == self.controller.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 2 then
		self.current_state = self.states.loaded
	end
end

function local_class:meet_thief_scene()

	wait_all_lua(

			function()

				--아르센 이미지 속 ■ 위치에 도착한 시점에 아래 항목 동시에 실행.

				local thief_end_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pivot, -4)

				--아르센 도착지점에서 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파페이드아웃되어 사라진다.

	do

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessLittleGuardianSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryClevatessLittleGuardian @
		Comment = 꼬마 가디언과 꼬마 공주랑 술래잡기 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryClevatessLittleGuardianController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		loaded = 2,
		find_kids = 3,
		in_cave = 4,
		run_around = 5,
		before_minigame = 6,
		after_minigame = 7,
		done = 8
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.main_quest_id = 7002101

	self.tilemap_prefix = 'sub_little_guardian_'

	self.section_name_pre_fix = 'little_guardian_'

	self.star_piece_name = 'sub_little_guardian_star_piece'

	self.kid_guardian_flag = false

	--FIXME
	self.item_id = 21717

	self.get_minigame_marker = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(self.tilemap_prefix .. 'minigame_pos')
	end

	self.get_kid_guardian = function()
		return get_character('kid_guardian')
	end

	self.get_kid_princess = function()
		return get_character('kid_princess')
	end

	self.get_queen = function()
		return get_character('queen')
	end

	self.get_alicia = function()
		return get_party_leader()
	end

	self.get_klen = function()
		return get_character('klen')
	end

	self.get_neruru_luna = function()
		return get_character('neruru_luna')
	end

	self.shortcut_e_interactable = {
		fo = get_field_object('exit_shortcut_e'),
		cached_interactable = nil,
		init_interactable = function(this)
			local exit = this.fo
			this.cached_interactable = exit.Interactable
			exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end,
		reset_interactable = function(this)
			local exit = this.fo
			if this.cached_interactable ~= nil then
				exit.Interactable = this.cached_interactable
				this.cached_interactable = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.late_update_handler = metatable_helper.inherit({
		priority = CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent,
		callback_name = 'late_update_frame',
		exist = false,
	}, {
		add = function(this, updater)
			if not this.exist then
				this.exist = true
				update_util.add_late_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end
		end,

		remove = function(this, updater)
			if this.exist then
				this.exist = false
				update_util.remove_late_update(updater, this.priority, this.callback_name)
			end
		end,
	})
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress.InnerProgress > 5 then
		self.current_state = self.states.loaded

		music_player_util.start_bgm_manager()

		self:npc_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FugitiveStateChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.knight_and_princess_sync = false
	self.late_update_handler:remove(self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.loaded and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tilemap_prefix .. 'out_cave_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.find_kids
		sp_util.start_scene(self.find_kids_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.find_kids and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tilemap_prefix .. 'in_cave_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.in_cave
		self.shortcut_e_interactable:init_interactable()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('shortcut_cave_door', true))
		sp_util.start_scene(self.in_cave_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.in_cave and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tilemap_prefix .. 'minigame_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.before_minigame
		self.shortcut_e_interactable:reset_interactable()
		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_minigame_scene, self, false)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.in_cave and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.shortcut_e_interactable.fo) then

		self.current_state = self.states.before_minigame
		self.shortcut_e_interactable:reset_interactable()
		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_minigame_scene, self, true)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_minigame and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_kid_guardian()) then

		self.current_state = self.states.after_minigame
		sp_util.start_scene(self.after_minigame_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 6 then
		self.current_state = self.states.loaded

		self:npc_setting()
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_fugitive_state_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_minigame and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Character, self.get_kid_guardian()) and
			e.StateType == CS.Oak.FugitiveStateType.Groggy then

		local kid_guardian = self.get_kid_guardian()
		--꼬마 가디언 (현방향, damaged, seat) 상태로 전환
		character_util.set_anim(kid_guardian, { name = 'seat' })
		character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'damaged' })

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:find_kids_scene()
	local kid_knight = self.get_kid_guardian()
	local kid_princess = self.get_kid_princess()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--플레이어 컨트롤 뺏기면서 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 변경
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--유저가 트리거존에 접촉시, 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
	--플레이어 (left, attack, jump 1회) noticed 이모티콘 출력, async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'notice')

	--꼬마 가디언 run 애니 상태 위 동선 따라 7의 속도로 이동.
	do
		local move_offset = vector(0, 0, 3)

		wp_util.move_async(kid_knight,
				kid_knight.Position + move_offset, 7, nil, { run = true })
	end

	--도착 지점에서 꼬마 가디언, 아가 공주 스파인 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파 페이드아웃
	do
		local move_offset = vector(0, 0, 3)
		local duration = 0.5

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_knight, 0, duration)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_princess, 0, duration)

					wait_for_sec(duration)
				end,
				function()
					wp_util.move_async(kid_knight,
							kid_knight.Position + move_offset, 7, nil, { run = true })
				end
		)
	end

	--0.5초간 플레이어 위치로 카메라 포커스 변경
	do
		local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.tilemap_prefix .. 'in_cave_pos')
		local door_name = 'shortcut_cave_door'

		character_util.set_position(kid_knight, pivot + vector(0, 0, -1.5))
		character_util.set_direction(kid_knight, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(kid_knight, 'smile')

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_knight, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_princess, 1, 0)

		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name))
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.
end

function local_class:in_cave_scene()
	local kid_knight = self.get_kid_guardian()
	local kid_princess = self.get_kid_princess()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--플레이어 컨트롤 1초간만 빼앗다가 돌려준다. async 아님

	--진입 전 세팅
	--꼬마 가디언과 아가 공주 알파값 원복
	--door open 상태로 변경, 이후 해당 상태 유지
	--사진 위치대로 스파인 배치
	--꼬마 가디언 (left, smile, hold_loop)
	--아가 공주 (left, smile, seat)
	--플레이어 그리드 진입시,
	--꼬마 가디언 hold와 run 애니 상태 위 동선 따라 7의 속도로 이동.
	do
		local pos = get_field_object('exit_shortcut_e').Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		local move_pos = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(kid_knight, pos, true)

		wp_util.move(kid_knight, move_pos, 7, nil, { run = true, end_callback = function()
			--도착 지점에서 꼬마 가디언, 아가 공주 스파인 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파 페이드아웃
			start_coroutine(function()
				local duration = 0.5
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_knight, 0, duration)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_princess, 0, duration)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				local pivot = self.get_minigame_marker()

				character_util.set_position(kid_knight, pivot + vector(1, 0, 1))
				character_util.set_direction(kid_knight, 'down')

				wait_for_sec(0.1)

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_knight, 1, 0)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(kid_princess, 1, 0)

				self:around_routine()
			end)
		end })
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt)

		return
	end
	local kid_knight = self.get_kid_guardian()
	local kid_princess = self.get_kid_princess()
	kid_princess.Direction = kid_knight.Direction
	character_util.set_position(kid_princess, kid_knight.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0), true)
end

function local_class:around_routine()
	local kid_guardian = self.get_kid_guardian()
	local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.tilemap_prefix .. 'minigame_pos')

	local move_table = {
		pivot + vector(1, 0, -1),
		pivot + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		pivot + vector(-1, 0, 1),
		pivot + vector(1, 0, 1),
	}

	self.kid_guardian_flag = true
	--그리드 진입 전 세팅
	--꼬마 가디언과 아가 공주 알파값 원복
	--꼬마 가디언 (smile, hold 마지막 프레임)
	--5의 속도로 동선 따라 돌고 있다.
	--아가 공주 (smile, seat) 들고 있는 상태
	while self.kid_guardian_flag == true and not self.controller.is_stage_ended do
		for _, vector in pairs(move_table) do
			self:move_async(kid_guardian, vector, 5)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_async(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)
	local end_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_callback')

	if data == nil then
		data = {}
	end

	local move_end = false

	data.end_callback = function()
		if end_callback then
			end_callback()
		end

		move_end = true
	end

	wp_util.move(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)

	while self.kid_guardian_flag and not self.controller.is_stage_ended and not move_end and fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.kid_guardian_flag or self.controller.is_stage_ended then
		character_util.stop(fo)
	end
end

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class ShortStoryClevatessMainController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessMainController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 9,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.attachment_name = {
		gibo = 'ct_gibo',
		broken_gibo = 'ct_broken_gibo_1',
		broken_gibo_2 = 'ct_broken_gibo_2',
		broken_gibo_3 = 'ct_broken_gibo_3'
	}

	-- 스테이지 컨트롤러로 현재 분리 되어있어, 문제가 생김. 스테이지 컨트롤러로 통합하는게 좋을듯.
	self.waypoint_guard = {
		num = 26,
		get_npc = function(idx)
			return get_character('waypoint_guard_' .. idx)
		end,
		activate_assassinate = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.num do
				local npc = this.get_npc(i)

				if npc ~= nil then
					npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.OverrideInteractionMarkerEvent.Create(npc, 'IC_battle_target.psd'))
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil then
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress > 4 then

			--암살 처리
			self.waypoint_guard:activate_assassinate()

			--5섹션 퍼즐 관련 화로 처리
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local result_brazier = get_field_object('s5_result_brazier_' .. i)
				local puzzle_brazier = get_field_object('s5_puzzle_brazier_' .. i)
				if not result_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
					command_util.publish_burn(result_brazier, result_brazier)
					command_util.publish_burn(puzzle_brazier, puzzle_brazier)
				end
			end

		end

		--3섹션 이후 그림자 튜토리얼 도어 완전 개방 처리
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress > 2 then
			local door = get_field_object('s3_tutorial_door')
			field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(door.Position,
					{ crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance })
		end

		--스미스 집 애니메이션 처리
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress > 3 then
			animator_util.play(get_field_object('s4_blacksmith_house'), 'idle')
		else
			animator_util.play(get_field_object('s4_blacksmith_house'), 'off')
		end

		--루나 처리
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_village_pos')
			self:setting_neruru_and_luna(pivot_pos + vector(-4, 0, -1), pivot_pos + vector(-3, 0, -1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setting_neruru_and_luna(neruru_pos, luna_pos)
	local neruru = get_character('neruru')
	local luna = get_character('luna')

	--네루루 (right, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(neruru, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(neruru, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(neruru)
	neruru.Position = neruru_pos

	--인터렉트 시 (heart) 출력
	neruru.Interactable = CS.Oak.EmoticonInteractable.Create(emoticon_type.heart)
	neruru.Interactable.InteractingSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

	--루나 (left, smile, seat)
	scene_util.set_direction(luna, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(luna, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(luna, self, 'seat')
	luna.Position = luna_pos

	--인터렉트 시 (rowdy) 출력
	luna.Interactable = CS.Oak.EmoticonInteractable.Create(emoticon_type.rowdy)
	luna.Interactable.InteractingSfx = '03_dialogue_notice_01'
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

return local_class

function local_class:intro_scene()
	--알리시아 도착 지점 기준
	--vector(114,0,18.5)
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.pivot_pos()

	--a 위치
	local gibo_pos = pivot_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 0)

	--NPC 배치
	--‘알’
	local alicia = self.npc.alicia()
	local klen = self.npc.klen()
	local neruru_luna = self.npc.neruru_luna()

	local camera_end_pos = pivot_pos
	camera_util.set_position(camera_end_pos, true)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(alicia)

	--알리시아 (right, idle, idle)
	local alicia_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pivot_pos, -1)

	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(alicia)
	alicia.Position = alicia_start_pos

	--카메라 선작업
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	--화면 페이드 인과 함께 환경음 루프 재생 시작 // 볼륨 1, 페이드 인 1초
	local amb_forest_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_forest_01', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 fade in되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (right, tired, walk), 3의 속도로 위 동선 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'tired')
	wp_util.move_async(alicia, pivot_pos, 3)

	--도착하면 (right, tired, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(alicia)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--알리시아 (left, attack, idle): 클렌 녀석, 훈련만 한다니까 그걸 안 꺼내주냐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_1_1')

	--알리시아 (right, tired, cross_arm): 언제 폭포 가르기로 훈련할 수 있으려나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true }, 'tired', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_2')

	--알리시아 (right, tired, cross_arm) 상태로 (silence) 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'silence')

	--알리시아 (right, tired, bomb_idle): 하아… 그냥 검 없이 하자.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_3')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (right, sleep_deep, dualsword_idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'dualsword_idle')

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 3.6크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.6, 1)

	--카메라 알리시아 지속 포커스 (알리시아 이동에 맞춰서 이동도 함께 부탁드립니다.)
	camera_util.follow_target(alicia, 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)


	--알리시아 (right, attack, dualsword_idle) 0.2초간 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'dualsword_idle')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--카메라 shake (0.07, 0.2) 출력 (async 아님)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.2)

	--카메라 0.2초에 걸쳐 3.4크기로 줌인 (async 아님)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.4, 0.2)

	--알리시아 (right, attack, dualsword_attack2 마지막에 정지)
	local da_anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(alicia, 'dualsword_attack2')
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'dualsword_attack2', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })

	wait_for_sec(da_anim_duration)

	--아래 동시 연출 2회 진행
	local action_count = 2

	for i = 1, action_count do
		--알리시아 (right, attack, sword_attack_stab)
		scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(alicia)
		scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_02' })

		--알리시아 0.4초에 걸쳐 오른쪽 0.4칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(alicia, alicia.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0), nil, 0.4)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--알리시아 (left, attack, katana_attack 마지막 정지) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(alicia, self, { name = 'katana_attack', loop = false, keep = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	--알리시아 (left, attack, twohand_attack2) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(alicia, self, { name = 'twohand_attack2', loop = false, keep = true })

	--알리시아 (left, attack, sword_shield_attack) 출력
	local ss_anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(alicia, 'sword_shield_attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'sword_shield_attack', loop = false, keep = true, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	wait_for_sec(ss_anim_duration)

	--위 연출 완료되면 다음 진행

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	do
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--알리시아 (left, attack, twohand_attack4) 출력
					scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
					scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, sfx_name = function(_, sfx)
						if sfx.String ~= 'stomp' then
							return
						end

						--카메라 shake(0.07, 0.3) 출력
						camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.3)

						--카메라 3.2, 0.3 크기로 줌인
						camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 0.3)

						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')

						self.fx.shockwave():Instantiate(alicia.Position)
					end })
				end,
				function()
					--위 연출 시작 0.3초 후
					wait_for_sec(0.3)

					--알리시아 0.6초에 걸쳐 왼쪽 0.6칸 이동
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
					wp_util.move_async(alicia, alicia.Position + vector(-0.6, 0, 0), nil, 0.6)
				end
		)

	end
	--1.2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	--알리시아 표정만 (tired)로 변경
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'tired')

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 3.5크기로 줌아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.5, 0.5)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (left, tired,  question 마지막 정지): 다른 검이라도 챙길걸. 느낌이 안 나네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false }, 'tired', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_4')

	--동시 연출
	local shake_sfx
	do
		--화면 shake 와 함께 효과음 루프 재생 시작	01_earthquake_03	볼륨 0.7, 페이드 인 1초
		shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true, volume = 0.7 })

		--카메라 shake(0.05, 1)
		camera_util.shake(0.05, 999)

		--알리시아 (right, surprise, idle) 상태로 normal_jump 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(alicia, true)

		--카메라 0.7초에 걸쳐 4 크기로 줌아웃
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.7)

		--알리시아 (notice) 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(alicia, nil, 'notice')
	end

	--위 연출 완료 후 0.5초 후 다음 연출 진행
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 shake 멈추면 효과음 루프 재생 종료	01_earthquake_03	볼륨 0.7, 페이드 아웃 2초
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(shake_sfx, 2)

	--화면 shake 정지
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--동시 연출 / a 위치 y축 4 위치에 이펙트 출력
	local gibo_spawn_pos = gibo_pos + vector(0, 4, 0)
	local gibo_space_cracked
	do
		--알리시아 (right, surprise, idle) 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'idle')

		--지보 등장 이펙트 : fx_ct_space_cracked_start_loop 출력
		--우측 상단에 베기 이펙트 출력	02_hana_slash_event_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hana_slash_event_01')
		gibo_space_cracked = self.fx.gibo_space_cracked_start_loop():Instantiate(gibo_spawn_pos)

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--틈새 벌어지는 연출에 효과음 재생	02_cast_magic_05
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')

			wait_for_sec(5.5)

			--틈새 닫히는 연출에 효과음 재생	02_fire_slash_03
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')
		end)

		--rotation (y -90), 크기 0.5배
		gibo_space_cracked.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

		--카메라 0.25초에 걸쳐 4크기로 줌 아웃
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, 0.25)

	end

	--3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(3)

	--a위치에서 b 위치까지 지보(ct_gibo)(임시) cwp_bakeneko
	local gibo_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = gibo_spawn_pos,
		item_id = 21685,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		spr_scale = 0.7,
	})

	--y축 3에서 0까지 1초에 걸쳐서 시계 방향으로 720도 회전
	quest_drop_item_util.move(gibo_item, gibo_pos, { duration = 0.5 })
	quest_drop_item_util.rotate(gibo_item, -720, 0.5)

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--알리시아 (right, greed, idle): 저건…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'greed', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_5')

	--알리시아 (right, greed, run)  b 왼쪽으로 0.5타일 간격으로 6의 속도로 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'greed')
	wp_util.move_async(alicia, gibo_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 6, nil, { run = true })

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 4크기로 2초에 걸쳐 줌인 (async 아님)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, 2)
			end,
			function()
				--알리시아 (right, greed, sing): 붉은색의 도신… 분명 지보야!
				--스킵 불가
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
						'sing', 'greed', { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_6', skip = false })

				--알리시아 (right, smile, cross_arm): 내가 소환한 건가?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
						'cross_arm', 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_7')

				--알리시아 (right, tired, cross_arm): 그럴리가, 나에겐 마법 재능이 없는걸.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
						'cross_arm', 'tired', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_8')
			end
	)

	--위 대사 출력되고 카메라 크기 줌인 완료되면 다음 연출 진행
	--알리시아 (right, idle, eat) 지속 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'eat')

	--알리시아 (right, idle, eat): 금이 갔네. 만들다가 실패한 지보이려나?
	--알리시아 (right, idle, eat) 지속 출력
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_9')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--지보 알리시아 방향으로 fly하여 획득 연출 진행
	--스트링 출력
	--금 간 지보.
	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(gibo_item, alicia)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--획득하면 알리시아 (right, smile, bow_idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'bow_idle')

	--손에 지보(ct_gibo) (임시) cwp_bakeneko 착용 상태
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(alicia, '[base]weapon1', self.controller.attachment_name.gibo)

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)


	--알리시아 (right, smile, bow_idle): 그래도 이게 어디야. 지보로 훈련할 수 있다니!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			'bow_idle', 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_10')

	--알리시아 (right, smile, rifle_idle): 들려줘, 지보야. 너는 어떤 힘을 가지고 있니?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'rifle_idle', keep = true }, 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_11')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 출력
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--클렌 말풍선(x: 0.3, y: 0.8): 어이, 알리시아.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, nil,
						nil, nil,
						{ key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_12', viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8) })
			end,
			function()
				--알리시아 (right, surprise, idle)상태에서 normal_jump
				scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'surprise')
				character_util.normal_jump_async(alicia, '01_jump_01')

				--알리시아 normal_jump 완료되면 (left, tired, cast) 출력
				scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'cast')
			end
	)

	--NPC 세팅

	--‘클’ 클렌 (shortstory_ct_klen)
	scene_util.set_direction(klen, 'right', false)
	klen.Position = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), -1)

	--‘넬’ 루나를 안고 있는 네루루 (shortstory_ct_neruru_luna)
	scene_util.set_direction(neruru_luna, 'right', false)
	neruru_luna.Position = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), -1)

	--동시 연출
	local cam_pos = pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--클렌, 네루루(right, idle, walk), 3의 속도로 카메라 그리드 밖에서 위 동선으로 이동
				wp_util.move(klen, pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0.5), 3)
				wp_util.move_async(neruru_luna, pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5), 3)

				--위 동시 연출 완료되면 (right, idle, idle) 출력
				scene_util.set_direction(klen, 'right', false)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(klen)

				scene_util.set_direction(neruru_luna, 'right', false)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neruru_luna)
			end,
			function()
				--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 4의 크기로 줌아웃
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 1.4)

				--카메라 ◆ 지점 1.4초에 걸 포커스 이동
				camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1.4)
			end
	)

	scene_util.set_direction(neruru_luna, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neruru_luna)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--클렌 (right, idle, idle): 루나와 산책 다녀오겠다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_13')

	--알리시아 (left, smile, idle): 그… 그래! 다녀와.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s1_14')

	scene_util.set_anim(klen, self, 'prostrate')

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryClevatessMain @
		Comment = 알리시아와 다시 합류하는 클렌 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryClevatessMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_clevatess'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		talk = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.npc = {
		klen = function()
			return get_character('klen')
		end,
		alicia = function()
			return get_character('alicia')
		end,
		neruru_luna = function()
			return get_character('neruru_luna')
		end,
		neruru = function()
			return get_character('neruru')
		end,
		trio_boss = function()
			return get_character('trio_boss')
		end,
		trio_man = function()
			return get_character('trio_man')
		end,
		trio_panda = function()
			return get_character('trio_panda')
		end,
		mayor = function()
			return get_character('mayor')
		end,
		s2_villager = function(idx)
			return get_character('s2_villager_' .. idx)
		end,
	}
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		gibo_piece_moving = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_ct_gibo_piece_moving')
		end,
		heal = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a')
		end

	})

	self.marker = {
		panda_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_panda_pos')
		end,
		mayor_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_mayor_pos')
		end,
		end_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_end_pos')
		end,
		nowhere = function()
			return vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	}

	self.object = {
		-- 1 -> a, 2 -> b, 3 -> c
		exit_interactable = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('exit_village_' .. string.char(idx + 96))
		end,

		inn_exit_interactable = function()
			return get_field_object('inn_exit')
		end,

		barricate_box = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('s2_barricate_box_' .. idx)
		end,
	}

	self.barricate_box_num = 4

	self.already_seen_trio_panda = false

	self.s2_exit_interactable = {
		exit_num = 3,
		exit_list = {},
		init_exit = function(this)
			for idx = 1, this.exit_num do
				local info = {}
				local exit = self.object.exit_interactable(idx)
				info.object = exit
				info.cashed_interactable = exit.Interactable
				exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				table.insert(this.exit_list, info)
			end

			-- 여관 입장 상호작용 기믹
			local info = {}
			local inn_exit = self.object.inn_exit_interactable()
			info.object = inn_exit
			info.cashed_interactable = inn_exit.Interactable
			inn_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			table.insert(this.exit_list, info)
		end,
		reset_exit = function(this)
			for idx = 1, #this.exit_list do
				local info = this.exit_list[idx]
				info.object.Interactable = info.cashed_interactable
			end
		end,
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:setting_npc_on_start()
	self.s2_exit_interactable:init_exit()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'village_field', target = self.npc.alicia() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.s2_exit_interactable:reset_exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_oneline_zone') and
			not self.already_seen_trio_panda then
		self.already_seen_trio_panda = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			self:trio_panda_scene()
			self:setting_npc_after_trio_panda_scene()
		end)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.alicia()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
			self:create_dynamic_smith_npc()

			character_util.hide_weapon(self.npc.alicia(), true)

			self:mayor_scene()

			character_util.hide_weapon(self.npc.alicia(), false)

			self:dispose_dynamic_smith_npc()
			self:unsetting_npc_after_trio_panda_scene()
		end)

		return true
	else
		for i = 1, #self.s2_exit_interactable.exit_list do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s2_exit_interactable.exit_list[i].object) then
				start_coroutine(self.exit_block_scene, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:exit_block_scene()
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(get_party_leader(), 'ss_clevatess_main_s2_exit_block', false)
end

function local_class:setting_npc_on_start()

	local s2_villager_2 = self.npc.s2_villager(2)

	local mayor_pos = self.marker.mayor_pos()

	--‘팬’ (레드 팬더)(shortstory_ct_trio_panda)(down, idle, idle)
	--비강제 이벤트 후 원라인 배치
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_panda, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trio_panda)

	scene_util.set_direction(trio_boss, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trio_boss)
	trio_boss.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	trio_boss.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_clevatess_main_s2_oneline_1'
	trio_boss.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-4, 0, 2)

	--‘대’ (대니)(shortstory_ct_trio_man)(right, tired, idle)
	--대사: 대니 배고프다….
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_man, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_man, self, 'tired')
	trio_man.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	trio_man.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_clevatess_main_s2_oneline_2'
	trio_man.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01'
	trio_man.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-5, 0, 2)

	--1번 NPC(shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a)(right, idle, idle)
	--비강제 이벤트 후 원라인 배치
	scene_util.set_direction(s2_villager_1, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(s2_villager_1)
	s2_villager_1.Position = pivot_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)

	--2번 NPC(shortstory_ct_blacksmith_c)(up, idle)

	scene_util.set_direction(s2_villager_2, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(s2_villager_2)

	--알리시아(left, tired, prostrate)
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, 'prostrate')
	alicia.Position = mayor_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(alicia)
	character_util.add_listener(alicia, self)

	for i = 1, self.barricate_box_num do
		local box = self.object.barricate_box(i)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(box, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:trio_panda_scene()
	local trio_panda = self.npc.trio_panda()
	local s2_villager_1 = self.npc.s2_villager(1)
	local s2_villager_2 = self.npc.s2_villager(2)

	--레드 팬더 (right, idle, idle): 예전에 대장장이에게 일을 받은 적이 있었지.

			nil, nil, { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s2_1', skip = false })

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s3_puzzle_door_03', false))
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		--1번 위치 - 노란색 위치 지보 조각 아이템 스프라이트
		{ zone = 'forest_field', target = self.marker.gibo_pos() },
		--2번 위치 - 노란색 위치 지보 조각 아이템 스프라이트
		{ zone = 'forest_b_field', target = self.marker.gibo_pos() },
		--3번 위치 - 초록색 위치 exit 기믹
		--4번 위치 - 초록색 위치 exit 기믹
		{ zone = 'village_field', target = self.object.exit_village_a() },
		--5번 위치 - 진입 불가
		--6번 위치 - 노란색 위치 지보 조각 아이템 스프라이트
		{ zone = 'forest_short_out_field', target = self.marker.gibo_pos() },
		--7번 위치 - 진입 불가
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))

	self:dispose_dynamic_observer_npc()

	local tutorial_door = self.object.tutorial_door()

	--퀘스트 조건에 따라, 타일맵 상에서 오픈 되도록 했기 때문에, 싱크를 맞춤
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(tutorial_door.Name, false))

	--3섹션 이후 그림자 튜토리얼 도어 완전 개방 처리
	field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(tutorial_door.Position,
			{ crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance })
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.shadow_tutorial_before and
			e.DoorHandleName == 's3_tutorial_door' then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.observer_tutorial_before
			self:shadow_tutorial_scene()
			self:create_dynamic_observer_npc()
		end)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.observer_tutorial_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_observer_zone') then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.first_gibo_before
			self:create_dynamic_observer_npc()
			self:observer_tutorial_scene()
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.first_gibo_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_gibo_zone') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self.current_state = self.states.gibo
			self:create_gibo_item()
			self:create_dynamic_rope_npc()
			self:first_gibo_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	for i = 1, #self.seen_hint do
		if not self.seen_hint[i] and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_hint_zone_' .. i) then
			self.seen_hint[i] = true

			start_coroutine(function()
				self:hint_scene(i)
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:shadow_tutorial_scene()
	local klen = self.npc.klen()
	local alicia = self.npc.alicia()

	local pivot_pos = self.marker.tutorial_pos()

	local switch = get_field_object('s3_tutorial_switch_2')

	--그림자 생성 기믹은 비활성화 상태

	--위의 파란색 스위치 동시에 켜지면 강제 연출 진행

	--도어는 기믹 세팅을 통해 open 된 상태
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--알리시아, 클렌(walk) 로 위와 같이 0.5초에 걸쳐 정렬
	wp_util.move(alicia, pivot_pos, nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(klen, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(alicia))

	--도착하면 알리시아 (left, idle, idle) / 클렌 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(alicia)

	scene_util.set_direction(klen, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(klen)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (left, smile, idle): 열렸다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_1')

	--알리시아, 클렌 (walk) 상태로 위로 이동
	wp_util.move(alicia, pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(klen, pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 1), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'up' })

	--위 연출 중 스위치를 통해 도어가 딛히면 강제 연출 진행

	--클렌 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(klen, 'left', false)

	--알리시아 (left, attack, idle) normal_jump 1회 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(alicia, '01_jump_01')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (right, tired, bomb_idle): 장치를 누르고 있어야 열리나 봐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_3')

	--클렌 (left, idle, idle): 내가 누르고 있을 테니 조각을 찾아와라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'left',
			'idle', nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_4')

	--클렌 (left, idle, idle): 혼자서도 충분할 텐데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_5')

	--알리시아 (right, tired, idle)(silence) 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'silence')

	--알리시아 (right, tired, idle): 둘이 찾으면 더 빨리 찾을 수 있지 않을까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_6')

	--클렌 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 정말 귀찮게 하는군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_7')

	--클렌 (right, idle, idle): 저기 햇빛 쪽으로 가라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_8')

	--클렌 (left, idle, idle): 그림자를 만들어 주지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_9')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--이후 컨트롤 해제

	--그림자 생성 기믹은 활성화로 전환
	self.shadow_manager = get_stage_event_controller('ClevatessShadowCloneController')
	self.shadow_manager:progress_gimmick_level()
end

function local_class:create_dynamic_observer_npc()
	if self.dynamic_observer_npc_list ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.dynamic_observer_npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		s3_dynamic_observer_1 = 'shortstory_ct_observer',
		s3_dynamic_observer_2 = 'shortstory_ct_observer',
		s3_dynamic_npc_3 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a',
		s3_dynamic_npc_4 = 'shortstory_ct_mercenary_male',
	})
	local observer_pos = self.marker.observer_pos(1)

	--NPC 세팅

	--1번 NPC (shortstory_ct_observer)(left, idle, idle)
	local observer_1 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_observer_1
	scene_util.set_direction(observer_1, 'left', false)
	observer_1.Position = observer_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5)

	--2번 MPC (shortstory_ct_observer)(left, idle, idle)
	local observer_2 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_observer_2
	scene_util.set_direction(observer_2, 'left', false)
	observer_2.Position = observer_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5)

	--3번 NPC (shortstory_ct_blacksmith_b)(right, scared, idle)
	local npc_3 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_npc_3
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_3, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_3, self, 'scared')
	npc_3.Position = observer_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0.5)

	--4번 NPC (shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a)(right, attack, idle)
	local npc_4 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_npc_4
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, 'twohand_idle')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc_4, '[base]weapon1', 'basic_twohandsword')

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.wp_guard(1), active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.wp_guard(2), active_state_type.disabled)

function local_class:dispose_dynamic_observer_npc()
	if self.dynamic_observer_npc_list ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_observer_npc_list)
		self.dynamic_observer_npc_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:observer_tutorial_scene()
	local observer_1 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_observer_1
	local observer_2 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_observer_2
	local npc_3 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_npc_3
	local npc_4 = self.dynamic_observer_npc_list.s3_dynamic_npc_4
	local klen = self.npc.klen()
	local alicia = self.npc.alicia()

	--감시자 쪽 카메라 기준
	local observer_pos = self.marker.observer_pos(1)

	--클렌 일행 카메라 기준
	local klen_pos = self.marker.observer_pos(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--빨간 존에 진입 시 강제 연출 진행
	--현재 상태 그대로 클렌 대사 출력: 누군가 있다.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(klen, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_9_1')

	--위 연출 끝나면 다음으로 진행
	wp_util.move(alicia, klen_pos + vector(2, 0, 2),
			4, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })
	wp_util.move(klen, klen_pos + vector(1, 0, 2),
			4, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	--1초에 걸쳐 ◆ 위치에 카메라 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move_async(observer_pos, 1)

	--완료되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 연출
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--3번 NPC (shake(0.03, 1))
				character_util.shake(npc_3, 0.03, 1)

				--3번 NPC (right, scared, walk) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 왼쪽 0.5칸 이동
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(npc_3, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc_3, self, 'scared')
				wp_util.move_async(npc_3, npc_3.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
						nil, 1, { locked_dir = 'right' })
			end,
			function()
				--3번 NPC 대사 출력: 요즘 숲에 나타난다는 괴물인가?
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(npc_3, 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_10')
			end
	)

	--4번 NPC (right, attack, idle): 그런 것 같네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_11')

	--카메라 shake(0.08, 0.5) 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.5)

	--4번 NPC (right, attack, handgun_idle): 단숨에 없애 주지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, 'right',
			'handgun_idle', 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_13')

	--4번 NPC (right, attack, twohand_attack 시작) 상태로 1.1초에 걸쳐 y축 0에서 최대 3의 높이까지 오른쪽 2.5타일 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })
	self.fx.slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(npc_4.Position)

	character_util.jump(npc_4, 3, 1.1)
	wp_util.move_async(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), nil, 1.1)
	--동시 연출

	--4번 NPC y축 0에 도착하면 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 출력
	do
		local fx_slash = self.fx.sword_slash_simple():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(npc_4.Position, 2))
		fx_slash.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 180)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_slash_02')

		--2번 NPC 왼쪽 0.5 타일 위치에 FX_hit_sword 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hero_shield_01')
		self.fx.hit_sword():Instantiate(observer_2.Position + vector(-0.5, 0.3, 0))

		--2번 NPC red pulse 출력
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(observer_2)

		--화면 shake (0.08, 0.5) 출력
		camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.5)
	end

	--위 연출 시작 1초후 다음 진행
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--4번 NPC (right, scared, twohand_attack 정지상태)(shake(0.03, 1)): 뭐… 뭐야, 끄떡없잖아!
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s3_13_2', skip = true })

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 2.5초에 걸쳐 3.6크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, 2.5)
	--4번 NPC (right, scared, twohand_attack 5회 출력)(mixduration 0.5초)
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc_4, 1)
	--4번 NPC (twohand_attack) 시작 0.1초 마다 FX_SwordSlash_simple, FX_hit_sword 출력
	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_4)
		--다섯 번째 twohand_attack은 마지막에 정지
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', loop = false, sfx_name = function()
			local fx_slash = self.fx.sword_slash_simple():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(npc_4.Position, 2))
			fx_slash.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 180)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(observer_2)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_slash_02')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hero_shield_01')
		end })

		wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(npc_4, 'twohand_attack') - 0.1)
	end

	--4번 NPC (right, sacred, twohand_attack 마지막에 정지) 상태에서 shake(0.03, 1) 출력
	character_util.shake(npc_4, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--위 연출 모두 완료되면 다음 연출 진행
	--basic_twohandsword_unique(임시) 착용
	--4번 NPC (sword_walk 상태로 뒤로 1타일 1의 속도로 이동): 제…젠장!
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, 'twohand_walk')
