	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초 후 다음 연출 진행
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 연출
	do
		--알리시아 y축 32 위치로 3초에 걸쳐 서서히 느리게 이동
		local move_func = function(target, end_pos, duration)
			local start_pos = target.Position
			local time_passed = 0

			while duration > time_passed do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
				local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, true)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			target.Position = end_pos
		end

		move_func(alicia, vector_util.get_x0z(alicia.Position, 30), 3)
	end

	--fx_ct_screen_diving_start_loop 출력

	local fx_screen_diving_loop = self.fx.screen_diving_start_loop():Instantiate(stage_camera.LookAtPosition,
			stage_camera.Transform.rotation, stage_camera.transform)

	--알리시아 현재 위치에 2초에 걸쳐 y축 30.2 ~ 29.8 까지 왕복 이동(async 아님)
	local sign_loop = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		local dist = 0.1
		local y_pivot = alicia.Position.y
		local time_passed = 0

		while sign_loop do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * time_passed) * dist

			character_util.set_position(alicia, vector_util.get_x0z(alicia.Position, y_pivot + cur_y), true)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--물통 이동 연출 아래 순서대로 진행 (async 아님)
	--세팅
	--물통 1 오브젝트 (임시) wall_out_box3 (151, 21, 3) 위치 출력
	--로테이션 값(7, -16.5, 36) 출력
	local box_1 = self.fo.box(1)
	local box_1_pos = vector(151, 21, 3)
	box_1.Position = box_1_pos
	box_1.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(7, -16.5, 36))

	--물통 2 오브젝트 (임시) wal_out_box3  (143, 21, 3) 위치 출력
	local box_2 = self.fo.box(2)
	local box_2_pos = vector(143, 21, 3)
	box_2.Position = box_2_pos
	box_2.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-2.5, 0, -15))

	--물통 3 오브젝트 (임시) wal_out_box3  (146, 21, 3) 위치 출력
	--스케일 0.5배
	local box_3 = self.fo.box(3)
	local box_3_pos = vector(146, 21, 3)
	box_3.Position = box_3_pos
	box_3.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	box_2.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-9, -13, -17.5))

	--물통 4 오브젝트 (임시) wal_out_box3  (149, 21, 3) 위치 출력
	--로테이션 값(-2.5, 0, -8) 출력
	--스케일 0.7배
	local box_4 = self.fo.box(4)
	local box_4_pos = vector(149, 21, 3)
	box_4.Position = box_4_pos
	box_4.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(25, -1, 30))
	box_4.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	local box_move = function(fo, end_pos, duration)
		local start_pos = fo.Position
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local cur_pos = progress * end_pos + (1 - progress) * start_pos
			fo.Position = cur_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		fo.Position = end_pos
	end

	local water_box_duration = 2.5
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--물통 1 오브젝트 2.5초에 걸쳐 y축 40 위치로 이동
				box_move(box_1, vector_util.get_x0z(box_1_pos, 40), water_box_duration)
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작 2초 후 물통 2 오브젝트 y축 40 위치로 이동
				wait_for_sec(2)

				box_move(box_2, vector_util.get_x0z(box_2_pos, 40), water_box_duration)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(2.5)

				--알리시아 (right, idle, prostrate)(생각 말풍선) : 엘베의 수직 갱도 때랑 상황이 비슷하네.
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(alicia,
						{ key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_30', skip = false, bubble_type = 'thought', force_sfx = true })
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작되면 3.5초 후 물통 3 오브젝트 2.5초에 걸쳐 y축 40 위치로 이동
				wait_for_sec(3.5)

				box_move(box_3, vector_util.get_x0z(box_3_pos, 40), water_box_duration)
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작 4.5초 후 물통 4 오브젝트 2.5초에 걸쳐 y축 40 위치로 이동
				wait_for_sec(4.5)

				box_move(box_4, vector_util.get_x0z(box_4_pos, 40), water_box_duration)
			end,
			function()
				--
				wait_for_sec(5.5)

				--알리시아 (right, idle, prostrate)(생각 말풍선)[스킵 불가]: 생각보다 깊은데 금방 찾을 수 있을까….
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(alicia,
						{ key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_31', skip = false, bubble_type = 'thought', force_sfx = true })

				sign_loop = false
			end
	)

	--카메라 알리시아 포커스로 이동

	--알리시아 대사 출력 완료되고 이동 완료되면 다음 연출 진행

	--동시진행
	do
		local river_bed_pos = vector(147, 1, 3)
		local duration = 8
		local move_key = 'alicia_move'

		--알리시아 (right, attack, prostrate) 상태로 아래로  8.8초에 걸쳐 이동
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(alicia, river_bed_pos, nil, duration * 1.1, self, move_key, { y_mode = 'flying' })

		--카메라 알리시아 포커스로 이동 y축 0의 위치로 8초에 걸쳐 서서히 느리게 이동
		local start_cam_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
		local end_cam_pos = river_bed_pos

		local start_alicia_pos = alicia.Position
		local end_alicia_pos = river_bed_pos
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--카메라 위치 조정
			local cam_progress = interpolations_constants.ease_out_sine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
			local cur_cam_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_cam_pos, end_cam_pos, cam_progress)
			camera_util.set_position(cur_cam_pos)

			local shadow_progress = time_passed / duration
			alicia.SpineController.ShadowScale = shadow_progress

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		alicia.SpineController.ShadowScale = 1

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--알리시아 y축 1의 위치에 도달하면 다음 연출 진행
	-- (right, idle, walk4legs 정지) 상태
	scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, scale = 999 })

	--시계 방향으로 270도로 0.5초에 걸쳐 회전
	character_util.spine_rotate(alicia, 270, 3)

	--fx_ct_screen_diving_loop_end 출력
	self.fx.screen_diving_loop_end():Instantiate(
			stage_camera.LookAtPosition, stage_camera.Transform.rotation, stage_camera.transform)

	--y축 0까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동
	camera_util.follow_target(alicia, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(alicia, vector(147, 0, 3), 0.5, nil)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	fx_underwater_shine:Dispose()

	fx_screen_diving_loop:Dispose()

	--y축 0에 도달하면 알리시아 위치에 fx_ct_sand_smoke (0.2배) 출력
	local fx_smoke = self.fx.sand_smoke():Instantiate(alicia.Position)
	fx_smoke.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2

	local box_list = {
		box_1, box_2, box_3, box_4,
	}

	local particle_systems = self.fx_diving_bubble_loop_effect:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))

	for i = 0, particle_systems.Length - 1 do
		local effect_particle_system = particle_systems[i]
		local main = effect_particle_system.main
		main.loop = false
	end

	--물통 오브젝트 1, 2, 3, 4 출력 제거
	for i = 1, #box_list do
		local box = box_list[i]
		field_object_util.set_active_state(box, active_state_type.disabled)
		box.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	--1초 대기
	character_util.spine_rotate(alicia, 0, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--알리시아 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(alicia)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (up, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'up')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (down, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'down')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--알리시아 (right, damaged, idle)(shake(0.03, 1) 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.shake(alicia, 0.03, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--알리시아 (right, attack, idle)(생각 말풍선): 숨이 차오르기 시작한다…. 서두르자.
	character_util.set_direction(alicia, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(alicia, self, 'attack')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(alicia,
			{ key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_32', skip = true, bubble_type = 'thought' })

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'river_field', target = self.markers.gibo_pos() + vector(0, 1, 0) },
	})

	for i = 0, particle_systems.Length - 1 do
		local effect_particle_system = particle_systems[i]
		local main = effect_particle_system.main
		main.loop = true
	end

	self.fx_diving_bubble_loop_effect:Dispose()
	self.fx_diving_bubble_loop_effect = nil

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(alicia)
	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	--물 속 컨트롤 세팅
	--이동 속도
	--걷는 속도 2
	--달리는 속도 4
	buff_manager:AddBuff(alicia, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			alicia, 'speed_cap_persistent', 0, false, false)

	time_util.mod(self.time_mod_key, 0.5)

	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(alicia)

	--알리시아 애니메이션 0.5배로 출력
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(alicia, 0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(klen)

	-- 시간마다 알리시아 비강제 연출 진행
	start_coroutine(function()
		local target = self.characters.alicia()
		local time_passed = 0
		local talk_info = {
			{
				--2.5초(리얼 타임 5초)
				--알리시아 표정 (scared) 변경 후 유지.
				--생각 말풍선 대사: 커..큽…!
				time = 2.5,
				check = false,
				emotion = 'scared',
				talk_key = { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_33', type_speed = 0.02, bubble_type = 'thought', force_sfx = true },

			},
			{
				--5초(리얼 타임 10초)
				--알리시아 표정 (damaged) 변경 후 유지
				--생각 말풍선 대사: 더 이상… 버티기 힘들어….
				time = 5,
				check = false,
				emotion = 'damaged',
				talk_key = { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_34', type_speed = 0.02, bubble_type = 'thought', force_sfx = true },
				sfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01'
			},
			{
				--7.5초(리얼 타임 15초)
				--알리시아 표정 (scared) 변경 후 유지
				--생각 말풍선 대사:머리가 하얘진다….
				time = 7.5,
				check = false,
				emotion = 'scared',
				talk_key = { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_35', type_speed = 0.02, bubble_type = 'thought', force_sfx = true },
			},
		}

		while self.current_state == self.states.diving do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, #talk_info do
				if not talk_info[i].check and talk_info[i].time <= time_passed then
					if talk_info[i].sfx then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(talk_info[i].sfx)
					end
					talk_info[i].check = true
					scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, talk_info[i].emotion)
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(alicia,
							talk_info[i].talk_key)
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)


	-- 배경 따라가도록
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.background_loop = true

		while self.background_loop do
			self.water_back_ground.transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_0yz(
					self.water_back_ground.transform.localPosition, stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x + 1)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
end

			end_pos, 5,
			nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up', run = true })

	--알리시아 (right, idle, idle) 출력

	--알리시아 (right, tired, bomb_idle): 여긴 장치가 안 보이는데….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'smile', 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_keydoor_3')

	--클렌 (left, idle, bomb_idle): 눈썰미가 없군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(klen, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_keydoor_4')

	--알리시아 (right, attack, release 2회): 지금까지 장치로 열고 와서 그런 거라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s7_keydoor_5')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--이후 컨트롤 해제
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessMainSection8')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryClevatessMain @
		Comment = 보스전 @
		Index = 7 @
		NextSections = 8 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryClevatessMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_clevatess'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		battle_end = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.characters = {
		klen = function()
			return get_character('klen')
		end,
		alicia = function()
			return get_character('alicia_3')
		end,
		boss = function()
			return get_character('boss')
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		center_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s8_center_pos')
		end
	}

	self.battle_zone_name = 'boss_battle_zone'
	self.battle_group_name = 'boss_battle'
	self.battle_gate_name = 's8_battle_gate_'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self:battle_start()

		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		start_coroutine(self.battle_clear_setting, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:battle_start()
	local alicia = self.characters.alicia()
	local klen = self.characters.klen()
	local boss = self.characters.boss()
	local center = self.markers.center_pos()

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		character_util.set_position(alicia, center + vector(2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(alicia, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(klen, center + vector(2.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(klen, 'left')

		field_object_util.set_active_state(boss, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(boss, center + vector(-2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(boss, 'right')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
	end

	screen_util.show_boss_title(
			'ss_clevatess_main_s8_1',
			'ss_clevatess_main_s8_2',
			2
	)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(2)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boss)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
	character_util.set_death_type(boss, 'none')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(boss, alicia, 'battle')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. 2, false))
	
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'combat',name = 'ondemand/short_story_clevatess/audio:bgm_clevatess_battle_boss' })
	end
	
end

function local_class:battle_clear_setting()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. 2, false))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	local boss = self.characters.boss()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = boss
	heal_info.target = boss

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

return local_class

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.crazy_dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.crazy_dynamic_npcs)
		self.crazy_dynamic_npcs = nil
	end
end

end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	local background_util = {
		controller = nil,

		load_resource = function(this)
			this.controller = global_table_util.get_or_create_background_fade_controller()

			local asset_path = 'ondemand/short_story_clevatess/effects'
			local asset_name = 'white_tint_background'
			this.controller:load_async(asset_path, asset_name)
		end,

		set_position = function(this, pos)
			this.controller:set_background_position(pos)
		end,

		set_color = function(this, rgb_vector3)
			this.controller:set_background_color(rgb_vector3.x, rgb_vector3.y, rgb_vector3.z)
		end,

		set_active = function(this, boolean)
			this.controller:set_background_active(boolean)
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

			local value = this.controller.background_renderer.color.a

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(value - time_passed)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.controller ~= nil then
				this.controller:dispose_loaded()
			end

			this.controller = nil
		end
	}

	background_util:load_resource()

	self.fx:load_async()

	local boss = self.npc.boss()
	local klen = self.npc.klen()
	local alicia = self.npc.alicia()
	local neruru = self.npc.neruru()
	local luna = self.npc.luna()

	local scene_2_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_scene_2_pos_2')

	-- 1번 NPC (shortstory_ct_blacksmith_b)(right, idle, idle)
	-- 2번 NPC (shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a)(right, idle, idle)
	-- 3번 NPC (shortstory_ct_male_a)(left, idle, idle)
	-- 4번 NPC (shortstory_ct_male_b)(right, idle, idle)
	-- 5번 NPC (shortstory_ct_female_a)(right, idle, idle)
	-- 6번 NPC (right, idle, idle)
	self.dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		s9_dynamic_npc_1 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_b',
		s9_dynamic_npc_2 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_3 = 'shortstory_ct_male_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_4 = 'shortstory_ct_china_merchant',
		s9_dynamic_npc_5 = 'shortstory_ct_female_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_6 = 'shortstory_ct_steampunk_citizen_male',

		s9_dynamic_npc_1_1 = 'shortstory_ct_mercenary_female',
		s9_dynamic_npc_1_2 = 'shortstory_ct_mercenary_male',

		--FIXME 임시, 이펙트 발주시 삭제되어야 함
		s9_dynamic_tail = 'shortstory_ct_clevatess_tail',

		s9_dynamic_npc_e_1 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_2 = 'shortstory_ct_female_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_3 = 'shortstory_ct_male_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_4 = 'shortstory_ct_steampunk_citizen_male',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_5 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_6 = 'shortstory_ct_mayor',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_7 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_c',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_8 = 'shortstory_ct_steampunk_citizen_male',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_9 = 'shortstory_ct_kid_civilian_boy',
		s9_dynamic_npc_e_10 = 'shortstory_ct_male_a',
	})

	local dynamic_npcs = self.dynamic_npcs

	local dynamic_npc_table = {}

	local npc_count = 6

	for i = 1, npc_count do
		local dynamic_npc = dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_npc_' .. i]
		field_object_util.set_active_state(dynamic_npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_npc, i == 3 and 'left' or 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(dynamic_npc, field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_dynamic_npc_pos_' .. i))
		table.insert(dynamic_npc_table, dynamic_npc)
	end

	do
		--2번 NPC (shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a)(right, smile, idle) (이모션 확인 부탁드립니다.)
		local dynamic_npc_2 = dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_npc_2']
		scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_npc_2, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_npc_2, self, 'smile')

		--5번 NPC (shortstory_ct_female_a)(left, idle, cross_arm) (애니메이션 확인 부탁드립니다.)
		local dynamic_npc_5 = dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_npc_5']
		scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_npc_5, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_npc_5, self, 'eat')
		character_util.set_position(dynamic_npc_5, dynamic_npc_5.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))

	end

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_klen_pos_1') + vector(-2, 0, 1)

	-- 알리시아 부서진 지보 3(ct_broken_gibo_3)(임시)broken_sword 착용 상태
	scene_util.show_weapon(alicia)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(alicia, '[base]weapon1', self.controller.attachment_name.broken_gibo_3)

	alicia.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
	alicia.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'sword_walk'
	alicia.CustomRunAnimationName = 'sword_run'

	message_system:SendSync(alicia, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
	character_util.remove_anim(alicia)

	-- 카메라 4의 크기로 ◆ 위치에 포커스
	--아래로 0.5타일 이동 부탁드립니다.
	local cam_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.set_position(cam_pos)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 클렌 (left, idle, idle): 끝났군.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(klen, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_2')

	-- 보스 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 shake(0.03, 1) 출력
	character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	scene_util.shake(boss, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--위 연출 모두 종료되면 다음으로 진행
	--동시 연출
	do
		local shake_duration = 1.5
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_creature_08')

		--카메라 shake (0.08, 0.5) 출력
		camera_util.shake(0.08, shake_duration)

		-- 보스 (right, idle, roar) 출력 (보스 포효하는 애니메이션 발주 예정)
		scene_util.set_anim(boss, self, { name = 'roar', loop = true })

		wait_for_sec(shake_duration)

		character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 연출
	do
		--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 z축 +1.5로 이동
		camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.5)

		--카메라 0.5에 걸쳐 5크기로 줌아웃
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.5)
	end

	--아래 그룹 연출 동시 연출
	--보스 ‘바위 같은 포효 연출’ 출력
	local rock_pivot_pos_list = {
		alicia.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		alicia.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		alicia.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	}

	--클렌, 알리시아 중간 지점 위치 y 6 위치(221.5, 6, 92.5)에 차원 이펙트 출력(발주 예정)
	--fx_ct_gibo_action_cracked(회전값 y -90) 1.3배 출력
	local fx_dimension_pos
	local space_cracked_fx
	local space_cracked_open = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')

		fx_dimension_pos = rock_pivot_pos_list[2] + vector(-0.5, 8.5, 0)
		space_cracked_fx = self.fx.space_cracked_start_loop():Instantiate(fx_dimension_pos)
		space_cracked_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -113.5, 0)
		space_cracked_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.8
	end

	local falling_rock_and_consumed = function(rock_pivot_pos)

		--fx_obj_demon_rock y축 5의 높이에서 0.25초에 걸쳐 y축 0.7 위치로 목표 좌표로 직선 이동
		local bbr_end_pos = rock_pivot_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
		local bbr_start_pos = rock_pivot_pos + vector(0, 7, 0)
		local boss_big_rock = self.fx.boss_big_rock():Instantiate(bbr_start_pos)
		local falling_duration = 0.5

		--이동 시작 0.38초에 fx_ct_gibo_action_consumed 목표 위치에 출력되고 화면 shake (0.05, 0.3) 출력
		local consumed_pos = bbr_end_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
		local consumed_fx = nil
		local consumed_start_timing = 0.38

		--이동 시작 0.3초에 fx_ct_boss_big_rock_proj 크기 0.1초에 걸쳐 sacle 1에서 0으로 출력
		local bbr_scale_start_timing = 0.3
		local bbr_scale_duration = 0.1
		local bbr_start_scale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		local bbr_end_scale = vector(0, 0, 0)

		do
			local time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < falling_duration do

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				--bbr 움직임
				local move_progress = time_passed / falling_duration
				local cur_pos = move_progress * bbr_end_pos + (1 - move_progress) * bbr_start_pos
				boss_big_rock.transform.position = cur_pos

				--consumed 출력
				if time_passed > consumed_start_timing and
						consumed_fx == nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_blackflower_cast_02')
					consumed_fx = self.fx.gibo_action_consumed():Instantiate(consumed_pos)
					camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)
				end

				--bbr scale 조정
				if time_passed > bbr_scale_start_timing then
					local scale_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((time_passed - bbr_scale_start_timing) / bbr_scale_duration)
					local cur_scale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(bbr_start_scale, bbr_end_scale, scale_progress)
					boss_big_rock.transform.localScale = cur_scale

				end

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			boss_big_rock.transform.position = bbr_end_pos
		end

		boss_big_rock:Dispose()
	end

	local red_open

	local move_end_key = 's9_move_end'

	wait_all_lua(
	--포효 연출은 각각 두번 반복
			function()
				space_cracked_open()
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작 2초 후 다음 연출 시작
				wait_for_sec(2)
				--목표 좌표
				--1. (221.5, 0, 92.5)
				falling_rock_and_consumed(rock_pivot_pos_list[1])
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작 2 + 0.3초 후 아래 진행
				wait_for_sec(2.3)
				--2. (222, 0, 92.5)
				falling_rock_and_consumed(rock_pivot_pos_list[2])
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작 2 + 0.3 + 0.3초 후 아래 진행
				wait_for_sec(2.6)
				--3. (222.5, 0, 92.5)
				--위 연출 모두 완료되면 shake 정지
				falling_rock_and_consumed(rock_pivot_pos_list[3])
			end,
			function()
				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				--클렌 (up, idle, idle) 출력
				scene_util.set_direction(klen, 'up', false)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(klen)

				--알리시아 (up, idle, idle) 상태에서 normal jump 1회 출력 (async 아님)
				scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'up', false)
				character_util.normal_jump(alicia)

				--위 연출 0.1초 후 아래 연출 진행
				wait_for_sec(1.3)

				--알리시아 방어 연출
				-- 알리시아 : 쓸데 없는 짓을…!
				start_coroutine(function()
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(alicia, self, nil,
							nil, nil, { key = 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_3', skip = false, bubble_direction = 'rb' })
				end)

				--알리시아 방어 연출, sword_attack 실행 - 02_clevatess_cwp_ready_01 + 02_clevatess_cwp_attack_01
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_clevatess_cwp_ready_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_clevatess_cwp_attack_01')

				--알리시아 (left, attack, sword_attack 마지막에 정지)
				scene_util.set_direction(alicia, 'up', false)
				scene_util.set_anim(alicia, self, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })

			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos, true)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
		character_util.set_position(npc, end_pos)

		time_passed = 0

		local next_end_pos = end_pos - vector(3, 0, 0)
		--duration = (next_end_pos - end_pos).magnitude / (speed * 0.25)
		duration = 0.8

			character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 360 * 2, duration)
		else
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.8)
		end

		if callback ~= nil then
			callback()
		end

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(end_pos, next_end_pos, progress)

			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

function local_class:trio_scene()
	local trio_boss = self.npc.trio_boss()
	local trio_man = self.npc.trio_man()
	local trio_panda = self.npc.trio_panda()

	--NPC 배치
	--스칼렛(right, tired, idle)
	--대니(right, tired, idle)
	--레드 팬더(right, tired, idle)

	--(0,0,0)
	local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_scene_2_pos_2') + vector(1, 0, 1)

	--스칼렛 기준
	local center = pivot + vector(4, 0, -1.5)
	self:npc_setting_trio()

	self.trio_dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_1 = 'shortstory_ct_male_a',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_2 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_3 = 'shortstory_ct_kid_civilian_boy',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_4 = 'shortstory_ct_female_a',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_5 = 'shortstory_ct_blacksmith_b',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_6 = 'shortstory_ct_mercenary_male',
		s9_dynamic_smith_t_7 = 'shortstory_ct_china_merchant',
	})

	local dynamic_1 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_1']
	local dynamic_2 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_2']
	local dynamic_3 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_3']
	local dynamic_4 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_4']
	local dynamic_5 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_5']
	local dynamic_6 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_6']
	local dynamic_7 = self.trio_dynamic_npcs['s9_dynamic_smith_t_7']

	--1번 NPC(shortstory_ct_male_a)(right, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_1, self, 'smile')
	dynamic_1.Position = pivot + vector(3.5, 0, 1.5)

	--2번 NPC(shortstory_ct_blacksmith_a)(left, smile, bomb_idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_2, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_2, self, 'bomb_idle')
	dynamic_2.Position = pivot + vector(4.5, 0, 1.5)

	--3번 NPC(shortstory_ct_kid_civilian_boy)(right, awesome, dance)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_3, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_3, self, 'awesome')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_3, self, 'dance')
	dynamic_3.Position = pivot + vector(-1.5, 0, -0.5)

	--4번 NPC(shortstory_ct_female_a)(left, smile, clap)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_4, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_4, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_4, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })
	dynamic_4.Position = pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

	--5번 NPC(shortstory_ct_blacksmith_b)(left, idle, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_5, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_5, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
	dynamic_5.Position = pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)

	--6번 NPC(shortstory_ct_mercenary_male)(right, smile, bomb_idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_6, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_6, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_6, self, 'bomb_idle')
	dynamic_6.Position = pivot + vector(1.5, 0, -4.5)

	--7번 NPC(shortstory_ct_china_merchant)(left, smile, clap)
	scene_util.set_direction(dynamic_7, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_7, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_7, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })
	dynamic_7.Position = pivot + vector(2.5, 0, -4.5)

	--카메라은 스칼렛 도착 위치 위로 3타일 위치에 세팅
	local cam_start_pos = pivot + vector(3.5, 0, -1.5)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				camera_util.resize_to_default(4)
				camera_util.move_async(cam_start_pos, 4)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 2)

				wait_for_sec(2)

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			end
	)


	--기존 다이나믹 npc 제거
	if self.crazy_dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.crazy_dynamic_npcs)
		self.crazy_dynamic_npcs = nil
	end
	if self.crazy_dynamic_npcs_2 ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.crazy_dynamic_npcs_2)
		self.crazy_dynamic_npcs_2 = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trio_non_fight', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })

	--동시 연출
	do
		--스칼렛, 대니, 레드 팬더 카메라 그리드 밖에서 (up, tired, walk) 4의 속도로 노란색 위치로 이동
		--도착하면 아래와 같이 정렬
		--스칼렛 (right, tired, idle)
		--대니 (right, tired, idle)
		--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(trio_boss, center, 3, nil, self, nil)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(trio_man, center + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				3, nil, self, nil)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(trio_panda, center + vector(1, 0, 0),
				3, nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--스칼렛 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_boss, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_boss, self, 'tired')

	--대니 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_man, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_man, self, 'tired')

	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_panda, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_panda, self, 'tired')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--스칼렛 (right, tired, idle): 300만 골드가 사라졌네.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_boss, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_43')

	--대니(right, tired, idle): 대니… 배고프다. 고기 먹고 싶다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_man, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_44')

	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle)(shake 0.03, 1) 출력
	scene_util.shake(trio_panda, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--레드 팬더 (right, tired, walk) 1의 속도로 오른쪽 2타일 이동
	--레드 팬더 도달하면 다음 연출 진행
	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle)
	wp_util.move_async(trio_panda, trio_panda.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			1, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--스칼렛 (right, tired, release 3회): 야! 어디가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_45')

	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle): 더 볼일 있어? 하던 일이나 해야지.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_panda, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_46')

	do
		--대니 (right, tired, idle) 상태로 shake(0.03, 1) 출력
		scene_util.shake(trio_man, 0.03, 1)

		--레드 팬더 (right, tired, walk) 1의 속도로 오른쪽 0.5타일 이동
		scene_util.set_anim(trio_panda, self, 'walk')
		wp_util.move_async(trio_panda, trio_panda.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil)

		--레드 팬더 도착하면 (right, tired, walk 정지 상태)
		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(trio_panda, 0)
	end

	do
		--화면 shake(0.05, 0.5) 출력
		camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.5)

		--대니 (left, tired, idle): 가지마라. 대니 슬프다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(trio_man, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_47', true, { scale = 1.3 })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	do
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, 1)

		--대니 (left, smile, idle): 팬더랑 같이 있으면 재밌다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(trio_man, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_man, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_48')
	end

	--레드 팬더 (silence) 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(trio_panda, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(trio_panda)
	character_util.remove_anim(trio_man)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(trio_panda, nil, 'silence')

	--스칼렛 (right, idle, release 3회): 그… 그래! 가지마.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, 'idle', 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_49')

	--스칼렛 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 우리 같이 용병단을 만드는 게 어때?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle', 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_50')

	--레드 팬더 (left, idle, idle): 용병단?
	scene_util.set_direction(trio_panda, 'left')
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_panda, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_51')

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.3, 2)
			end,
			function()
				--스칼렛(right, idle, idle): 이야기 지어내는 것보다 우리랑 지내는 게 더 재밌지 않아?
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_boss, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_52', true)
			end
	)

	--레드 팬더 (left, attack, idle): 무슨 소리!
	--jump 2회
	character_util.normal_double_jump(trio_panda, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_panda, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_52_1')

	--레드 팬더 (left, attack, attack 2회): 모두 이 몸이 겪은 일이라고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_panda, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'attack', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_52_2')

	--스칼렛 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 뭐… 믿어는 줄게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_52_3')

	--스칼렛 (right, idle, idle): 그래서 어떻게 할래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_52_4')

	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle) 상태에서 (silence) 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_panda, self, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(trio_panda, nil, 'silence')

	--레드 팬더 (left, tired, idle) shake(0.03, 1)
	scene_util.shake(trio_panda, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--레드 팬더 (left, smile, victory_get): 너… 너희들이 원한다면 특별히 합류해 주지!
	--스칼렛 ,대니 (smile) 이모션으로 유지
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trio', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_boss, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_man, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_panda, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, 'attack', 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_53')

	--레드 팬더(left, smile, run) 5의 속도로 스칼렛 오른쪽 1타일로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_panda, self, 'smile')
	wp_util.move_async(trio_panda, trio_boss.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--레드 팬더 (left, smile, release 3회) : 대신 용병단 이름은 매드 팬더단이다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_panda, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, nil,
			'ss_clevatess_main_s9_54')

	--대니 (right, smile, victroy_get 마지막 정지): 좋다! 팬더 좋다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_man, self, 'right',
			'victory_get', { name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'ss_clevatess_main_s9_55')

	--스칼렛 (right, smile, release 3회): 전설의 용병, 탄생이다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trio_boss, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, { name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'ss_clevatess_main_s9_56')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이동 중에 대사 출력
	--스칼렛(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 그런데 말야.
	scene_util.set_emotion(trio_boss, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(trio_man, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(trio_boss, 'ss_clevatess_main_s9_57', true)

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class ShortStoryClevatessOniGirlRacingController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryClevatessOniGirlRacingController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.quest_name = 'onigirl_quest'
	self.main_quest_id = 7002101

	self.get_onigirl = function()
		return get_character('onigirl_kid')
	end

	self.get_onigirl_mother = function()
		return get_character('onigirl_mother')
	end

	self.get_intro_pivot = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_quest_onigirl_pivot_pos')
	end

	self.get_blocks = function(index)
		return get_field_object('sub_quest_onigirl_block_' .. index)
	end

	--오픈시점 : 6섹션 이후
	self.start_open_section = 5

	--메인 퀘스트 ID
	self.main_quest_id = 7002101

	self.is_onigirl_routine_start = false

	self.onigirl_routine_flag = false
	self.request = false

	self.is_stage_end = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_onigirl_routine_start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_quest_onigirl_acting_zone') then
		self.onigirl_routine_flag = true

		self:onigirl_active_routine()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_onigirl_routine_start and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_quest_onigirl_acting_zone') then

		self:deactive_onigirl_routine()
		return false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == self.start_open_section then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
		local mother = self.get_onigirl_mother()
		local pivot = self.get_intro_pivot()

		character_util.set_position(onigirl, pivot + vector(-2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'right')
		onigirl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		field_object_util.set_active_state(onigirl, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_position(mother, pivot + vector(0, 0, 3))
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'down')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(mother, active_state_type.enabled)

		self.is_onigirl_routine_start = true

		self:clear_setting(false)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.start_open_section then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
		local mother = self.get_onigirl_mother()
		local pivot = self.get_intro_pivot()

		character_util.set_position(onigirl, pivot + vector(-2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'right')
		onigirl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		field_object_util.set_active_state(onigirl, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_position(mother, pivot + vector(0, 0, 3))
		character_util.set_direction(mother, 'down')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(mother, active_state_type.enabled)

		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			mother.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_clevatess_oni_girl_62'
		end

		self.is_onigirl_routine_start = true

		self:clear_setting(false)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.is_stage_end = true
end

function local_class:clear_setting(is_start)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.onigirl_routine_flag = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_start, true)

	self:onigirl_active_routine()
end

function local_class:onigirl_active_routine()
	local pivot = self.get_intro_pivot()

	if not self.request then
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.request = true
			while self.onigirl_routine_flag and not self.is_stage_end do
				self:onigirl_oneline_routine(
						self.get_onigirl(),
						pivot + vector(-2, 0, 0),
						self.get_blocks(1),
						pivot + vector(2, 0, 0),
						(self.onigirl_routine_flag and not self.is_stage_end)
				)
			end
			self.request = false
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_oneline_routine(fo, start_pos, jump_fo, rotate_pos, check_flag)
	local jump_fo_left_vec = jump_fo.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 0)
	local jump_fo_right_vec = jump_fo.Position + vector(0.8, 0, 0)

	--라나 아래 동작 loop 한다.
	--라나 (left, attack, run) 애니적용 5의 속도로 좌로 2타일 이동
	self:move_async(fo, jump_fo_left_vec, 5, nil, nil, check_flag)

	if not check_flag then
		return
	end

	--라나 캐릭터 (left, attack, jump) 0.5초간 높이 1.5로 점프하여 1타일 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = fo})
	character_util.jump_move(fo, jump_fo_right_vec,
			5, 1.5, true, character_util.get_look_direction(fo))

	if not check_flag then
		return
	end

	--라나 (left, attack, run) 애니적용 5의 속도로 좌로 2타일 이동
	--라나 right 방향전환
	self:move_async(fo, rotate_pos, 5, nil, nil, check_flag)

	if not check_flag then
		return
	end

	--라나 (right, attack, run) 애니적용 5의 속도로 우로 2타일 이동
	self:move_async(fo, jump_fo_right_vec, 5, nil, nil, check_flag)

	if not check_flag then
		return
	end

	--라나 캐릭터 (right, attack, jump) 0.5초간 높이 1.5로 점프하여 1타일 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = fo})
	character_util.jump_move(fo, jump_fo_left_vec,
			5, 1.5, true, character_util.get_look_direction(fo))

	if not check_flag then
		return
	end

	--라나 (right, attack, run) 애니적용 5의 속도로 우로 2타일 이동
	--라나 leftt 방향전환
	self:move_async(fo, start_pos, 5, nil, nil, check_flag)
end

function local_class:move_async(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data, check_flag)
	local end_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_callback')

	if data == nil then
		data = {}
	end

	local move_end = false

	data.end_callback = function()
		if end_callback then
			end_callback()
		end

		move_end = true
	end

	wp_util.move(fo, waypoints, speed, duration, data)

	while check_flag and not move_end and fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not check_flag then
		character_util.stop(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:deactive_onigirl_routine()
	self.onigirl_routine_flag = false
end

return local_class

function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height)
	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:setting_start()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		-- 미션키가 1이거나 퀘스트가 완료되었을 때
		if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.mission_key(3)) == 1
				or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local door_name = self.get_epicurean_slime_feed_door_1_name
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, false))
		end
	end
end

-- size만큼 duration시간동안 크기를 줄이고 아이템을 삭제한다.
function local_class:sprite_duration_size_set(target, to, duration, from)
	local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
	local time_passed = 0

	-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
		target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
		target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
	target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

	-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(target)
	end
end

function local_class:target_throw(target, end_pos, height, duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local end_time = duration

	-- 시작 위치 저장
	local target_pos = target.Position
	target.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	while true do
		-- 현재 시간과 시작 시간을 빼서 지난 시간을 체크
		local time_limit = unity_class.time.time - start_time

		-- 시간 초과시 종료
		if time_limit >= end_time then
			local change_pos = self.controller:bezier_curves(target_pos, end_pos, 1, height)
			if lua_helper.type_compare(target, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
				character_util.set_position(target, change_pos)
			else
				target.Position = change_pos
			end
			break
		end

		local progress = time_limit / end_time
		local change_pos = self.controller:bezier_curves(target_pos, end_pos, progress, height)

		if lua_helper.type_compare(target, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
			character_util.set_position(target, change_pos)
		else
			target.Position = change_pos
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	target.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
end

function local_class:party_position_setting(dai_pos, dir, index)
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	-- 흉켈 존재 체크
	local is_hyunckel = user_party:Contains(hyunckel)

	local dai_party_pos = {}
	if index == 1 then
		-- 생선 꼬치
		dai_party_pos = {
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), dai_pos + vector(2, 0, 1),
			dai_pos + vector(1, 0, 1), dai_pos + vector(2, 0, 0)
		}
	elseif index == 2 then
		--슬라임 스튜
		dai_party_pos = {
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), dai_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), dai_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			dai_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0), dai_pos + vector(-2, 0, -0.5)
		}
	elseif index == 3 then
		--선택지
		dai_party_pos = {
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)
		}
	elseif index == 4 then
		-- 프리섹션
		dai_party_pos = {
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, 0), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			dai_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), dai_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)
		}
	end

	-- 1다이, 2레오나
	-- 3포프, 4고메
	-- 5마암, 6흉켈
	local move_key = 'dai_party'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai, dai_party_pos[1], 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leona, dai_party_pos[2], 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(popp, dai_party_pos[3], 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(gome, dai_party_pos[4], 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })

	-- 흉켈 포함
	if is_hyunckel then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maam, dai_party_pos[5], 4,
				nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hyunckel, dai_party_pos[6], 4,
				nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
	else
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maam, dai_party_pos[5], 4,
				nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = dir })
	end
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
end

function local_class:create_drop_item(pos, itemid, target_pos, scale, showoncharacter)
	local item_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
	local item_showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, true)
	local item_target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, nil)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = pos,
		target = item_target_pos,
		itemid = itemid,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = item_scale,
		showoncharacter = item_showoncharacter
	})
	return item
end

function local_class:throw_drop_item_create(start_pos, end_pos, start_itemid, end_itemid, scale, showoncharacter)
	local item_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
	local item_showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, true)
	local item = self:create_drop_item(
			start_pos,
			start_itemid,
			nil,
			item_scale
	)
	-- 던진 후 그 위치에 아이템 생성 유무 (다른 아이템id가능 / 예. 물약병 -> 깨진 물약병)
	if end_itemid == nil then
		drop_item_util.throw_item(item, end_pos)
	else
		drop_item_util.throw_item(item, end_pos)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
		item = self:create_drop_item(
				end_pos,
				end_itemid,
				nil,
				item_scale,
				item_showoncharacter
		)
	end
	return item
end

	return false

	if e.SwitchObject == get_field_object(self.get_epicurean_reset_switch_name) then

	end

	elseif self.current_epicurean_state == self.choose_state.finish then

		self:set_choose_event()

-- 첫 시작 존 이벤트
function local_class:epicurean_start_event()
	-- 식당 (사장, 직원)
	local owner = self.controller.get_epicurean_restaurant_owner()
	local employee = self.controller.get_epicurean_restaurant_employee()

	-- 위치 설정 용
	local owner_after_pos = self.controller.get_epicurean_food_markers(2, 2).position
			+ vector(2, -1, 0)
	local employee_after_pos = owner_after_pos + vector(1, 0, 1)

	--식당 주인(right, attack, idle) 가슐랭 가이드의 미식가가 우리 마을의 식당을 평가하기 위해 왔다고 한다.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(owner, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(owner, self.get_string_presection_name .. 1)

	--식당 주인(right, attack, release x2) 궁극의 요리를 선보여서 그동안 갈고닦은 실력을 보여주자!
	scene_util.pointing_at(owner, 2, '01_swing_01', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(owner, self.get_string_presection_name .. 2)

	--식당 알바(left, jump x1, attack) 예! 셰프!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(employee, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(employee, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(employee, self.get_string_presection_name .. 3)

	--둘 다 왼쪽으로 뛰어감
	local move_key = 'restaurant_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(owner, owner.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0), 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(employee, owner.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0), 4,
			nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 위치 셋팅
	character_util.set_position(owner, owner_after_pos)
	character_util.set_position(employee, employee_after_pos)
end

	character_util.remove_anim(epicurean)

	-- 미식가 (right, cross_arm, sleep_deep) 음…

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(epicurean, 'cross_arm')

	character_util.normal_jump(employee)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(epicurean, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(epicurean)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(epicurean, self.get_string_presection_name .. 11)

	-- 미식가 (right, release x2, idle) 이 정도론 가슐랭 스타를 드릴 수 없으니, 돌아가세요.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(epicurean, 'idle')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.pointing_at, epicurean, 2, '01_swing_01', true),
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, epicurean, self.get_string_presection_name .. 12)
	})

	-- 식당 주인 (left, idle, tired) 제기랄…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(owner, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(owner)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(owner, self.get_string_presection_name .. 13)

	-- 우측으로 퇴장
	wp_util.move_async(owner, { owner_marker_pos[1], owner_marker_pos[2] }, 4, nil,

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(employee, 'surprise')

			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 미식가는 음식2 좌측으로 올라가서

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(epicurean, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(epicurean, 'cross_arm')

	-- 미식가 (left, idle, tired) : 이 마을엔 환상적인 음식들이 많다는 소문을 듣고 왔는데…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(epicurean, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(epicurean)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(epicurean, self.get_string_presection_name .. 15)

	-- 미식가 (left, cross_arm, tired) : 가슐랭 가이드에 새로 이름을 올릴 만한 식당은 없는 건가….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(epicurean, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(epicurean, 'cross_arm')

	-- 파티 초기화
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- mission_0의 값을 2로 바꿔주고 다시 시작안되도록 설정

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 원라인 대사 추가
	local civilian_1 = self.controller.get_epicurean_civilian(1)
	local civilian_2 = self.controller.get_epicurean_civilian(2)
	civilian_1.Interactable.Talk = self.get_string_section_1_name .. 80 .. '_1'
	civilian_2.Interactable.Talk = self.get_string_section_1_name .. 80 .. '_2'
	owner.Interactable.Talk = self.get_string_section_1_name .. 87
	employee.Interactable.Talk = self.get_string_section_1_name .. 88
	--endregion
end
