	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_8_1_2')
	character_util.remove_emotion(dai)

	--다이(attack, dagger_idle) : 반드시… 대마왕 버언을 쓰러뜨리겠어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'dagger_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_8_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

	--마암(idle, idle) : 아방 선생님께서도 언제나 우리를 지켜봐주실거야, 다이.
	--이 대사할 때 다이 right.
	scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'right')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_8_2')

	--다이 right, idle, nod 1회.
	scene_util.nod_the_head(dai)

	--레오나(tired) : 델무린 섬에서 처음 만났을 때는 너무 작아서 믿음이 가지 않았는데…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leona, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_8_4')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leona)

	--레오나(smile, cast) : 이제는 정말 믿음직스러워졌구나, 다이.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'cast', { upper = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leona, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_8_5')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leona, true)

	--마암(smile, clap) : 자, 우리도 이제 자야지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'clap', { upper = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_9')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maam, true)

	--레오나(smile, nod) : 다들 푹 자야 내일 작전도 성공할거야.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leona, { name = 'nod', upper = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leona, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_10')

	--대사 끝나면, 일행들 자리에 눕는다.
	--각각 0.1초 차이를 두고, 포프, 레오나, 마암 순으로 눕는다.
	--표정은 sleep_deep, 애니메이션은 sleep(상하체 포함)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'sleep', { mix_duration = 0.2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'sleep', { mix_duration = 0.2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'sleep', { mix_duration = 0.2 })

	--고메는 sleep, sleep
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.set_direction(gome, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(gome, 'sleep', { mix_duration = 0.2 })

	--다이도 일행들 눕기 시작하면 left 바라보고,
	wp_util.move_async(dai, vector(dai_bed_pos.x + 2, 0, dai.Position.z), 2)

	--침대 위로 점프한 후,
	local jump_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_dai')
	local jump_duration = 0.4

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'get')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(dai, 1.2, jump_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(dai, jump_pos, nil, jump_duration)

	character_util.cancel_jump(dai)
	character_util.remove_anim(dai)

	character_util.set_direction(dai, 'right')

	--tired, sleep으로 0.3초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'sleep', { mix_duration = 0.2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--=> sleep_deep, sleep으로 잠든다.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'sleep_deep')

	--다이 눈감으면서 화면 페이드아웃 1초에 걸쳐서.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(bg_loop_sfx, 2.0)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maam)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leona)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gome)

	field_util.remove_tint(room_tint_key, 0)
end

function local_class:portal_open_scene()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()

	local room_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_room_center')

	camera_util.move_async(room_center, 0)

	--초록색 사각형이 마법진. 주황색 사각형이 포탈.
	--좌상단에 포프, 좌하단에 다이, 우상단에 마암, 우하단에 레오나.
	--방에 전원 잠들어 있다.
	--각자 침대에,
	character_util.set_position(popp, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_popp'))
	character_util.set_direction(popp, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'sleep')

	character_util.set_position(dai, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_dai'))
	character_util.set_direction(dai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'sleep_deep')

	character_util.set_position(maam, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_maam'))
	character_util.set_direction(maam, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'sleep_deep')

	character_util.set_position(leona, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_leona'))
	character_util.set_direction(leona, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'sleep_deep')

	-- 고메는 다이 아래쪽에.
	character_util.set_position(gome, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_bed_gome'))
	character_util.set_direction(gome, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(gome, 'sleep')

	--틴트로 조금 어둡게 표현.
	local room_tint_key = 'main_s1_portal_open'

	field_util.tint(room_tint_key, unity_color({ 0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1 }), 0)

	local bg_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2.0,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
	})

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	scene_util.shake(dai, 0.025, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--다이 잠꼬대 대사 : …엄마… 아빠…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_0_11')

	--2초간 대기.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--그 때, 방 바닥에 마법진이 그려지기 시작한다.
	--이펙트 자체의 생성 시간으로 마법진 그려지는 것 조절 예정.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')
	local portal_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s1_portal_center')
	self.get_fx_crack_start():Instantiate(portal_center_pos)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(bg_loop_sfx, 1)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--마법진이 생성되기 시작하고 1초 뒤,
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local crack_effect = self.get_fx_crack():Instantiate(portal_center_pos)

	--고메가 0.3초간 shake하고,
	scene_util.shake(gome, 0.025, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--0.3초 대기,
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--다시 0.3초간 shake하고
	scene_util.shake(gome, 0.025, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--점프하며 깨어난다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gome)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(gome, 'left', 0.3, 0.4)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--고메가 right 바라보며,
	scene_util.set_direction(gome, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--surprise 표정으로 느낌표 이모티콘 띄운다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'surprise')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(gome, nil, 'notice')

	--그동안, 마법진이 완성된다.
	--마법진 완성됨과 동시에 작게 카메라 쉐이크 시작.(아래 일행들 모두 빨려들어갈 때까지 카메라 쉐이크 유지.)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_thunder_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 99999)

	--그제서야 일행들이 깨어나지만

	--일행들 shake 하다가 일어난다.
	local shake_done_count = 0
	local custom_shake_and_wakeup = function(character)
		scene_util.shake(character, 0.025, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(character, character.Direction, 0.3, 0.4)

		shake_done_count = shake_done_count + 1
	end

	--마암, 다이, 레오나 순으로 일어난다.
	--일어나는 간격은 0.15초
	start_coroutine(custom_shake_and_wakeup, maam)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(custom_shake_and_wakeup, dai)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(custom_shake_and_wakeup, leona)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	while shake_done_count < 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	crack_effect:Dispose()

	--포탈(fx_event_portalspawn_red_open)이 생겨난다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_07')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_01')
	local portal_effect = self.get_fx_portal_open():Instantiate(portal_center_pos)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_escape' })

	local portal_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_portal_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
	})


	--포탈이 생겨남과 동시에 카메라 쉐이크가 더 강해진다.
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 99999)

	--다들 표정 surprise.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'surprise')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local is_swaying_dict = {}

	local sway_routine = function(character, start_angle, angle_adder)
		is_swaying_dict[character] = true

		local cycle = 0.4
		local time_passed = 0

		while is_swaying_dict[character] do
			local current_angle = start_angle + math.sin((time_passed / cycle) * (math.pi * 2)) * angle_adder

			character_util.spine_rotate(character, current_angle, 0)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	local end_sway = function(character)
		is_swaying_dict[character] = nil
	end

	local first_group_action_done_count = 0
	local second_group_action_done_count = 0

	start_coroutine(function()
		--sleep, sleep애니메이션.

		local to_portal_dir = (portal_center_pos - popp.Position).normalized

		--하지만 점점 포탈에 가까워진다.
		--1초에 걸쳐 0.3 가까워진다.
		character_util.move_to_async(popp, popp.Position + to_portal_dir * 0.3, 1)

		--이후, 1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--다시 1초에 걸쳐 0.3 가까워진다.
		character_util.move_to_async(popp, popp.Position + to_portal_dir * 0.3, 1)

		--침대 끝에 도달하면 빙글빙글 돌며 빨려 들어간다.
		first_group_action_done_count = first_group_action_done_count + 1
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--마암도 뒤로 돌아 attack, run 애니메이션으로
		scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'attack')

		local bed_head_pos = maam.Position + vector(0.8, 0.5, 0)
		wp_util.move_async(maam,
				vector_util.get_x0z(bed_head_pos + vector(-0.4, 0, 0), maam.Position.y),
				0.5, nil, { run = true })

		--침대의 베개 위쪽 나무 부분을 붙잡는다.
		--attack, prostrate 애니메이션
		local jump_duration = 0.3
		local sway_start_angle = -5

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = jump_duration })
		character_util.jump(maam, 0.4, jump_duration)
		character_util.spine_rotate(maam, sway_start_angle, jump_duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(maam, bed_head_pos + vector(-0.2, 0, 0), jump_duration)

		--이후, 자신이 빨려들어가는 순서 전까지는 z축으로 10 ~ -20도로 회전하여 달랑달랑 거리는 느낌 표현.
		start_coroutine(sway_routine, maam, sway_start_angle, 15)

		second_group_action_done_count = second_group_action_done_count + 1
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--레오나는 포프와 마찬가지로 뒤로 돌아 damaged, run 애니메이션.
		scene_util.set_direction(leona, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'run')

		local to_portal_dir = (portal_center_pos - leona.Position).normalized

		--하지만 점점 포탈에 가까워진다.
		--1초에 걸쳐 0.3 가까워진다.
		character_util.move_to_async(leona, leona.Position + to_portal_dir * 0.3, 1)

		--이후, 1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--다시 1초에 걸쳐 0.3 가까워진다.
		character_util.move_to_async(leona, leona.Position + to_portal_dir * 0.3, 1)

		--침대 끝에 도달하면 빙글빙글 돌며 빨려 들어간다.
		first_group_action_done_count = first_group_action_done_count + 1
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local sway_start_angle = 5
		local rotate_duration = 0.5
		--다이는 1바퀴 돌며 빨려들어가다가,
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.spine_rotate(dai, -360 + sway_start_angle, rotate_duration)

		local bed_edge_pos = dai.Position + vector(1, 0.1, 0.85)
		local start_pos = dai.Position
		local target_pos = bed_edge_pos + vector(0.2, 0, 0)

		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < rotate_duration do
			local progress = interpolations_constants.ease_in_quad(time_passed, 0, 1, rotate_duration)

			dai.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		dai.Position = target_pos

		character_util.spine_rotate(dai, sway_start_angle, 0)

		character_util.set_direction(dai, 'left')

		--침대 끝부분을 damaged, prostrate 애니메이션으로 붙잡는다.
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = 0.2 })

		--붙잡고 있는 동안은 z축으로 10 ~ -20도로 회전하여 달랑달랑 거리는 느낌 표현.
		start_coroutine(sway_routine, dai, sway_start_angle, -15)

		--1초간 붙잡고 있다가 빨려들어간다.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		second_group_action_done_count = second_group_action_done_count + 1
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local sway_start_angle = 5

		--고메는 다이 옆에 붙어 함께 침대를 붙잡고 있는다.
		scene_util.set_direction(gome, 'left')

		local jump_duration = 0.3
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(gome, 'sleep', { mix_duration = jump_duration })
		character_util.spine_rotate(gome, sway_start_angle, jump_duration)
		character_util.jump(gome, 0.4, jump_duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(gome, gome.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3), jump_duration)

		--붙잡고 있는 동안은 z축으로 10 ~ -20도로 회전하여 달랑달랑 거리는 느낌 표현.
		start_coroutine(sway_routine, gome, sway_start_angle, -15)

		second_group_action_done_count = second_group_action_done_count + 1
	end)

	--빙글빙글 돌며 빨려 들어간다.
	local enter_portal_done_count = 0

	local enter_portal_routine = function(character)
		--빨려들어가는 속도는 모두 동일하게.
		local speed = 6
		local start_pos = character.Position
		local target_pos = portal_center_pos
		local duration = (start_pos - target_pos).magnitude / speed

		local alpha_fade_duration = 3 / 6
		local alpha_fade_activated = false

		local target_rot = start_pos.x < target_pos.x and 720 or -720

		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local calc_progress = 1 - math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress)

			character.Position = start_pos * (1 - calc_progress) + target_pos * calc_progress
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, target_rot * calc_progress)

			if not alpha_fade_activated and duration - time_passed <= alpha_fade_duration then
				alpha_fade_activated = false

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, duration - time_passed)
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)

		enter_portal_done_count = enter_portal_done_count + 1
	end

	while first_group_action_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 99999)

	--포프, 레오나가 동시에 빨려들어가기 시작하고,
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'damaged')
	start_coroutine(enter_portal_routine, popp)

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'embarrassed')
	start_coroutine(enter_portal_routine, leona)

	--0.3초 후,
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	while second_group_action_done_count < 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--마암, 다이, 고메 모두 빨려들어가기 시작한다.
	end_sway(dai)
	character_util.remove_anim(dai)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'embarrassed')
	start_coroutine(enter_portal_routine, dai)

	end_sway(maam)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maam)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'embarrassed')
	start_coroutine(enter_portal_routine, maam)

	end_sway(gome)
	character_util.remove_anim(gome)
	start_coroutine(enter_portal_routine, gome)

	--마암, 다이, 고메 빨려들어가기 시작하면서 카메라 줌인 시작.
	--3초간 사이즈 0.5배로 줌인.
	local zoom_duration = 3
	camera_util.move(portal_center_pos, zoom_duration)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, zoom_duration)

	while enter_portal_done_count < 5 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--포탈이 닫히고(fx_event_portalspawn_red_end),
	local portal_end_effect = self.get_fx_portal_end():Instantiate(portal_center_pos)
	portal_end_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	portal_effect:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(portal_loop_sfx, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--0.5초만에 화면 검은색 페이드아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 페이드아웃 끝날때까지 카메라 쉐이크 유지.
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	field_util.remove_tint(room_tint_key, 0)

	camera_util.cancel_move()
	camera_util.cancel_resize_to()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
end

function local_class:sky_scene()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()

	--2초 후,
	wait_for_sec(2)

	local camera_center_pos = vector(500, 0, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(camera_center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	self.background_sky_obj:SetActive(true)
	self.background_sky_obj.transform.position = camera_center_pos + vector(0, -10, 10)
	self.background_sky_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

	self.sky_tint_obj.transform.position = camera_center_pos
	self.sky_tint_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

	-- 일단 애니메이션 켜놓고 재생 속도만 0으로 설정
	self.background_sky_animator:Play('down')
	self:change_sky_speed_async(0, 0, 'linear')

	local members = {
		dai,
		popp,
		maam,
		leona,
		gome
	}

	for i = 1, #members do
		local member = members[i]

		character_util.set_direction(member, 'right')

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, popp) then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(member, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(member, 'damaged')
		else
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(member, 'embarrassed')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(member, 'surprise')
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(member, 0, 0)
		member.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

		character_util.set_active_shadow(member, false)
	end

	--화면 페이드 인 되면,
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--하늘에 포탈이 생기고,

	--프롤로그에서 썼던 하늘과 같은 방식으로 사용하되, 구름이 위로 스크롤 되는 형식으로 수정 필요함.(논의 필요)

	--좌측 원이 포탈.
	--포탈 생기고
	local portal_pos = camera_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local portal_effect = self.get_fx_portal_open():Instantiate(portal_pos)

	-- 생성 대기시간 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local fall_done_count = 0
	local screen_bonus_distance = 1.5
	local character_min_z = camera_center_pos.z -  screen_util.get_world_screen_size().y / 2 - screen_bonus_distance

	--다이 일행이 튀어나와 떨어진다.
	local fall_routine = function(character, start_pos, target_pos)
		local start_speed = 0
		local duration = 0.7
		local gravity = 2 * ((target_pos.z - start_pos.z) - start_speed * duration) / (duration * duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local x_speed = (target_pos.x - start_pos.x) / duration

		character.Position = start_pos

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, 0.5)

		--떨어질 때, 0.5초 동안 60도씩 각자 회전하며 떨어진다.
		character_util.spine_rotate(character, -60 / 0.5 * 5, 5)

		while time_passed < duration do
			--떨어질 때, 포물선으로 떨어지는 형태.
			local additional_height = start_speed * time_passed + gravity / 2 * time_passed * time_passed

			-- X방향 속도는 0까지 변경
			local current_x = start_pos.x + x_speed * time_passed

			character.Position = vector(current_x, 0, additional_height + start_pos.z)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		character.Position = target_pos

		--일행들 화면 아래(카메라 바깥)로 떨어진다.
		while character.Position.z > character_min_z do
			local additional_height = start_speed * time_passed + gravity / 2 * time_passed * time_passed
			local current_x = start_pos.x + x_speed * time_passed

			character.Position = vector(current_x, 0, additional_height + start_pos.z)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)

		fall_done_count = fall_done_count + 1
	end

	--떨어지는 순서는 포프, 마암, 다이, 레오나, 고메 순.
	--각각의 간격은 0.15초.
	start_coroutine(fall_routine, popp, portal_pos, camera_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -4))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(fall_routine, maam, portal_pos, camera_center_pos + vector(-1, 0, -4))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(fall_routine, dai, portal_pos, camera_center_pos + vector(2, 0, -4))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(fall_routine, leona, portal_pos, camera_center_pos + vector(1, 0, -4))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	start_coroutine(fall_routine, gome, portal_pos, camera_center_pos + vector(-2, 0, -4))
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	--고메까지 카메라에서 사라지고 나면,
	while fall_done_count < 5 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(members)

	--포탈이 닫힌다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')

	portal_effect:Dispose()

	local portal_end_effect = self.get_fx_portal_end():Instantiate(portal_pos)
	portal_end_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--포탈이 닫힌 후,

	local infinite_shake_key = 'main_s1_sky_fall'
	camera_util.shake(0.025, 99999, nil, infinite_shake_key)

	--카메라 아래로 이동
	local blizzard_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2.0,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
	})

	self:change_sky_speed_async(1.4, 1.5, 'ease_in_quad')

	local fail_effect = self.get_fx_fail():Instantiate(camera_center_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--일행들 애니메이션 세팅 0.35배속
	local embarrassed_anim_scale = 0.35

	local member_fall_offsets = {
		[dai] = vector(-2.5, 0, -0.5),
		[maam] = vector(2.5, 0, -0.5),
		[gome] = vector(-1.5, 0, 2),
		[leona] = vector(1.5, 0, 2),
		[popp] = unity_class.vector3.zero
	}

	local member_state = {
		stopped = 1,
		requested_stop = 2,
		in_cycle_rotate = 3,
		in_fall_shake = 4,
	}

	local current_member_state = {
		[dai] = member_state.stopped,
		[maam] = member_state.stopped,
		[gome] = member_state.stopped,
		[leona] = member_state.stopped,
		[popp] = member_state.stopped,
	}

	-- 즉시 정지
	local stop_member_routine = function(member)
		current_member_state[member] = member_state.stopped

		character_util.spine_rotate(member, member.SpineController.RotateAngle, 0)
		character_util.stop_shake(member)
	end

	-- 정지 요청. 실제 정지 시점은 상황마다 다름
	local request_stop_member_routine = function(member, fix_rotation)
		current_member_state[member] = member_state.requested_stop

		if fix_rotation then
			character_util.spine_rotate(member, member.SpineController.RotateAngle, 0)
		end
	end

	local fall_shake_routine = function(character, data)
		local start_rot = character.SpineController.RotateAngle
		local first_rot = start_rot + data.sway_rot_amplitude
		local second_rot = start_rot - data.sway_rot_amplitude

		local move_start_pos = character.Position
		local first_move_pos = move_start_pos + data.sway_pos_diff / 2
		local second_move_pos = move_start_pos - data.sway_pos_diff / 2

		local sway_once_dur = data.sway_cycle / 2

		local fall_move_diff = vector(0, 0, -1)
		local fall_duration = 2.5
		local fall_spin_once_rot = start_rot + (character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and 360 or -360)

		current_member_state[character] = member_state.in_fall_shake

		local fall_shake_change_offset_routine = function(target_rot, target_pos, duration, interpolation)
			local time_passed = 0
			local start_pos = character.Position
			local lerp_func = interpolations_constants.ease_in_out_quad

			if interpolation ~= nil then
				lerp_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]
			end

			if target_rot ~= nil then
				character_util.spine_rotate(character, target_rot, duration)
			end

			while current_member_state[character] == member_state.in_fall_shake and time_passed < duration do
				local progress = lerp_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

				character.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			if current_member_state[character] == member_state.in_fall_shake then
				character.Position = target_pos
			end
		end

		local custom_shake_async = function()
			local duration = 0.3
			character_util.shake(character, 0.015, duration)

			local start_time = unity_class.time.time

			if data.on_shake ~= nil then
				data.on_shake()
			end

			while current_member_state[character] == member_state.in_fall_shake and
					unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end

		--z축으로 15도 움직인 후
		while current_member_state[character] == member_state.in_fall_shake do
			-- 왔다 갔다 4번 반복. 단, 시작과 끝은 반씩만 움직이므로 이동 함수는 5번 실행
			fall_shake_change_offset_routine(first_rot, first_move_pos, sway_once_dur / 2)

			custom_shake_async()

			fall_shake_change_offset_routine(second_rot, second_move_pos, sway_once_dur)

			custom_shake_async()

			fall_shake_change_offset_routine(first_rot, first_move_pos, sway_once_dur)

			custom_shake_async()

			fall_shake_change_offset_routine(second_rot, second_move_pos, sway_once_dur)

			custom_shake_async()

			fall_shake_change_offset_routine(start_rot, move_start_pos, sway_once_dur / 2)

			if not data.just_sway then

				if current_member_state[character] ~= member_state.in_fall_shake then
					break
				end

				--이모션/애니메이션은 damaged, damaged로
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(character, 'damaged')

				--이후, 2.5초간 720도 회전
				--2.5초 간 z축 -1칸 이동
				fall_shake_change_offset_routine(fall_spin_once_rot, move_start_pos + fall_move_diff * 0.5,
						fall_duration / 2, 'ease_in_quad')

				if current_member_state[character] ~= member_state.in_fall_shake then
					break
				end

				character_util.spine_rotate(character, start_rot, 0)

				fall_shake_change_offset_routine(fall_spin_once_rot, move_start_pos + fall_move_diff * 0.5,
						fall_duration / 2, 'ease_out_quad')

				if current_member_state[character] ~= member_state.in_fall_shake then
					break
				end

				character_util.spine_rotate(character, start_rot, 0)

				--회전 끝나면 다시 애니메이션 cliff로 변경.
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(character, 'embarrassed',
						{ scale = embarrassed_anim_scale })

				-- 왔다 갔다 2번 반복. 단, 시작과 끝은 반씩만 움직이므로 함수는 3번 실행
				fall_shake_change_offset_routine(first_rot,
						first_move_pos + fall_move_diff * 0.75, sway_once_dur / 2)

				custom_shake_async()

				fall_shake_change_offset_routine(second_rot,
						second_move_pos + fall_move_diff * 0.25, sway_once_dur)

				custom_shake_async()

				fall_shake_change_offset_routine(start_rot, move_start_pos, sway_once_dur / 2)
			end
		end
	end

	local cycling_rotate_routine = function(character, is_clockwise, speed_ratio)
		local cycle = 1.5 / speed_ratio
		local start_angle = character.SpineController.RotateAngle
		local target_angle = (is_clockwise and -360 or 360) + start_angle

		current_member_state[character] = member_state.in_cycle_rotate

		while current_member_state[character] == member_state.in_cycle_rotate do
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, start_angle, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, target_angle, cycle)

			wait_for_sec(cycle)
		end

		if current_member_state[character] == member_state.requested_stop then
			current_member_state[character] = member_state.stopped
		end
	end

	local stoppable_move_req_id = {
		[popp] = 0,
		[gome] = 0,
	}

	local stop_move = function(character)
		stoppable_move_req_id[character] = stoppable_move_req_id[character] + 1
	end

	local stoppable_move_routine = function(character, target_pos, duration, interpolation)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = character.Position
		local progress_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

		stoppable_move_req_id[character] = stoppable_move_req_id[character] + 1
		local cur_id = stoppable_move_req_id[character]

		while cur_id == stoppable_move_req_id[character] and time_passed < duration do
			local progress = progress_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

			character.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if cur_id == stoppable_move_req_id[character] then
			character.Position = target_pos
		end
	end

	local trail_effects = {}
	local trail_activated = {}

	--대쉬 트레일 이펙트 루틴
	local trail_effect_routine = function(target)
		local time_passed = 0
		local trail_state = {
			move = 1,
			before_disable = 2,
			disabled = 3,
		}

		local current_trail_state = trail_state.move
		local move_duration = 0.4
		local additional_printing_dur = 0.5
		local delay = 0.5
		local effect_offset = vector(0, 0.35, 0)
		local start_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.5)
		local target_offset = vector(0, 0, 2.5)

		--몸에 FX_Dash_Trail 달고, localPosition (0, 0, -0.3)에서 localPosition(0, 0, 1.5)까지 0.4초만에 움직임
		--0.5초 대기
		--이펙트 disabled 한 후,  localPosition (0, 0, -0.3)으로 이동.
		--0.5초 대기
		--다시 반복.

		trail_activated[target] = true

		trail_effects[target] = self.get_fx_fall_trail():Instantiate(target.Position + effect_offset + start_offset)

		while trail_activated[target] do
			if current_trail_state == trail_state.move then
				if time_passed < move_duration then
					local progress = time_passed / move_duration
					local current_offset = start_offset * (1 - progress) + target_offset * progress
					trail_effects[target].transform.position = target.Position + effect_offset + current_offset
				else
					current_trail_state = trail_state.before_disable
					time_passed = 0
				end

			elseif current_trail_state == trail_state.before_disable then
				if time_passed > additional_printing_dur then
					trail_effects[target]:Dispose()
					trail_effects[target] = nil

					current_trail_state = trail_state.disabled
					time_passed = 0
				end

			elseif current_trail_state == trail_state.disabled then
				if time_passed > delay then
					trail_effects[target] = self.get_fx_fall_trail()
							:Instantiate(target.Position + effect_offset + start_offset)

					current_trail_state = trail_state.move

					time_passed = 0
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	local instantiate_trail_effect = function(target)
		start_coroutine(trail_effect_routine, target)
	end

	local dispose_trail_effect = function(target)
		trail_activated[target] = false

		if trail_effects[target] ~= nil then
			trail_effects[target]:Dispose()
		end

		trail_effects[target] = nil
	end

	local rotation_info = {
		dai = {
			start = -65,
			amplitude = 15
		},
		maam = {
			start = 65,
			amplitude = -15
		},
		leona = {
			start = 90,
			amplitude = -15
		},
		popp = {
			start = -10,
			amplitude = 10
		}
	}

	--일행들 애니메이션 세팅
	--다이 right, attack, embarrassed
	character_util.set_direction(dai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'embarrassed', { scale = embarrassed_anim_scale })
	character_util.spine_rotate(dai, rotation_info.dai.start, 0)

	--마암 left, attack, embarrassed
	character_util.set_direction(maam, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'embarrassed', { scale = embarrassed_anim_scale })
	character_util.spine_rotate(maam, rotation_info.maam.start, 0)

	--레오나 left, surprise, embarrassed
	character_util.set_direction(leona, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'embarrassed', { scale = embarrassed_anim_scale })
	character_util.spine_rotate(leona, rotation_info.leona.start, 0)

	--고메 right, damaged
	character_util.set_direction(gome, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'damaged')

	--별도 지시 있기 전까지는 이대로 계속 회전.
	start_coroutine(cycling_rotate_routine, gome, false, 1)

	--포프 right, damaged, damaged
	character_util.set_direction(popp, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'damaged')
	character_util.spine_rotate(popp, rotation_info.popp.start, 0)

	--별도 지시 있기 전까지는 이대로 계속 회전.
	--회전 속도는 고메의 1.15배로
	start_coroutine(cycling_rotate_routine, popp, true, 1.15)

	--카메라가 아래로 이동한 것처럼 보이도록, 일행들이 아래에서 천천히 위로 올라오는 형태로 구현.
	local move_camera_to_members = function(duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		-- FIXME : character_min_z가 해상도 따라 조금씩 달라지긴 함...
		local start_center_pos = vector(camera_center_pos.x, 0, character_min_z - 2)
		local target_center_pos = camera_center_pos

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = interpolations_constants.ease_out_sine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

			local current_center_pos = start_center_pos * (1 - progress) + target_center_pos * progress

			for i = 1, #members do
				local member = members[i]
				member.Position = current_center_pos + member_fall_offsets[member]

			local current_center_pos = vector(current_x, 0, current_z)

			local gather_progress = time_passed / gather_duration

			local current_offset_ratio = gather_progress < 1 and
					((1 - gather_progress) + target_offset_ratio * gather_progress) or target_offset_ratio

			for i = 1, #move_infos do
				local info = move_infos[i]

				info.fo.Position = current_center_pos + info.offset * current_offset_ratio
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #members do
		local member = members[i]
		activate_lura_trail_effect(member)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')

	lura_move_routine()

	--일행들 사라지면

	--1초간 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	moving_with_lura = false

	for i = 1, #members do
		local member = members[i]

		remove_lura_effect(member)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)

		member.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, origin_character_sorting_order)

		character_util.set_active_shadow(member, true)
		character_util.spine_rotate(member, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_scale(member, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, #lura_effects do
		lura_effects[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.background_sky_obj:SetActive(false)

	-- 루라 코루틴 종료까지 대기
	coroutine.yield()
end

function local_class:change_sky_speed_async(speed, duration, interpolation)
	local time_passed = 0
	local process_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	--애니메이터의 현재 속도
	local start_speed = self.background_sky_animator.speed

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = process_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		local current_speed = start_speed * (1 - progress) + speed * progress

		--애니메이터 속도 조절
		self.background_sky_animator.speed = current_speed

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.background_sky_animator.speed = speed
end

--- 하늘 연출용 페이드 인
function local_class:fade_sky_in_async(duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 - progress })

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 혹시 모르니 0000으로 초기화
	self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })

	-- 더 이상 렌더링 하지 않도록 비활성화
	self.sky_tint_obj:SetActive(false)
end

--- 하늘 연출용 페이드 아웃
function local_class:fade_sky_out_async(duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	self.sky_tint_obj:SetActive(true)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, progress })

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_class.color.black
end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_46')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'cast')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s1_47_2')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)

	--화면 오른쪽 SHOUT 말풍선 : 여기 있다!

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(goblins[1], 'short_story_dai_main_s1_48', nil,

	local goblin_appear_diff = vector(right_entrance_x + 1 - goblin_align_front.x, 0, 0)

	else

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'attack')

	character_util.set_active_state(leona, 'visible')

	--전투 시작.

	for i = 1, self.battle_info.monster_count do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(goblins[i], self.battle_info.group_name, self.battle_info.zone_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(goblins[i], dai, 'battle')
	end

	for i = 1, self.battle_info.gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_info.gate_name .. i))
	end

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(bg_loop_sfx, 1)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_battle

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function local_class:stop_avoid_battle()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()

	character_util.stop(leona)
	character_util.stop(gome)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leona)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gome)

	character_util.set_active_state(gome, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(leona, 'enabled')
end

function local_class:after_battle_scene()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	--전투 끝나면,
	for i = 1, self.battle_info.gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_info.gate_name .. i))
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.left_door_name .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.left_door_name .. 2, false))

	local bg_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_event_castle_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1.0,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
	})

	--화면 페이드인/아웃 하여 다음 연출 진행.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:stop_avoid_battle()

	self.dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		main_s1_after_battle_goblin_1 = 'shortstory_dai_standard_goblin',
		main_s1_after_battle_goblin_2 = 'shortstory_dai_standard_goblin',
		main_s1_after_battle_goblin_3 = 'shortstory_dai_standard_goblin',
		main_s1_after_battle_goblin_4 = 'shortstory_dai_standard_goblin',

		main_s1_after_battle_hyunckel = 'shortstory_dai_hyunckel_armor',

	local goblins = {

		self.dynamic_npcs.main_s1_after_battle_goblin_2,

		self.dynamic_npcs.main_s1_after_battle_goblin_5,

		dai,
		popp,
		maam,
		leona,
		gome,
	}

	-- 위치 세팅

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'tired')

	end

		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_meteorstrike_cast')
	end

	self.get_meteor_proj_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_meteorstrike_proj')
	end

		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_quest_dai_buff_loop')
	end

	self.get_event_crack_interact = function(num)
		return get_field_object('event_crack_interact_' .. num)
	end

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		interact_dolf = 2,
		battle_1 = 3,

		crack_end = 5,
		battle_2 = 6,
		clear_battle_2 = 7,
		enter_boss_zone = 8
	}

	self.dai_party = {}

	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	self.loop_sfxs = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.controller:crack_effects_on(4, 4)

	self.controller:change_oneline_npc_by_section_state(9, false)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.available_stage_name then
		start_coroutine(self.pre_setting, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.loop_sfxs ~= nil then
		for _, sfx in pairs(self.loop_sfxs) do
			sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.loop_sfxs = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	self.dai_party = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_dolf())
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_dolf
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.interact_dolf_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.crack_end then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2
		start_coroutine(self.start_battle_2, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'boss_battle') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_boss_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_boss_zone, self)

	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's9_battle_zone_1')  and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.crack_end
		self.controller:remove_crack_effect('s10_crack_1')

		-- 균열 상호작용 오브젝트 비활성화
		local event_crack_interact_obj = self.get_event_crack_interact(2)
		if event_crack_interact_obj ~= nil then
			event_crack_interact_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

	-- 진입 막는 이벤트들
	if self.is_enter_blocking_zone then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_1') then
		self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_2') then
		self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_1, self, e.Zone, 'left')
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_3') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_1 or
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.crack_end then
			self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_2, self, e.Zone, 'right')
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_1, self, e.Zone, 'right')
		end
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_4') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_1 or
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.crack_end then
			self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_2, self, e.Zone, 'down')
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_1, self, e.Zone, 'down')
		end
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_5') and
			(self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_1 or
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.crack_end) then
		self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_2, self, e.Zone, 'up')
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_6')  and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle_2 then
		self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_3, self, e.Zone, 'right')
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's10_block_zone_7') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.is_enter_blocking_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.blocking_wrong_way_1, self, e.Zone, 'left')
		return true
	end
	--endregion
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's10_battle_zone_1'
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear_battle_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.clear_battle_1_scene, self)
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 's10_battle_zone_2'
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear_battle_2
		start_coroutine(self.clear_battle_2, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	-- 집 들어갔을 경우 마커 세팅
	if e.CameraGrid.name == 'house_inner_grid' then

	if e.CameraGrid.name == 'house_inner_grid' then

	wp_util.move(dolf, dolf.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'eat' })

		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		character_util.hide_weapon(princess, false)
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'twohand_idle' })
	end)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_suspense', state = 'event' })

	-- 주민들 달려오는 연출
	local civil_start_pos = field:GetMarker('s10_civil_runaway_start_pos').position
	local get_civil_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('s10_civil_runaway_pos_' .. num).position end
	local civil_pos = { civil_start_pos, civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0 , -1),
	                    civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
	                    civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5) }
	local civil_anim = { 'idle', 'idle', 'cast', 'cast', 'idle', 'cast' }
	local civil_run_term = { 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.2, 0 }

	for i = 1, #civil do
		character_util.set_position(civil[i], civil_pos[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(civil[i], { name = 'scared' })
		civil[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	-- 지정한 경로로 도망치는 주민들
	local runaway_civil = self.get_plaza_civil(7)
	character_util.set_position(runaway_civil, civil_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5))
	character_util.set_emotion(runaway_civil, { name = 'scared' })

	local civil_waypoint = { { civil_pos[1] + vector(-10, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[1].x - 10, 0,
			get_civil_pos(1).z), get_civil_pos(1) },
	                         { civil_pos[2] + vector(-8, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[2].x - 8, 0,
			                         get_civil_pos(2).z), get_civil_pos(2) },
	                         { civil_pos[3] + vector(-8, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[3].x - 8, 0,
			                         get_civil_pos(3).z), get_civil_pos(3) },
	                         { civil_pos[4] + vector(-9, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[4].x - 9, 0,
			                         get_civil_pos(4).z), get_civil_pos(4) },
	                         { civil_pos[5] + vector(-10, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[5].x - 10, 0,
			                         get_civil_pos(5).z), get_civil_pos(5) },
	                         { civil_pos[6] + vector(-10, 0, 0), vector(civil_pos[6].x - 10, 0,
			                         get_civil_pos(6).z), get_civil_pos(6) } }
	for i = 1, #civil do
		local waypoint = civil_waypoint[i]
		wp_util.move(civil[i], waypoint, 9, nil, { last_direction = 'right', run = true, play_sfx = true,
		                                           callback = function(waypoint_index)
			                                           if waypoint_index + 1 == #waypoint then
				                                           character_util.shake(civil[i], 0.03, 9999)
				                                           character_util.remove_anim(civil[i])
				                                           character_util.set_anim(civil[i], { name = civil_anim[i], mix_duration = 0 })
			                                           end
		                                           end
		})
		wait_for_sec(civil_run_term[i])
	end
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local camera_pos = get_civil_pos(7)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(runaway_civil, get_civil_pos(7), 9, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })


	-- 주기적으로 랜덤하게 도망치는 시민 루틴
	local optimized_civil = {}
	local optimized_civil_count = 10
	local repeat_runaway = true

	for i = 1, optimized_civil_count do
		local civil = self.optimized_npcs['civil_' .. i]
		character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_active_state(civil, 'disabled')
		table.insert(optimized_civil, { npc = civil, runaway = false })
	end

	local rand_runaway_start_pos = { -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 }
	local rand_runaway_x_pos = { -5.5, -6, -6.5, -7, -7.5, -8, -8.5 }
	local rand_runaway_z_pos = { 23.5, 24, 29, 29.5 }
	local rand_runaway_end_x_pos = { -8, -8.5, -9, -9.5 }
	local rand_runaway_term = { 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.1 }

	start_coroutine(function()
		local civil_index = 1
		while repeat_runaway do
			while optimized_civil[civil_index].runaway do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not repeat_runaway then
				break
			end

			optimized_civil[civil_index].runaway = true
			local cur_index = civil_index
			local civil = optimized_civil[cur_index].npc
			local rand_x = rand_runaway_x_pos[random_util.get_random_int(1, #rand_runaway_x_pos)]
			local rand_z = rand_runaway_z_pos[random_util.get_random_int(1, #rand_runaway_z_pos)]
			local rand_end_x = rand_runaway_end_x_pos[random_util.get_random_int(1, #rand_runaway_end_x_pos)]

function local_class:get_blocking_way_move_target_pos(zone, dir)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local xz_adder = 0.3
	local target_pos = leader.Position

	if dir == 'left' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(leader.Position, zone.Bounds.min.x - (leader.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder))
	elseif dir == 'right' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(leader.Position, zone.Bounds.max.x + (leader.Bounds.extents.x + xz_adder))
	elseif dir == 'down' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position, zone.Bounds.min.z - (leader.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder))
	elseif dir == 'up' then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position, zone.Bounds.max.z + (leader.Bounds.extents.z + xz_adder))
	end

	return target_pos
end

function local_class:pond_npc_setting()
	local pond_civil_count = 10
	local is_ethereal_civil = { true, true, true, false, false, true, false, false, true, true, false, false }
	for i = 1, pond_civil_count do
		local civil = self.get_pond_civil(i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s10_pond_civil_pos_' .. i)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civil, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_position(civil, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(civil, marker.direction)
		character_util.shake(civil, 0.03, 99999)

		if is_ethereal_civil[i] then
			civil.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end

	local pond_monster_count = 9
	for i = 1, pond_monster_count do
		local monster = self.get_pond_monster(i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s10_battle_2_monster_pos_' .. i)
		character_util.set_position(monster, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')
	end

	local optimized_damaged_civil_count = 4
	for i = 1, optimized_damaged_civil_count do
		local civil = self.optimized_npcs['damaged_civil_' .. i]
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s10_damaged_civil_pos_' .. i)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civil, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_position(civil, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(civil, marker.direction)
	end

end

function local_class:shake_boss()

	while self.is_shake_boss do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_chain_02')
		character_util.shake(boss_zaboera, 0.1, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(3)
	end
end

-- 밀리는듯한 넉백
function local_class:ease_out_knockback(fo, end_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.set_position(fo, end_pos)
end

-- 맞고 날아가는 연출
function local_class:hit_and_throw(fo, end_pos, angle, height, duration, end_anim)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fo)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, angle, duration)
	character_util.jump(fo, height, duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(fo, end_pos, duration, nil)

	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)

	if end_anim then
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	end

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
end

function local_class:activate_dai_buff_effect()
	if self.manual_dai == nil then
		self.manual_dai = self.get_dai()
	end

	if self.dai_buff == nil then
		self.activate_dai_buff = true
		self.dai_buff = self.get_fx_dai_buff():Instantiate(self.manual_dai.Position)

		start_coroutine(function()
			while self.activate_dai_buff do
				self.dai_buff.transform.localPosition = self.manual_dai.Position
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			self.dai_buff:Dispose()
			self.dai_buff = nil
			self.manual_dai = nil
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_dai_buff_effect()
	self.activate_dai_buff = false
end

return local_class

function local_class:fade_sky_in_async(duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 - progress })

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 혹시 모르니 0000으로 초기화
	self.sky_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })

	-- 더 이상 렌더링 하지 않도록 비활성화
	self.sky_tint_obj:SetActive(false)
end

return local_class

	self:preset_npcs()

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_farmer(), self.controller)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

	--마커는 다음 균열에게.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_key, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_maid_crack'))
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_farmer(), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_swindler(), self.controller)

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()

		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
	end

	self.dynamic_npcs = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.maid_fight_grid_name) then
		self.in_maid_fight_grid = true

		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_maid_fight_1 then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1

			start_coroutine(self.maid_fight_1_scene, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.maid_fight_grid_name) then
		self.in_maid_fight_grid = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_maid_fight_done') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_maid_fight_2

		--이후, 오른쪽 그리드 통해서 2층으로 진입하게 되면,
		self:set_maid_fight_end()

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_maid_fight_2 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_maid_fight_2') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_meet_maid

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.maid_fight_2_scene, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_maid and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_meet_maid') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_maid

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_maid_scene, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_farmer and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_enter_farm') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.farmer_promoting

		start_coroutine(self.farmer_promotion_routine, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.farmer_promoting and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_try_exit_farm') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_farmer

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_farmer_scene, self, false)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_swindler then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_meet_swindler_top') then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_swindler

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_swindler_scene, self, true)

			return true

		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_meet_swindler_right') then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_swindler

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_swindler_scene, self, false)

			return true
		end
	end

	if not self.seen_crack_villager and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s2_crack_villagers') then
		self.seen_crack_villager = true

		start_coroutine(self.crack_villager_nonstop_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.farmer_promoting and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_farmer()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_farmer
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_farmer_scene, self, true)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_talk_with_swindler and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_swindler()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_with_swindler
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.talk_with_swindler_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:maid_fight_1_scene()
	local goblin_1 = self.dynamic_npcs.maid_fight_goblin_1
	local goblin_2 = self.dynamic_npcs.maid_fight_goblin_2

	local maid = self.get_maid()

	local custom_wait_for_sec = function(duration)
		local start_time = unity_class.time.time

		while not self.controller.stage_ended and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 and
				unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--고블린들이 에이미에게 맞아 2층에서 1층으로 던져진다.

	--날아가기 전까지 고블린들은 up으로 shake 하고 있는 상태.
	character_util.shake(goblin_1, 0.03, 99999)
	character_util.shake(goblin_2, 0.03, 99999)

	custom_wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	local fly_routine = function(character, target_pos)
		local speed = 10
		local max_height = 3
		local start_pos = character.Position
		local duration = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
		local time_passed = 0

		--날아오기 시작하면서 shake는 멈춘다.
		character_util.stop_shake(character)

		-- 같은 카메라 그리드 안에 있을 때에만 발동시킴
		if self.in_maid_fight_grid then
			--고블린 맞을 때 마다 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초 세기 0.05
			-- 카메라 그리드 넘어가는동안 shake가 지속되는 것을 막기 위해 unscaledTime 옵션을 켜줌
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3, true)
		end

		--피격시, lasthit 이펙트
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0.3))

		--고블린들 피격 이펙트
		character_util.set_direction(character, target_pos.x < start_pos.x and 'right' or 'left')

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(character)

		--고블린 피격 사운드
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(character, 'prostrate',{ mix_duration = duration / 2 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', loop = false, parent = character,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_die_goblin_01', loop = false, parent = character,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(character, 'damaged')

		character_util.spine_rotate(character, target_pos.x < start_pos.x and 1080 or -1080, duration)

		--고블린 에어 스핀
		local air_spin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_02', parent = character,
													  loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', })

		while not self.controller.stage_ended and
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 and time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local height = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * max_height
			local xz_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

			character_util.set_position(character, xz_pos + vector(0, height, 0))

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		-- 이미 프로그래스가 변경된 것이므로 바닥 충돌 관련 연출은 패스
		if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
			air_spin_sfx:Stop()
			return
		end

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(character)

		character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(character, target_pos)

		air_spin_sfx:Stop()
	end

	local hit_delay = 0.4

	--에이미 표정은 frenzy_attack, twohand_attack2로 한번에 공격해서 날린다.
	--에이미가 무기 휘두르는 사운드
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(maid, 'twohand_attack2', { sfx_name = '02_bath_slash_01', remove_after = 0.8 })

	custom_wait_for_sec(hit_delay)

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	--두번 공격해서 하나씩 각각 날린다.
	start_coroutine(fly_routine, goblin_1, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_goblin_1_fall'))

	character_util.normal_jump(goblin_2)
	custom_wait_for_sec(0.4)

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	local goblin_move_duration = 1
	local maid_move_start_delay = 0.2

	local goblin_move_target_pos = goblin_2.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move(goblin_2, goblin_move_target_pos,
			nil, goblin_move_duration, { run = true })

	custom_wait_for_sec(maid_move_start_delay)

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(maid, goblin_move_target_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
			nil, goblin_move_duration - maid_move_start_delay - hit_delay, { run = true })

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(maid, 'down')
	--에이미가 무기 휘두르는 사운드
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(maid, 'twohand_attack2', { sfx_name = '02_bath_slash_01', remove_after = 0.8 })

	custom_wait_for_sec(hit_delay)

	if self.controller.stage_ended or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_maid_fight_1 then
		return
	end

	character_util.stop(goblin_2)
	fly_routine(goblin_2, field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_goblin_2_fall'))
end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(goblin_4, {

		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_maid_wp_2'),

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maid, 'frenzy_attack')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--에이미가 그 뒤를 쫓아간다.
	local exit_x_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_maid_wp_1').x

	--이벤트 끝나면 에이미는 위쪽 길로 사라진다.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maid, {
		vector_util.get_0yz(maid.Position, exit_x_center),

		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_maid_wp_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_maid_fight_maid_wp_3'),

function local_class:meet_maid_scene()
	local maid = self.get_maid()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)

	--방 진입하면 존 엔터 이벤트로 진행.
	--에이미 대사하는 동안 다이 일행 정렬.
	local members = {
		dai,
		popp,
		maam,
		hyunckel,
		gome,
		leona
	}
	--이벤트 시작과 함께 bgm 볼륨 0.5로 조절, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--이 동안 다이 일행 정렬
	local party_align_wp_key = 'main_s2_meet_maid_party_align'
	local crack_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_maid_crack')

	for i = 1, #members do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(members[i],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_maid_' .. members[i].Name),
				3.5, nil, self, party_align_wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	--카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐서 균열로 이동.
	--이 동안 다이 일행 정렬
	camera_util.move_async(crack_pos, 1)

	--카메라 포커스 1초동안 유지
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후, 현재 포커스 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(maid.Position, 0.5)

	character_util.hide_weapon(maid, true)

	--에이미(up, idle) : 이… 이게 돌프가 말했던 균열…
	--에이미 대사와 함께 한번 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_1')

	--에이미(up, idle) : 가… 가서… 말… 말해줘야…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_2')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_wp_key)

	--포프가 에이미 등 뒤로 다가간다.
	character_util.move_to_async(popp, maid.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 1.5, true, true)

	--포프 : 저기…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_3')

	local camera_move_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local focus_maid_duration = 0.5
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, focus_maid_duration)
	camera_util.move(maid.Position, focus_maid_duration)

	--에이미(up, idle, shake 0.3초) : 하…
	character_util.hide_weapon(maid, false)
	scene_util.shake(maid, 0.03, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_4',
			true, { auto_layout = true })

	while unity_class.time.time - camera_move_start_time < focus_maid_duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--에이미(down, frenzy_attack) : 이 더러운 고블린…

			true, { auto_layout = true })

	--포프(idle, jump 1회) : 히익!

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump(popp, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(gome, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_6',
			true, { auto_layout = true })

			4, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_7')

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_7_1')
	character_util.remove_anim(maid)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_7_2')

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_7_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(maid)

	--말끝나면 오른쪽으로 뛰어서 퇴장한다.
	local maid_wp_key = 'main_s2_meet_maid_wp'

function local_class:farmer_promotion_routine()
	--좌측 존 진입하면, 농장직원 대사.
	local farmer = self.get_farmer()

	--플레이어가 우측 존으로 나가거나, 좌측 존으로 나가기 전까지 반복 대사.
	while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.farmer_promoting and not self.controller.stage_ended do
		--농장직원(down, smile, cast) : 귀여운 슬라임! 밍키를 만나보세요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event',
									 player_priority = 'npc', parent = farmer })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_18', false)
	end
end

function local_class:align_party(marker_name, duration, last_direction)
	local min_speed = 1
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local align_wp_key = 'main_s2_party_align'

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name .. member.Name)
		local move_speed = math.max((member.Position - target_pos).magnitude / duration, min_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, move_speed, nil, self, align_wp_key, {
			last_direction = last_direction
		})
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_wp_key)

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end
