function local_class:crack_villager_nonstop_scene()
	local villager_1 = self.get_crack_villager(1)
	local villager_2 = self.get_crack_villager(2)
	local villager_3 = self.get_crack_villager(3)

	--시1(right, tired, cross_arm) : 이게 그 균열이지?
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(villager_1, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villager_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_13', false)

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(villager_1)

	--시2(left, scared, cast) : 가까이서 보니까 더 불길한 기분이야.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villager_2, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villager_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_14', false)

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	--시3(left, tired, bomb_idle) : 도대체 세상이 어떻게 되려는건지…
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villager_3, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villager_3, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_15', false)

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	--이후 위 대사 그대로 원라인으로 존재.
	villager_1.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_13'
	villager_2.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_14'
	villager_3.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s2_oneline_15'
end

function local_class:stop_crack_villagers()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_crack_villager(1))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_crack_villager(2))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_crack_villager(3))
end

function local_class:meet_swindler_scene(is_top_entered)
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	local maid = self.get_maid()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()

	local villagers = {
		self.get_swindler_villager(1),
		self.get_swindler_villager(2),
		self.get_swindler_villager(3),
		self.get_swindler_villager(4),
		self.get_swindler_villager(5),
		self.get_swindler_villager(6),
		self.get_swindler_villager(7),
		self.get_swindler_villager(8),
		self.get_swindler_villager(9),
		self.get_swindler_villager(10),
	}

	--이벤트 시작하면 bgm 볼륨 0.5로 조절, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 돌프 단상으로 포커스 이동.
	local swindler_speech_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_swindler_speech')
	camera_util.move(swindler_speech_pos, 1)

	--동시에 다이 일행 정렬(위냐 오른쪽이냐에 따라서 배치에 차이.)
	if is_top_entered then
		self:align_party('main_s2_meet_swindler_top_', 1, 'down')
	else
		self:align_party('main_s2_meet_swindler_right_', 1, 'left')
	end

	--시 : 마을 사람들
	--홀수 : civilian_male
	--짝수 : civilian_female
	--꼬 : 꼬마 아이(kid_girl2)

	character_util.hide_weapon(maid, true)
	character_util.hide_weapon(swindler, true)

	--에이미 대사 시작과 함께 루프 사운드 시작, 믹스 0초
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_drum_roll_01', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', mix = 0 })

	--에이미(left,idle, idle) : 매지컬 왕국의… 궁정 마법사…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_26')

	--에이미(tired, idle) : 모… 모든 의뢰를 해결해내는 S급 용병…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maid, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_27')
	character_util.remove_emotion(maid)

	--에이미(idle, cast) : 티… 티탄 왕국의 포로들을 풀어준 해방자…이자…  캔터베리 가디언의 진정한 맹우…
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_27_1')
	character_util.remove_anim(maid)

	--에이미(attack, idle, jump 1회) : 위, 위대한 마법사!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maid, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(maid, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_27_2')
	character_util.remove_emotion(maid)

	--에이미(idle, bomb_idle) : 도… 돌프님이십니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_spotlight_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_28')
	character_util.remove_anim(maid)

	--위와 함께 루프 사운드 페이드아웃, 믹스 0초
	loop_sfx:Stop()

	--마을 사람들 환호한다.
	--나머지 NPC들 다 clap / 표정 smile, awesome, idle 섞어서

	--smile -> 7, 5, 1, 10
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[1], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[5], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[7], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[10], 'smile')

	--awesome -> 3, 9
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[3], 'awesome')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[9], 'awesome')

	--love -> 4
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[4], 'love')

	--clap -> 1, 3, 6, 9
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[1], 'clap')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[3], 'clap')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[6], 'clap')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[9], 'clap')

	--success ->7, 2
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[2], 'success')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[7], 'success')

	--sing -> 4
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[4], 'sing')

	--사람들 환호성  시작하면 한번 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_03')

	--마을 사람들 환호 대사 하면서
	wait_all({
		--civilian_male(left, smile, success) : (shout 말풍선)와아아!
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_shout_speech_async, villagers[7],
				'short_story_dai_main_s2_28_1', nil, { bubble_direction = 'rt' }),

		--civilian_female(down, love, clap) : 위대한 마법사님! 멋있어요!
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, villagers[4],
				'short_story_dai_main_s2_28_2', nil, { bubble_direction = 'lb' }),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			--돌프 단상 위로 점프해 올라선다.
			local swindler_jump_wp_key = 'main_s2_meet_swindler_swindler_jump'
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(swindler, swindler_speech_pos, nil, 0.5,
					self, swindler_jump_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
			--get 자세로 점프
			character_util.mario_jump_async(swindler, 'right', 0.5, 0.7)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, swindler_jump_wp_key)

			--돌프 dealwithit, clap,
			scene_util.set_emotion_non_loop(swindler, 'dealwithit')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(swindler, 'clap')

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maid, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast2')

			--그 동안 에이미는 꽃(스프라이트)을 돌프에게 던져준다.
			--참고 연출
			local flower_drop_offsets = {
				vector(0.15, 0, 0.1),
				vector(-0.15, 0, -0.1),
				vector(0.1, 0, -0.15),
				vector(-0.1, 0, 0.15),
			}

			local flower_item_id = 20002

			local flower_item_disappeared_count = 0

			--0.3초 간격으로 총 4개.
			for i = 1, #flower_drop_offsets do

				-- 어차피 코루틴 돌릴거 그냥 아이템별로 묶어서 돌림
				start_coroutine(function()
					local drop_pos = swindler.Position + flower_drop_offsets[i]

					local flower_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
						itemid = flower_item_id, notforinven = true,
						pos = maid.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
						lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
					})

					flower_item.Position = maid.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

					--이동 속도는 각 0.7초.
					drop_item_util.move_item_async(flower_item, drop_pos, {
						duration = 0.7, angle = -720, is_fly = false, y_move = function(progress)
							return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 1.5
						end
					})

					drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(flower_item, 0, 0.5)

					drop_item_util.dispose_item(flower_item)

					flower_item_disappeared_count = flower_item_disappeared_count + 1
				end)

				wait_for_sec(0.4)
			end

			-- 마지막 아이템이 사라질 때까지 대기
			while flower_item_disappeared_count < #flower_drop_offsets do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maid)
		end)
	})

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(villagers)

	--돌프(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 모든 마법을 통달한 위대한 마법사! 돌프라고 하오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(swindler, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_29')
	character_util.remove_anim(swindler)

	--돌프(left, idle, idle) : 본래 이곳에 온 이유는 이 균열을 조사하기 위해서였소.
	scene_util.set_direction(swindler, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_32')

	--다이 표정 attack, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(dai, true)

	--카메라 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동하여 균열 보여주고,
	--카메라가 균열 쪽으로 움직이기 시작하면 한번 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	local swindler_speech_camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_swindler_crack'),
			0.7, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	--1초 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(swindler_speech_camera_pos, 0.5, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(dai)

	scene_util.set_direction(swindler, 'right')

	--시민4(attack, idle, jump2회) : 다 저 균열이 문제예요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[4], 'attack')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local villager = villagers[4]

			character_util.normal_jump_async(villager, true)
			character_util.cancel_jump(villager)
			character_util.normal_jump_async(villager, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, villagers[4], 'short_story_dai_main_s2_32_1')
	})

	character_util.remove_emotion(villagers[4])

	--시민7(tired, idle) : 맞아, 저 균열이 생긴 뒤로 고블린들도 더 난폭해졌어.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[7], 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villagers[7], 'short_story_dai_main_s2_32_2')
	character_util.remove_emotion(villagers[7])

	--시민7 대사와 함께 루프재생 시작, 믹스 디폴트
	local loop_sfx_1 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	--꼬마(scared, cast) : 숲에서 이상하게 생긴 괴물도 봤어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[10], 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(villagers[10], 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villagers[10], 'short_story_dai_main_s2_32_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(villagers[10])

	--nod 고개 숙인채로 유지
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(swindler, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(swindler, 'nod')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	swindler.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

	--돌프(right,sleep_deep, nod) : 이 균열 때문에 문제들이 많다는 것 잘 알고 있소.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_33')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)
	swindler.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

	--돌프(attack, release) : 이 위대한 마법사 돌프가! 그 문제들을 모두 해결해주겠소!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(swindler, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(swindler, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_34')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)

	--위와 함께 루프 사운드 종료, 믹스 디폴트
	loop_sfx_1:Stop()

	--돌프(doyagao, clap) : 자, 자, 오늘같은 기회는 다시 오지 않으니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(swindler, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(swindler, 'clap')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_34_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	--돌프(down, idle, bomb_idle) : 문제가 있는 자들은 나에게!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(swindler, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_35')
	character_util.remove_anim(swindler)

	--돌프(attack, bomb_idle, jump 1회) : 위대한 마법사 돌프에게 오시오!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(swindler, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(swindler, 'cast2')
	character_util.normal_jump(swindler)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_35_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)

	--에이미(tired, cast) : 돌… 아, 아니.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maid, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_36')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maid)

	--에이미(idle, cast) : 주인님과 상담을 하고 싶으신 분은…
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(maid, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_37')

	--에이미(idle, idle) : 저에게 10… 10골드를…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_38')

	--표정을 attack, smile, idle 섞어서 배치.
	--smile -> 9, 10, 4, 3
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[3], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[4], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[9], 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[10], 'smile')

	--attack -> 2, 7, 5
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[2], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[7], 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(villagers[5], 'attack')

	--마을사람들이 전체적으로 1칸 더 돌프 쪽으로 다가온다.
	local villagers_wp_key = 'main_s2_meet_swindler_villagers'
	for i = 1, #villagers do
		local villager = villagers[i]
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(
				'main_s2_meet_swindler_villager_' .. i .. '_approach')
		local look_dir = villager.Direction
		character_util.set_locked_dir(villager, look_dir)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(villager, target_pos, 1, nil, self, villagers_wp_key, {
			last_direction = look_dir
		})
	end

	--사람들 돌프에게 모여들기 시작하면 루프재생 시작, 믹스 디폴트
	local loop_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	--시민9 : 저요! 제가 제일 먼저 왔어요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(villagers[9], 'short_story_dai_main_s2_39')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, villagers_wp_key)

	for i = 1, #villagers do
		local villager = villagers[i]

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(villager)
	end

	--에이미(up, release) : 이… 이쪽으로 주… 줄 서주세요…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.set_direction(maid, 'up')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(maid)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maid, 'short_story_dai_main_s2_39_1')
	character_util.remove_anim(maid)

	character_util.set_direction(swindler, 'up')

	--마을 사람들 에이미 앞으로 줄을 선다.
	local get_villager_align_pos = function(index)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_swindler_villager_' .. index .. '_align')
	end

	local get_villager_start_pos = function(index)
		return villagers[index].Position
	end

	local villager_turn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s2_meet_swindler_villager_align_turn')
	local villager_default_speed = 4
	local villager_align_info = {
		{
			waypoints = nil,
			emotion = 'smile',
		},
		{
			waypoints = nil,
		},
		{
			waypoints = {
				get_villager_align_pos(3)
			},
		},
		{
			--시4(down, smile, success)
			waypoints = {
				get_villager_align_pos(4)
			},
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'cast',
		},
		{
			--시5(down, smile, idle)
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(5).x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(5).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(5)
			},
			emotion = 'smile',
		},
		{
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(6).x, 0, villager_turn_pos.z),
				villager_turn_pos,
				vector(villager_turn_pos.x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(6).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(6)
			},
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'cast',
			speed = villager_default_speed - 0.2
		},
		{
			--시7(down, tired, bomb_idle)
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(7).x, 0, villager_turn_pos.z),
				villager_turn_pos,
				vector(villager_turn_pos.x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(7).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(7)
			},
			emotion = 'tired',
			anim = 'bomb_idle',
			speed = villager_default_speed - 0.2
		},
		{
			--시8(down, tired, idle)
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(8).x, 0, villager_turn_pos.z),
				villager_turn_pos,
				vector(villager_turn_pos.x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(8).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(8)
			},
			emotion = 'tired',
			speed = villager_default_speed - 0.2
		},
		{
			--시9(down, tired, idle)
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(9).x, 0, villager_turn_pos.z),
				villager_turn_pos,
				vector(villager_turn_pos.x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(9).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(9)
			},
			emotion = 'tired',
			speed = villager_default_speed - 1
		},
		{
			--꼬마(down, smile, cast)
			waypoints = {
				vector(get_villager_start_pos(10).x, 0, villager_turn_pos.z),
				villager_turn_pos,
				vector(villager_turn_pos.x, 0, get_villager_align_pos(10).z),
				get_villager_align_pos(10)
			},
			anim = 'cast',
		},
	}

	--사람들 에이미 앞으로 줄서기 시작하면 한번 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	for i = 1, #villagers do
		local villager = villagers[i]
		local info = villager_align_info[i]

		if info.waypoints == nil then

			character_util.set_direction(villager, 'down')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FugitiveStateChangedEvent), 'on_fugitive_state_change_event')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FugitiveStateChangedEvent))

	local pickpocket = self.get_pickpocket()
	local dai = self.get_dai()

			start_coroutine(function()
				self.is_blocker_coroutine_start = true
				while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.blocker_zone_event and not self.is_disposed do
					--빨간원(down,idle,cast) : 오늘은 뭘 사갈까나? (쿨타임 5초)

					wait_for_sec(5)

					-- 인터렉트 이후 탈출
					if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.blocker_interact_event or self.is_disposed then
						character_util.remove_anim(blocker)
						return

				end
			end)
		end

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_event_zone_3') and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.pick_pocket_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pick_pocket_event, self)

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_event_zone_4') and self.pickpocket_guard_enter_flag_1 and
			self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.pick_pocket_3 then
		self.pickpocket_guard_enter_flag_1 = false
		start_coroutine(function()
			while self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 and not self.is_disposed do
				--시장 아줌마는 3타일거리안에 접근할 시 자동으로 대사가 출력된다.
				--B의 시장아줌마 (up,idle,idle) : 어떤게 좋을까…?
				local pickpocket_guard_1 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(1)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pickpocket_guard_1, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_42', skip = false })
				wait_for_sec(5)

				if not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 or self.is_disposed then
					character_util.remove_anim(pickpocket_guard_1)
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_event_zone_5') and self.pickpocket_guard_enter_flag_2 and
			self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.pick_pocket_3 then
		self.pickpocket_guard_enter_flag_2 = false
		start_coroutine(function()
			while self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 and not self.is_disposed do
				--시장 아줌마는 3타일거리안에 접근할 시 자동으로 대사가 출력된다.
				--A의 시장아줌마 (down,idle,cast) : 전부 예뻐 보이잖아!
				local pickpocket_guard_2 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(2)
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(pickpocket_guard_2, 'cast')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pickpocket_guard_2, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_43', skip = false })
				character_util.remove_anim(pickpocket_guard_2)
				wait_for_sec(5)

				if not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 or self.is_disposed then
					character_util.remove_anim(pickpocket_guard_2)
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, pickpocket, 's3_pickpocket_away_zone_1') then
		self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_1 = true
		if self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_1 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_run and
				not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 and not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.catch_pickpocket, self, 1)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, pickpocket, 's3_pickpocket_away_zone_2') then
		self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_2 = true
		if self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_2 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_run and
				not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 and not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.catch_pickpocket, self, 2)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_event_zone_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_3 and not self.is_zone_enter then
		self.is_zone_enter = true
		--다이(left,attack,idle): 고메를 되찾아야 해! 오른쪽으로 0.5칸 이동
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_37')

			local dai_wp_right = vector(54.5, 0, dai.Position.z)

			wp_util.move_async(dai, dai_wp_right, 3, nil, { run = false })

			character_util.remove_emotion(dai)
			self.is_zone_enter = false
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_event_zone_6') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_3 and not self.is_zone_enter then
		self.is_zone_enter = true
		--다이(right,attack,idle): 고메를 되찾아야 해! 왼쪽으로 0.5칸 이동
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_37')

			local dai_wp_left = vector(59.5, 0, dai.Position.z)

			wp_util.move_async(dai, dai_wp_left, 3, nil, { run = false })
			character_util.remove_emotion(dai)
			self.is_zone_enter = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local blocker_npc_1 = self.get_blocker_npc(1)
	local pickpocket_guard_1 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(1)
	local pickpocket_guard_2 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(2)
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, blocker_npc_1) and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.blocker_interact_event then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.blocker_interact_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.blocker_interact, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pickpocket_guard_1) and self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_3
		self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pickpocket_guard_interact, self, 1)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pickpocket_guard_2) and self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_3
		self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pickpocket_guard_interact, self, 2)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, princess) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_run then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.done
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pick_pocket_ending, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fugitive_state_change_event(e)
	local pickpocket = self.get_pickpocket()

	-- FIXME : FugitiveCharacterController 리펙토링 브랜치 옮겨올 시 해당 로직만 삭제 요망
	if e.StateType == CS.Oak.FugitiveStateType.Watch then
		local bomber = e.Character
		-- 0.5 Unit 기준으로 반올림
		local doubled_pos = bomber.Position * 2
		local rounded_pos = vector(
				unity_class.mathf.Round(doubled_pos.x),
				unity_class.mathf.Round(doubled_pos.y),
				unity_class.mathf.Round(doubled_pos.z)
		) / 2

		bomber.Position = rounded_pos

		if self.pick_pocket_dash_sound ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.pick_pocket_dash_sound)
		end

		return true

	elseif e.StateType == CS.Oak.FugitiveStateType.Dodge then
		self.pick_pocket_dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = pickpocket, max_distance = 10,
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
		})
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local pickpocket = self.get_pickpocket()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, pickpocket, 's3_pickpocket_away_zone_1') then
		self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_1 = false
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, pickpocket, 's3_pickpocket_away_zone_2') then
		self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_2 = false
	end
end

function local_class:blocker_interact()
	local blocker_npc_1 = self.get_blocker_npc(1)

	party_util.align_to_target(blocker_npc_1, 'up', 1, 'arc')

	--동시에 공주와 로레인 이벤트 재생

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(blocker_npc_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_5')

		{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_6', 'mercy' },
		--시장이 어딘지 묻는다. (노랑)
		{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_7', 'intellect' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--길을 비켜달라고 한다.
		--다이(down,smile,idle): 잠깐 지나가도 될까요?
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_8')

		--아줌마(up,idle)(jump1회) : 아이코, 나도 참 주책이야!
		character_util.normal_jump_async(blocker_npc_1, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(blocker_npc_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_9')
		character_util.remove_anim(blocker_npc_1)

		--아줌마가 오른쪽으로 이동
		wp_util.move_async(blocker_npc_1,
				blocker_npc_1.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

		--아줌마(left,idle,sing) : 미안해, 젊은친구들~
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(blocker_npc_1, 'sing')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(blocker_npc_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_10')
		character_util.remove_anim(blocker_npc_1)

		--아줌마(left,idle,sing): 오늘 우리 자매들 모임 날이라 조금 들떠있었네~호호!
		scene_util.set_direction(blocker_npc_1, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(blocker_npc_1, 'sing')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(blocker_npc_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_13_1')
		character_util.remove_anim(blocker_npc_1)

	elseif choose_result == 2 then

		--다이(down,smile,idle): 혹시 시장이 어느 쪽인지 아시나요?
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_11')

		--아줌마(down,idle,release) : 저 쪽으로 가면 된단다!
		scene_util.set_release_anim(blocker_npc_1)

	scene_util.set_direction(blocker_npc_1, 'down', true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(blocker_npc_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_14')
	character_util.remove_emotion(dai)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.get_block_wall(i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	end

	--get_field_object('pickpocket_wall_2').Position = self.get_pickpocket_guard_marker(2, 1)

	--다이일행 그대로 공주앞까지 이동 다이(right,attack,eat) 나머지 일행(right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')

	local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = dai,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'eat')

	character_util.set_group_emotion({ leona, maam, hyunckel, popp }, { name = 'idle' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--다이(right,attack,idle)(jump1회) 공주 마리오점프로 기상 (left,idle,idle)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sound)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(princess, 'left', 0.5, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(dai)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다이(right,smile,release): 꼬마야, 괜찮니?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(dai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_30')
	character_util.remove_anim(dai)

	--꼬마공주(left,smile,idle): 응! 다친 곳은 없어!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'smile')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_31')

	--포프(right,attack,release): 다이! 이럴 때가 아냐,빨리 고메를 구해야지!
	--이때 다이(left,attack,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(popp, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_32')
	character_util.remove_anim(popp)

	--공주(left,idle,cast): 방금 그 사람을 쫓고 있는 거야?
	--이때 다이(right,idle,idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(dai)
	scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_33')

	--다이(right,attack,cast) : 응! 내 소중한 친구를 납치해 갔거든!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'cast')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_34')

	--공주(left,attack,idle): 소중한 친구를 납치했다고?!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'idle')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, '01_player_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_35')

	--공주(left,attack,cast) : 그런거라면 나도 도울게!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'cast')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_36')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	local princess_move_key = 'main_s3_princess_move'

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, {
		self.get_princess_marker(2, 3)
	}, 6, nil, self, princess_move_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel })
	character_util.set_group_direction({ dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel }, 'down')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(gome, 'right')

	--컨트롤이 풀린다.
	--공주 2번위치 도착하면 (right,attack,eat) 원라인 대사 : 뭔가… 도울 방법이…
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, princess_move_key)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'eat')

	self.princess_eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = princess, max_distance = 3,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})

	princess.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_41'

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, pickpocket, true)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_3
	--컨트롤 풀림
end

function local_class:pickpocket_guard_interact(idx)
	local pickpocket_guard_1 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(1)
	local pickpocket_guard_2 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(2)

	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	local dai_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel }

	--해당 시장아줌마에게 말을 걸면 표기한대로 파티원이 정렬되고 대화가 출력된다.
	if idx == 1 then
		local party_align_key = 'main_s3_princess_move'

		for i = 1, 5 do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai_party[i], {
				self.get_party_align_marker(2, i)
			}, 4, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pickpocket_guard_1)

		--	A(right,idle,idle) : 어머머, 무슨일이니?
		character_util.remove_anim(pickpocket_guard_1)
		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_1, 'down', true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_46')

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 저도 그 물건좀 봐도 될까요? (초록)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_49', 'mercy' },
			-- 아무일도 아니에요.(노랑)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_50', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--A(right,idle,idle)(jump1회): 어머! 미안해, 물건에 정신이 팔려서~
			scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_1, 'down', true)
			character_util.normal_jump_async(pickpocket_guard_1, '01_jump_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_51')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pickpocket_guard_1)

			--A1 -> A2로 위치이동
			wp_util.move_async(pickpocket_guard_1, {
				pickpocket_guard_1.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				pickpocket_guard_1.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1.5),
				self.get_pickpocket_guard_marker(1, 2)
			}, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

			--A(right,idle,idle) 원라인 : 미안해, 젊은 친구들~
			pickpocket_guard_1.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_54'

			--region 소매치기 도망 루트 막기 용 wall_invisible 위치 세팅

			--FugitiveCharacterController 기능 상 npc 로 길을 막아도 막는걸로 인지 하지만, 정확한 충돌 후 넉백 처리 때문에
			--길 막는 npc 위치에 wall_invisible을 배치 했으나, 액팅 기획 상 충돌하는 경우가 존재 하지 않기 때문에 주석 처리함
			--예상과 다른 경로로 도망쳐서 블로킹 이슈가 생길 수 있으므로 코드 복구 가능성 있음
			--get_field_object('pickpocket_wall_1').Position = self.get_pickpocket_guard_marker(1, 2)

			--endregion
			character_util.remove_relate_event(pickpocket_guard_1, self.controller)

			-- 소매치기 도망 연출 시작 스테이트
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_run

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--A(right,idle,idle)(jump1회): 시장 구경 재밌게 하렴!
			scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_1, 'down', true)
			character_util.normal_jump_async(pickpocket_guard_1, '01_jump_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_53')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pickpocket_guard_1)

			self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 = true
		end
	elseif idx == 2 then
		local party_align_key = 'main_s3_princess_move'

		for i = 1, 5 do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai_party[i], {
				self.get_party_align_marker(2, i + 5)
			}, 4, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key)

		--B(down,idle,idle): 응? 왜그러니?
		character_util.remove_anim(pickpocket_guard_2)
		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_2, 'down', true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_55')

		--이 후 다시 말걸면 선택지부터 나온다.
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--잠시 비켜주실래요?(초록)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_58', 'mercy' },
			--아무일도 아니에요. (흰색)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s3_59', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--B(down,idle,sing)(jump1회) : 귀여운 아이들 부탁인데 그정도는 들어줘야지!
			character_util.normal_jump_async(pickpocket_guard_2, '01_jump_01')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(pickpocket_guard_2, 'sing')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_62')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pickpocket_guard_2)

			--B1 -> B2로 위치이동
			wp_util.move_async(pickpocket_guard_2, {
				pickpocket_guard_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				self.get_pickpocket_guard_marker(2, 2)
			}, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'down' })

			--B(down,idle,idle) 원라인 : 호호, 아직도 고민되네~
			pickpocket_guard_2.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_63'

			--region 소매치기 도망 루트 막기 용 wall_invisible 위치 세팅

			--FugitiveCharacterController 기능 상 npc 로 길을 막아도 막는걸로 인지 하지만, 정확한 충돌 후 넉백 처리 때문에
			--길 막는 npc 위치에 wall_invisible을 배치 했으나, 액팅 기획 상 충돌하는 경우가 존재 하지 않기 때문에 주석 처리함
			--예상과 다른 경로로 도망쳐서 블로킹 이슈가 생길 수 있으므로 코드 복구 가능성 있음
			--get_field_object('pickpocket_wall_2').Position = self.get_pickpocket_guard_marker(2, 2)

			--endregion

			character_util.remove_relate_event(pickpocket_guard_2, self.controller)

			-- 소매치기 도망 연출 시작 스테이트
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.pick_pocket_run

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--B(down,idle,sing): 여기 과일이 참 달단다~!
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(pickpocket_guard_2, 'sing')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_60')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pickpocket_guard_2)

			self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 = true
		end
	end

	if self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_1 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_run and
			not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 and not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 then
		self:catch_pickpocket(1)
	elseif self.enter_pickpocket_away_zone_2 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.pick_pocket_run and
		not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_1 and not self.pickpocket_guard_interact_flag_2 then
		self:catch_pickpocket(2)
	end
end

function local_class:catch_pickpocket(idx)
	local pickpocket = self.get_pickpocket()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local pickpocket_guard_1 = self.get_pickpocket_guard(1)

	pickpocket.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	-- dash 사운드가 남아있다면 꺼줌
	if self.pick_pocket_dash_sound ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.pick_pocket_dash_sound)
	end

	--꼬마공주 (노란원)(left,smile,cast) -> (left,attack,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'idle')

	-- 다이(attack)(jump1회)
	character_util.look_at(dai, pickpocket)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(dai, '01_jump_01')

	--다이(attack) 표정 : shout 말풍선 : 이제 그만 고메를 돌려줘! 이 납치범!!!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'attack')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_63_1')

	if idx == 1 then
		local npc = get_character('s3_oneline_npc_13')
		--카메라 도둑에게 이동
		camera_util.move_async(pickpocket.Position, 1, { end_target = pickpocket })

		--A (right,mad,idle): 뭐라고?! 납치범!!!
		--이 때 소매치기(left,scared,idle)(jump1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket, 'scared')
		character_util.normal_jump(pickpocket, '01_player_jump_01')

		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_1, 'right', true)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket_guard_1, 'mad')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pickpocket_guard_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_63_2')

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function()
				--3(up,attack,idle): 납치범이라고요?!
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'up', true)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'attack')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc, 'short_story_dai_main_s3_63_3')
			end),
			util.cs_generator(function()
				--이 때 소매치기(down,scared,idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket, 'down', false)

				--이 때 A오른쪽으로 이동
				wp_util.move_async(pickpocket_guard_1, {
					pickpocket_guard_1.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
				}, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
			end)
		})
		wp_util.move(npc, {
			npc.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		}, 2, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

		--소매치기 (left)0.5초 (down)0.5초 (right)0.5초
		scene_util.look_around(pickpocket, { 'left', 'down', 'right' }, nil, 0.5)

		--소매치기 (down,attack,idle)(shake0.03) 1초
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket, 'down', false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(pickpocket, 0.03, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--소매치기 (mad)표정 변화 shout 말풍선 : 저리 비켜!
		--이 때 A(right,attack,idle)(jump1회)
		character_util.normal_jump(pickpocket_guard_1, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket_guard_1, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket, 'mad')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pickpocket,
				{ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s3_63_4', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		--소매치기는 멈추지 않고 그대로 경로대로 이동
		wp_util.move_async(pickpocket, {
			pickpocket.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
		}, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'right', true)

		--소매치기 S위치일 때 3번 빨간틴트+바운스 fx_hit 출력 왼쪽으로 1칸 제자리로 밀린다.
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(npc.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))

		--이 때 3(right,damaged,damaged) 0.5초 후 다시 (right,tired,idle) 잡는 연출 끝나면 다시 (right,smile,idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'damaged')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
		character_util.move_to(npc, npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 4, false, false)

		wp_util.move_async(pickpocket, {
			pickpocket.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			pickpocket.Position + vector(-1.2, 0, -1)
		}, 7, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		sp_util.sine_move(pickpocket, {
			from = pickpocket.Position,
			to = pickpocket.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			duration = 0.5,
			height = 2
		})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		wp_util.move_async(pickpocket, {
			self.get_pickpocket_marker(8),
			self.get_pickpocket_marker(9),
			self.get_pickpocket_marker(10) + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		}, 7, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

		--경로 도착하면 (A)(left,mad,idle)(shake0.03) 상태
		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket_guard_1, 'left', true)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pickpocket_guard_1, 'mad')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(pickpocket_guard_1, 0.03, 99999)

		--이 후 동일하게 잡는 연출 재생
	elseif idx == 2 then
		--카메라 도둑에게 이동
		camera_util.move_async(pickpocket.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 1)

		local npc = get_character('s3_oneline_npc_14')
		--A (right,mad,idle): 뭐라고?! 납치범!!!
		--이 때 소매치기(up)(jump1회)

		scene_util.set_direction(pickpocket, 'up', false)

	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)

		self.get_princess_marker(3, 1)
	}, 4, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	self.get_fx_small_smoke()
	self.get_fx_heal()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()

	self.get_fx_jump_smoke()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_field_object_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lorain_pos_1_1') + vector(0.5, 0, 1), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	if self.tap_sfx ~= nil then
		self.tap_sfx = nil
	end

	self:remove_all_loop_sfx()

	-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.is_disposed = true

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_event_zone_1') and
			self.current_staff_1_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.is_saw_staff_1_event then
		self.current_staff_1_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.is_saw_staff_1_event
		start_coroutine(function()
			--(A)농장직원(여) china_female (임시) / (down,idle,idle)
			--농장에서 갓 따낸 슬라임 정수 팝니다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('s4_farm_staff_1'),
					{ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_1', skip = false })
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_event_zone_2') and
			self.current_staff_2_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.is_saw_staff_1_event then
		self.current_staff_2_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.is_saw_staff_1_event
		start_coroutine(function()
			--( B )농장직원(남) china_male (임시) / (right,idle,idle)
			--우리 농장 사장님말이야… 10년전에는 엄청 팔팔했다던데?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(get_character('s4_farm_staff_3'),
					{ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_oneline_6', skip = false })

			--( C )농장직원(여) china_female (임시) / (left,tired,bomb_idle)
			--그렇게 기운없으신 분이 정말로 그랬다고?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(get_character('s4_farm_staff_4'),
					{ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_oneline_7', skip = false })

			--(B),(C) NPC 해당 대화 후 해당 대사들 원라인 상태로 유지
			get_character('s4_farm_staff_3').Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_oneline_6'
			get_character('s4_farm_staff_4').Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_oneline_7'

		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_event_zone_3') and
			not self.is_saw_staff_2_event then
		self.is_saw_staff_2_event = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('s4_farm_staff_2'),
					{ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_14', skip = false })
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'main_s6_farm_house_zone') then
		self:farm_house_quest_marker_setting('enter')
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local farm_staff_1 = self.get_farm_staff(1)
	local farm_staff_2 = self.get_farm_staff(2)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, princess) then
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_farm_1 then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.slime_farm_1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.cocktail_manual_event, self)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence
				and not self.farm_staff_1_flag and not self.farm_staff_2_flag then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.bar_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.bar_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, lorain) then
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_farm_1 then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.slime_farm_1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.cocktail_manual_event, self)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence
				and not self.farm_staff_1_flag and not self.farm_staff_2_flag then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.bar_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.bar_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, farm_staff_1) and self.farm_staff_1_flag then
		self.farm_staff_1_flag = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.buy_slime_essence, self, 1)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, farm_staff_2) and self.farm_staff_2_flag then
		self.farm_staff_2_flag = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.buy_slime_essence, self, 2)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_trash(i)) then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_trash(i).Name)
				start_coroutine(self.trash_collect, self, self.get_trash(i))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, 's4_trash_acting_leave_zone') and self.zone_leave_flag then
		self.zone_leave_flag = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.cleaning_cocktail_zone_leave, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, 'main_s6_farm_house_zone') then
		self:farm_house_quest_marker_setting('leave')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1

		if self.tap_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_inn_01')
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local signboard_new = self.get_signboard_new()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	if self.is_signboard_hold_up then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
			signboard_new.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, 1.47, 0.4)
			if not self.is_signboard_hold_up then
				return
			end
		end
	elseif self.is_attach_slime then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, popp) then
			self.dynamic_npcs.slime.Position = popp.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0)
			if not self.is_attach_slime then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(lorain, 's4_lorain_pos_1_1')
	lorain.Interactable.Talk = nil
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_lorain(), self.controller)

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(princess, 's4_princess_pos_1_1')
	princess.Interactable.Talk = nil
	character_util.add_listener(princess, self.controller)

	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(farm_owner, 's4_farm_owner_pos_1')
	farm_owner.Interactable.Talk = nil

	for idx = 1, 7 do
		local trash = self.get_trash(idx)
		trash.Position = self.get_trash_marker(idx)
	end

	for idx = 1, 4 do
		local chair_old = self.get_bar_chair_old(idx)
		local chair_new = self.get_bar_chair_new(idx)

		chair_old.Position = chair_new.Position
		chair_new.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	local cocktail_bar_old = self.get_cocktail_bar_old()
	local cocktail_bar_new = self.get_cocktail_bar_new()

	cocktail_bar_old.Position = cocktail_bar_new.Position
	cocktail_bar_new.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local signboard_new = self.get_signboard_new()
	signboard_new.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.zone_leave_flag = false

	character_util.add_listener(self.get_farm_staff(1), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_farm_staff(2), self.controller)
end

--쓰레기 수거
function local_class:trash_collect(target)
	self.trash_count = self.trash_count + 1
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()

	local camera_move_to_trash_duration = 1

	local function trash_effect(trash)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(trash.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		trash.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		trash.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	end

	local function hyunckel_side_trash_destroy_routine()
		-- 카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 흉켈과 포프가 부수던 쓰레기로 이동.
		local hyunckel_popp_side_trash = self.get_trash(7)

		camera_util.move_async(hyunckel_popp_side_trash.Position, camera_move_to_trash_duration)

		-- 흉켈과 포프가 부수던 쓰레기가 부숴진다.
		trash_effect(hyunckel_popp_side_trash)

		self.keep_popp_jingak_routine = false

		-- 포프는 smile, success / 흉켈은 right, idle, idle
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'success')

		scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(hyunckel, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(hyunckel, 'idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local function maam_side_trash_destroy_routine()
		local maam_leona_side_trash = self.get_trash(5)

		-- 카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 레오나랑 마암이 부수던 쓰레기로 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(maam_leona_side_trash.Position, camera_move_to_trash_duration)

		-- 레오나랑 마암이 부수던 쓰레기가 부숴진다.
		trash_effect(maam_leona_side_trash)

		self.keep_maam_jingak_routine = false

		-- 레오나는 smile, success / 마암은 left, smile, clap
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'success')

		character_util.remove_anim(maam)
		scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(maam, 'clap')

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local function princess_side_trash_destroy_routine()
		local princess_side_trash = self.get_trash(6)
		--카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 꼬마공주와 로레인이 부수던 쓰레기로 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(princess_side_trash.Position, 1)

		--꼬마공주와 로레인이 부수던 쓰레기가 부숴진다.
		trash_effect(princess_side_trash)

		--꼬마공주 smile, success, 로레인 idle, idle 1초 보여준다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'success')

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lorain, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local function remove_all_anim()
		local all_npcs = { leona, maam, popp, hyunckel, princess, lorain }
		character_util.remove_group_anim(all_npcs)
		character_util.remove_group_emotion(all_npcs)
	end

	trash_effect(target)

	if self.trash_count == 4 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		--이후 칵테일 바 수리 QTE 플레이어블 이벤트 시작.
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			local dist_to_hyunkel = vector_util.distance(hyunckel.Position, user_party.Leader.Position)
			local dist_to_maam = vector_util.distance(maam.Position, user_party.Leader.Position)
			local is_closer_to_hynkel = dist_to_hyunkel < dist_to_maam

			if is_closer_to_hynkel then
				hyunckel_side_trash_destroy_routine()
				princess_side_trash_destroy_routine()
				maam_side_trash_destroy_routine()
			else
				maam_side_trash_destroy_routine()
				princess_side_trash_destroy_routine()
				hyunckel_side_trash_destroy_routine()
			end

			wait_for_sec(1)

			self.is_jingak_routine = false

			remove_all_anim()

			self:repairing_cocktail_bar()
		end)
	else
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

-- 칵테일 교본 획득 이벤트
-- marker scene 2, idx n
function local_class:cocktail_manual_event()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local dai_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome }

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--꼬마공주 인터랙트 시
	--해당 대열로 정렬
	for i = 1, 6 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai_party[i], {
			self.get_party_align_marker(1, i)
		}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'party_align')

	--농장주인(left,idle,idle)(nod1회): …그렇게 됐다네.

-- 농장 직원에게 슬라임 정수 구매 이벤트
function local_class:buy_slime_essence(idx)
	local farm_staff_1 = self.get_farm_staff(1)
	local farm_staff_2 = self.get_farm_staff(2)
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local slime_essence_pocket_item_id = 20816
	local slime_essence_box_item_id = 20873

	if idx == 1 then
		party_util.align_party(farm_staff_1.Position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

		if self.current_staff_1_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.is_first_interact then
			self.current_staff_1_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.is_first_interact
			--A(down,attack,release): 저희 농장은 오직 토종슬라임만을 방목 사육합니다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_release_anim(farm_staff_1, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_2')
			character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)

			--A(down,smile,idle): 엄선된 관리를 통해 그 어떤 슬라임보다도 질높은 정수를 뽑아내죠!
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'smile')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_3')
			character_util.remove_emotion(farm_staff_1)
		end

		--이 후 재 인터랙트 시 아래 대사부터 재생된다.
		--A(down,smile,sing): 저희 농장의 슬라임 정수를 구매하시겠나요?
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'sing')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_4')

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--구매한다. (초록색)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_6', 'mercy' },
			--구매하지 않는다. (흰색)
			{ 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_5', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--다이(up,idle,push) 0.5칸 위로 이동
			--다이 다시 0.5칸 아래로 뒷걸음질 이동
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'push')

			--이 때 A(down,idle,push) 다이가 해당 스프라이트를 건네준다.
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.spine_deviate_local(dai, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.4, 0.3)

				end),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					local slime_essence_pocekt_1 = drop_item_util.create_item({
						itemid = slime_essence_pocket_item_id, pos = dai.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.7),
						skip_text = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
						showoncharacter = false, notforinven = true
					})
					drop_item_util.move_item_async(slime_essence_pocekt_1, dai.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.2))

					wait_for_sec(0.1)

					slime_essence_pocekt_1.ConsumeTarget = farm_staff_1
					slime_essence_pocekt_1:Fly()
				end)
			})

			if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_essence then
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				--	정수사오기 액팅 전 반응
				--	A(down,tired,idle) : …철 지난 장난인가요?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'tired')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_26')

				--다이(up,idle,idle): 응? 무슨 소리야?
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_27')

				--A(down,attack,cast): 문양도 다른 장난감돈으로 절 속이려 하다니…!
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'cast')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_28')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)

				--A가(attack)으로 해당 아이템을 다시 다이에게 던진 후 다이에게 아이템이 빨려들어간다.
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(farm_staff_1, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')

				drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = slime_essence_pocket_item_id, pos = farm_staff_1.Position,
					target = user_party.Leader.Position, skip_text = true,
					lootstate = 'FixLooter', showoncharacter = true, notforinven = true
				})

				wait_for_sec(0.4)

				--A(down,cry,idle): 저번에도 장난감 돈을 잘못 받아서 혼났다고요!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'cry')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_29')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_1)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

				self.farm_staff_1_flag = true

				--이 후 컨트롤 복귀
			elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence then
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--A(down,smile,sing): 그럼, 정수는 어떻게 담아드릴까요?
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'sing')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_8')

				--A(down,smile,release): 구이용? 스튜용? 크림용?
				scene_util.set_release_anim(farm_staff_1)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_9')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)

				choose_util.play_choose_event({
					--칵테일용으로! (초록)
					{ 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_9_1', 'mercy' }
				})

				--다이(up,idle,release): 저희는 칵테일용으로 담아주세요!
				scene_util.set_release_anim(dai)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_10')
				character_util.remove_anim(dai)

				--A(down,idle,question)(...) silence 이모티콘 버블
				scene_util.set_question_anim(farm_staff_1)
				character_util.remove_emotion(farm_staff_1)
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(farm_staff_1, nil, 'silence')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)

				--A(down,smile,idle)(jump1회): 슬라임 주스용이라… 오랜만에 들어보네요!
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'smile')
				character_util.normal_jump_async(farm_staff_1, true)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_11')

				--A(right,attack,eat) 1초 후
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_brewery_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(farm_staff_1, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'eat')

				--A(down,smile,idle): 여기 주문하신 정수입니다!
				scene_util.set_direction(farm_staff_1, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'smile')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_12')

				--A(down,smile,bow_idle)로 해당아이템을 다이에게 건네준다.

				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'bow_idle')

				wait_all({
					util.cs_generator(function()
						character_util.spine_deviate_local(farm_staff_1, vector(0, 0, -0.3), 0.4, 0.3)

					end),
					util.cs_generator(function()
						wait_for_sec(0.2)

						local slime_essence_pocekt_1 = drop_item_util.create_item({
							itemid = slime_essence_box_item_id, pos = farm_staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.7),
							lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = false, notforinven = true
						})
						drop_item_util.move_item_async(slime_essence_pocekt_1, farm_staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.2))

						slime_essence_pocekt_1.ConsumeTarget = dai

				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_1, 'success')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_13')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_1)

				--이 후 원라인 (down,smile,idle): 구매해주셔서 감사합니다!

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_1)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_1, 'tired')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_1, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_7')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_1)

	elseif idx == 2 then
		party_util.align_party(farm_staff_2.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

		if self.current_staff_2_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.is_first_interact then

			--D(left,attack,release): 오늘 색다른 맛을 경험해보고 싶지 않나요?

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_release_anim(farm_staff_2, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_15')
			character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_2)

			--D(left,smile,idle): 저희 슬라임 정수의 맛은 그 어떤 농장보다도 더 달콤합니다!
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'smile')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_16')
			character_util.remove_emotion(farm_staff_2)
		end

		--이 후 재 인터랙트 시 아래 대사부터 재생된다.
		--D(left,smile,sing): 이 진한 슬라임 정수의 풍미를 느껴보시겠나요?

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--다이(right,idle,staff_idle) 0.5칸 오른쪽으로 이동
			--이 때 A(left,idle,push) 다이가 해당 스프라이트를 건네준다.
			--다이 다시 0.5칸 왼쪽으로 뒷걸음질 이동
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'push')

			--이 때 A(down,idle,push) 다이가 해당 스프라이트를 건네준다.
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.spine_deviate_local(dai, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.4, 0.3)

					wait_for_sec(0.4)

					character_util.remove_anim(dai)
				end),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					local slime_essence_pocekt_2 = drop_item_util.create_item({
						itemid = slime_essence_pocket_item_id, pos = dai.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3),
						skip_text = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
						showoncharacter = false, notforinven = true
					})
					drop_item_util.move_item_async(slime_essence_pocekt_2, dai.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0.3))

					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					slime_essence_pocekt_2.ConsumeTarget = farm_staff_2
					slime_essence_pocekt_2:Fly()
				end)
			})

			if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_essence then
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--정수사오기 액팅 전 반응
				--D(left,tired,idle) : 이건… 받을 수 없어요.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'tired')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_30')

				--다이(right,idle,bomb_idle): 응? 돈으로 사는 게 아니야?
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'bomb_idle')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_31')
				character_util.remove_anim(dai)

				--D(left,tired,idle): 아무리 봐도 저희 쪽 화폐가 아니잖아요!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_32')

				--A가(attack)으로 해당 아이템을 다시 다이에게 던진 후 다이에게 아이템이 빨려들어간다.
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(farm_staff_2, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')

				drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = slime_essence_pocket_item_id, pos = farm_staff_2.Position,
					target = user_party.Leader.Position, skip_text = true,
					lootstate = 'FixLooter', showoncharacter = true, notforinven = true
				})

				wait_for_sec(0.4)

				--D(left,tired,release): 저희는 공용화폐만 받습니다…!
				scene_util.set_release_anim(farm_staff_2)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_33')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)

				--이 후 컨트롤 복귀
				self.farm_staff_2_flag = true

			elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence then
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--D(left,smile,bomb_idle): 원하시는 숙성정도는 있으신가요?
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_2, 'bomb_idle')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_21')

				--D(left,smile,sing): 몇일을 숙성했느냐에 따라 풍미가 달라진답니다!
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_2, 'sing')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_22')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_2)

				choose_util.play_choose_event({
					--칵테일에 어울리게! (초록)
					{ 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_22_1', 'mercy' }
				})

				--다이(right,smile,bomb_idle): 칵테일에 어울리는 걸로 주세요.
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(dai, 'bomb_idle')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(dai, 'smile')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_23')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

				--D(left,idle,question) (...) silence 이모티콘 버블
				scene_util.set_question_anim(farm_staff_2)
				character_util.remove_emotion(farm_staff_2)
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(farm_staff_2, nil, 'silence')
				character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_2)

				--D(left,smile,idle): 그럼, 갓 따낸 정수가 어울리겠군요!
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'smile')
				character_util.normal_jump_async(farm_staff_2, true)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_24')

				--D(right,attack,eat) 1초 후
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_brewery_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(farm_staff_2, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_2, 'eat')

				scene_util.set_direction(farm_staff_2, 'left', false)

				--D(left,smile,bow_idle)로 해당아이템을 다이에게 건네준다
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_2, 'bow_idle')

				wait_all({
					util.cs_generator(function()
						character_util.spine_deviate_local(farm_staff_2,
								vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.4, 0.3)

						wait_for_sec(0.4)

						character_util.remove_anim(farm_staff_2)
					end),
					util.cs_generator(function()
						wait_for_sec(0.2)

						local slime_essence_pocekt_2 = drop_item_util.create_item({
							itemid = slime_essence_box_item_id, pos = farm_staff_2.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.3),
							lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
							showoncharacter = false, notforinven = true
						})
						drop_item_util.move_item_async(slime_essence_pocekt_2,
								farm_staff_2.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.3))

						wait_for_sec(0.2)

						slime_essence_pocekt_2.ConsumeTarget = dai
						slime_essence_pocekt_2:Fly()
					end)
				})

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--D(left,smile,success): 다음에 또 오세요!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_staff_2, 'success')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'smile')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_25')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)

				self.current_staff_2_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.buy_slime_essence

				character_util.remove_relate_event(farm_staff_2, self.controller)
				farm_staff_2.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_25'
				farm_staff_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'
				quest_marker_util.remove('farm_staff_slime_essence_2')

				if self.current_staff_1_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.buy_slime_essence and
						self.current_staff_2_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.buy_slime_essence then
					self.current_staff_1_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.done
					self.current_staff_2_state = self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.done

					character_util.add_listener(self.get_lorain(), self.controller)
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_princess(), true)

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--d(left,tired,idle): 언제든 생각나면 다시 오세요…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_staff_2, 'tired')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_staff_2, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_slime_essence_20')

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(farm_staff_2)

			self.farm_staff_2_flag = true
		end
	end
end

-- 슬라임 칵테일을 만들어 본다.
-- marker scene 3, idx n
function local_class:bar_event()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 캐릭터 받기
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()
	local dai_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome }
	local all_npc = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome, princess, lorain, farm_owner }
	local npcs_except_dai_hyunckel_lorain_farm_owner = { popp, maam, leona, gome, princess }
	local hyunckel_lorain = { hyunckel, lorain }

	-- 파티 정렬 이벤트
	local align_dur = 1
	local align_pivot = princess.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
	local align_pos = {
		dai = align_pivot,
		popp = align_pivot + vector(-1, 0, 1),
		maam = align_pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		leona = align_pivot + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		hyunckel = align_pivot + vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
		gome = align_pivot + vector(-2, 0, -0.5)
	}

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	for i = 1, #dai_party do
		local member = dai_party[i]
		character_util.move_to(member, align_pos[member.Name], align_dur, nil, true, true)
	end

	-- 카메라포커스는 다이와 꼬마공주의 가운데 지점으로.
	local cam_pos = (align_pos[dai.Name] + princess.Position) * 0.5
	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, align_dur)

	character_util.set_group_direction(dai_party, 'right')

	--다이(smile, bomb_idle) : 슬라임 정수 모두 사 왔어, 공주님.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dai, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dai, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

	--꼬마공주(smile, idle) : 셰이커 통도 다 고쳤어!
	self.shaker.ConsumeTarget = princess
	self.shaker:Fly()

	character_util.remove_group_anim({ princess, lorain })
	character_util.set_group_direction({ princess, lorain }, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_2')
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	--꼬마공주가 다이에게 셰이커 통을 던져준다.
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.233)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

	local princess_throw_start_pos = vector(princess.Position.x - 0.2, 0.5, princess.Position.z)
	local shaker_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = princess_throw_start_pos,
		target = dai.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
		itemid = 20847,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = true
	})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--smile, throw로 dropitem으로 전달, 다이에게 빨려들어간다.
	--아이템 이름 : 슬라임 셰이커 통
	shaker_item.ConsumeTarget = dai
	shaker_item:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--포프(smile, nod) : 좋아! 그럼 이제 무지개 칵테일 주스를 만들어 볼까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.nod_the_head(popp, 1)
	character_util.set_emotion(popp, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_3')
	character_util.remove_emotion(popp)

	--꼬마공주(left, idle, idle) : 내가 레시피를 읽어줄게!
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_4')

	--꼬마공주가 교본을 dropitem으로 자신의 앞으로 던진다.
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.233)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')

	local cocktail_manual_item_target_pos = princess.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local cocktail_manual_item = self:make_cocktail_manual_item(princess_throw_start_pos, cocktail_manual_item_target_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마공주 eat 애니메이션 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'eat', remove_after = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마공주 idle, idle, question 이모티콘, jump 1회
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'question')

	--꼬마공주(left, surprise, idle) : <b>경고 : 마스터 슬라임 바텐더가 아닌 사람은 제작하지 마시오</b>…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_5')
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	--포프(tired, cross_arm) : 마스터 슬라임 바텐더?
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(popp)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_5_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)

	--꼬마공주(idle, idle) : 여기 적힌 모든 슬라임 주스 제조법을 통달한 자라고 적혀있네?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cocktail_making_5_2')

	--포프(idle, bomb_idle) : 한시가 급한데, 적힌 대로만 만들면 문제없지 않을까?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'bomb_idle')
