	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()

	local dai_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome }

	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.set_position(dai_party[i + 1], self.get_party_align_marker(4, i))
	end
	character_util.set_position(dai, self.get_party_align_marker(4, 5) + vector(1, 0, 0))

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(dai_party)

	--D2) 포프 / jungpa_male_fighter (임시) / left, attack, jingak
	scene_util.set_direction(popp, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')

	--D3) 마암 / ms_student_bad_female (임시) / down, attack, jingak
	scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'attack')

	--D4) 흉켈 / aw_reaper_b (임시) / (up),cast2
	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(hyunckel, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(hyunckel, 'cast2')

	--D5) 레오나 / aw_eurydice (임시) / right, smile, eat
	scene_util.set_direction(leona, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
	character_util.set_anim(leona, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	--C1) 꼬마 공주 / princess / (right)(smile)(eat)
	character_util.set_position(princess, self.get_princess_marker(3, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'eat')
	character_util.remove_relate_event(princess, self.controller)

	--C2) 로레인 / maiden / (up),cast2
	character_util.set_position(lorain, self.get_lorain_marker(3, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(lorain, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lorain, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'cast2')
	character_util.remove_relate_event(lorain, self.controller)

	--농장주인 원라인 대사
	--idle, release : 자, 어서들 움직이라고!
	scene_util.set_direction(farm_owner, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(farm_owner, dai.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_owner, 'release')
	farm_owner.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cleaning_2'

	--플레이어블 이벤트 (Push Release Action)
	--쓰레기 봉투 치우기
	--치워야 하는 쓰레기 봉투 총 5개 (노란색 스마일 제외)
	--쓰레기 청소 액팅
	--컨트롤 복귀 이후 각 쓰레기 오브젝트는 인터렉트 가능 상태로 변경됨.
	--노란색 스마일 쓰레기 봉투는 상호작용 안 됨
	--쓰레기 인터렉트 시 eat 애니메이션과 함께 게이지 바 출력. 게이지 바 모두 갱신할 시 쓰레기 제거됨. (게이지 바 1초 max)
	--총 쓰레기는 5개가 배치되어 있으며, 이벤트 시작 시 각 쓰레기별로 마킹 출력.
	--플레이어가 쓰레기를 전부 제거할 시 스마일 표시가 붙은 쓰레기 또한 제거된다.
	for idx = 1, 4 do
		local trash = self.get_trash(idx)
		trash.Interactable = CS.Oak.Interactable()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.get_trash(idx).Name, trash, true)
	end

	self.zone_leave_flag = true

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(popp)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(maam)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(leona)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(hyunckel)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_jingak_routine = true
	-- 쓰레기 청소 액팅 중 jingak 애니메이션 루틴
	start_coroutine(self.jingak_routine, self)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--이후 칵테일 바 수리 QTE 플레이어블 이벤트 시작.
end

-- 쓰레기 청소 액팅 중 jingak 애니메이션 루틴
function local_class:jingak_routine()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()

	while self.is_jingak_routine do
		if self.keep_popp_jingak_routine then
			character_util.set_anim(popp, { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = function()
				self.get_trash(7):Shake(0.03, 0.2)
			end })
		end

		if self.keep_maam_jingak_routine then
			character_util.set_anim(maam, { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = function()
				self.get_trash(5):Shake(0.03, 0.2)
			end })
		end

		-- 코루틴 오류 방지용 종료 루틴
		if not self.is_jingak_routine then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 쓰레기 청소 액팅 중 존을 벗어 났을 때 이벤트
function local_class:cleaning_cocktail_zone_leave()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()
	local bounds = field_util.get_zone('s4_trash_acting_leave_zone').Bounds

	--바 영역을 벗어나면 마암의 텍스트 버블 등장 후, 가장 가까운 존 안쪽으로 되돌아 온다.
	--농장주인 : 자네, 청소 안하고 어디가는 건가!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
	character_util.look_at(farm_owner, dai)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_owner, 'short_story_dai_main_s4_cleaning_1')

	local min_x = bounds.min.x
	local max_x = bounds.max.x
	local min_z = bounds.min.z
	local dai_x = dai.Position.x
	local dai_z = dai.Position.z
	local dai_wp = nil

	if min_x > dai_x and dai_z > min_z then
		dai_wp = vector(min_x + 1, 0, min_z + 1)
	elseif min_x > dai_x and min_z > dai_z then
		dai_wp = vector(min_x + 1, 0, min_z + 1)
	elseif min_x < dai_x and dai_z < min_z then
		dai_wp = vector(dai_x, 0, min_z + 1)
	elseif max_x < dai_x and dai_z > min_z then
		dai_wp = vector(max_x - 1, 0, dai_z)
	end

	wp_util.move_async(dai, dai_wp, 3, nil, { run = false })

	self.zone_leave_flag = true
end

function local_class:custom_qte_tab()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	local old_bar = self.get_cocktail_bar_old()
	local duration = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0
	local phase_count = 0
	self.tap_count = 0

	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()

	local all_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome, princess, lorain, farm_owner }

	local hammer_wielders = { maam, dai }
	local pickaxe_wielders = { hyunckel, popp, lorain }
	local broom_wielders = { farm_owner, leona }

	self.lasthit_loop = true
	self.hit_loop = true
	self.jump_small_loop = true

	for i = 1, #hammer_wielders do
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(hammer_wielders[i], '[base]weapon1', 'hammer')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(hammer_wielders[i], 'twohand_attack', { sfx_name = '02_flower_hit_01' })
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.lasthit_loop do
			self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(maam.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(dai.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			if not self.lasthit_loop then
				return
			end
		end
	end)

	for i = 1, #pickaxe_wielders do
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(pickaxe_wielders[i], '[base]weapon1', 'pickaxe_bronze_sword')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(pickaxe_wielders[i], 'twohand_attack')
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.hit_loop do
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hyunckel.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(popp.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(lorain.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			if not self.hit_loop then
				return
			end
		end
	end)

	for i = 1, #broom_wielders do
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(broom_wielders[i], '[base]weapon1', 'twohand_broom')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(broom_wielders[i], 'dualgun_attack_left')
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.jump_small_loop do
			self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(farm_owner.Position + vector(0.3, 1, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(leona.Position + vector(-0.3, 1, 0))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			if not self.jump_small_loop then
				return
			end
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'eat')

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
	while self.is_qte_success do
		if self.tap_count >= 5 then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--5회 이상 터치 하고 / 1.5초 지나면
			if time_passed > duration then
				phase_count = phase_count + 1

				if phase_count == 1 then
					--캐릭터들 표정 attack으로 변경
					--건물이 shake 하기 시작한다.
					--카메라 줌인 0.3초만에 0.8배로
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 0.3)
					character_util.set_group_emotion(all_party, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
					old_bar:Shake('old_bar_shake', 0.1, 99999)
					for idx = 1, 4 do
						local chair = self.get_bar_chair_old(idx)
						chair:Shake('old_chair_shake', 0.1, 99999)
					end

					self.tap_count = 0
					time_passed = 0
				elseif phase_count == 2 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
					character_util.set_group_emotion({ dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, princess, lorain }, { name = 'burning', loop = true })
					scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'attack')

					--캐릭터들 표정 burning으로 변경
					local anim_scale_data = { scale = 1.5 }

					for i = 1, #hammer_wielders do
						scene_util.set_anim_loop(hammer_wielders[i], 'attack', anim_scale_data)
					end

					for i = 1, #pickaxe_wielders do
						scene_util.set_anim_loop(pickaxe_wielders[i], 'twohand_attack', anim_scale_data)
					end

					for i = 1, #broom_wielders do
						scene_util.set_anim_loop(broom_wielders[i], 'dualgun_attack_left', anim_scale_data)
					end

					--건물에서 먼지 이펙트가 발생한다.
					--FX_Common_Jump_small
					--0.3초당 2개씩 배치.
					--바 모서리 4개중 2곳 번갈아가며 배치.
					--카메라 줌인 0.3초만에 0.6배로
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.4, 0.3)

					self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(old_bar.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
					wait_for_sec(0.3)
					self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(old_bar.Position + vector(4, 0, 0))

					self.tap_count = 0
					time_passed = 0

				elseif phase_count == 3 then
					--fx_common_smokescreen이 바를 덮으며 발생한다.
					--1.5초에 걸쳐 화이트 페이드 아웃.
					--동시에 카메라 줌인 1.5초에 걸쳐 0.4배로
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(1.6, 1.53)

					old_bar:CancelShake('old_bar_shake')

					for idx = 1, 4 do
						local chair = self.get_bar_chair_old(idx)
						chair:CancelShake('old_chair_shake')
					end

					message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

					if self.tap_sfx ~= nil then
						self.tap_sfx = nil
					end

					screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

					music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
					self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(old_bar.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))

					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					self.is_qte_success = false

					return
				end
			end
		end

		if not self.is_qte_success then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:play_loop_sfx(sfx_name, key, data)
	if self.loop_sfxs == nil then
		self.loop_sfxs = {}
	end

	if data == nil then
		self.loop_sfxs[key] = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, loop = true })
	else
		data['sfx_name'] = sfx_name
		data['loop'] = true
		self.loop_sfxs[key] = music_player_util.play_sfx(data)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_loop_sfx(key, fade_out_time)
	if self.loop_sfxs[key] ~= nil then
		if fade_out_time == nil then
			self.loop_sfxs[key]:Stop()
		else
			self.loop_sfxs[key]:FadeOut(fade_out_time)
		end

		self.loop_sfxs[key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_loop_sfx()
	if self.loop_sfxs ~= nil then
		for _, loop_sfx in pairs(self.loop_sfxs) do
			loop_sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.loop_sfxs = nil
	end
end

-- 농장 집 진입 시 스테이트 별 퀘스트 마커 세팅
function local_class:farm_house_quest_marker_setting(event)
	local exit_farm_house = get_field_object('exit_farm_house')
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if event == 'enter' then
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_farm_1 then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence then
			if self.current_staff_1_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.buy_slime_essence then
				quest_marker_util.remove('farm_staff_slime_essence_1')
			end
			if self.current_staff_2_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.buy_slime_essence then
				quest_marker_util.remove('farm_staff_slime_essence_2')
			end
			if self.current_staff_2_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.done and
					self.current_staff_1_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.done then
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
			end
		end

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'exit_farm_house', exit_farm_house, true)

	elseif event == 'leave' then
		quest_marker_util.remove('exit_farm_house')

		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.slime_farm_1 then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lorain_pos_1_1') + vector(0.5, 0, 1), true)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.slime_essence then
			if self.current_staff_1_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.buy_slime_essence then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'farm_staff_slime_essence_1', self.get_farm_staff(1), true)
			end
			if self.current_staff_2_state < self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.buy_slime_essence then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'farm_staff_slime_essence_2', self.get_farm_staff(2), true)
			end
			if self.current_staff_2_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_2.done and
					self.current_staff_1_state == self.slime_staff_state.staff_1.done then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, princess, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryDaiMainSection5')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	end

		return get_character('princess')
	end

	-- 농장 주인

		return get_character('farm_owner')
	end

	self.get_lorain_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lorain_pos_5_1')
	end

	self.cached_leader = nil

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_lorain(), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.cached_leader ~= nil then
		self.cached_leader = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 종료
	if e.Name == 'CocktailMiniGame' then
		start_coroutine(self.end_cocktail_minigame, self, e.Success)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lorain()) then
		start_coroutine(self.lorain_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s6_farm_house_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'exit_farm_house', get_field_object('exit_farm_house'), true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s6_farm_house_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.remove('exit_farm_house')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_lorain(), true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_cocktail_minigame()

	-- 미니게임 불러옴
	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.mini_game_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 미니게임 시작
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:lorain_interact_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 리더 무적 처리
	self.cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	if self.cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		self.cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
	local current_state = self.cached_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		--TODO: HoldTarget이 nil일 때는 버그 일텐데 굳이 체크하는게 맞을지...?
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(self.cached_leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(self.cached_leader.Direction)
			, self.cached_leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	local lorain = self.get_lorain()

	party_util.align_party(lorain, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	if not self.failed_minigame then
		--로레인 : 장사를 배울 준비가 되었나요?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(lorain, 'short_story_dai_main_s5_1')
	else
		--로레인 : 재도전할 준비가 되었나요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_6', skip = true })
	end


	--1. 시작하자!
	--2. 아니, 조금만 기다려.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_dai_main_s5_choose_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'short_story_dai_main_s5_choose_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if not self.failed_minigame then
			--로레인 : 다들 처음이니까 딱 300코인만 모아볼까요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_2', skip = true })
		else
			--로레인 : 이번에도 300코인만 모아보죠.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_7', skip = true })
		end

		self:dai_mini_game_start_reaction()
		self:start_cocktail_minigame()

		wait_for_sec(3)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.set_direction('up')
		return
	end

	-- 리더 무적 해제
	if self.cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		self.cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 무기 다시 보이게
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:end_cocktail_minigame(success)
	-- 미니게임 성공 시 다음 섹션 이동
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame('CocktailMiniGame')

	princess.Interactable.Talk = nil
	princess.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil

	farm_owner.Interactable.Talk = nil
	farm_owner.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil

	if success then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.failed_cocktail_minigame, self)
	end
end

function local_class:failed_cocktail_minigame()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0)

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lorain = self.get_lorain()
	local farm_owner = self.get_farm_owner()

	princess.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_oneline_2'

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(lorain)

	-- 로레인 (down, idle, idle): 이래선 손님들한테 찬사가 아니라 악평만 받을 거예요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_4', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(lorain)

	-- 로레인(down, idle, bomb_idle) : 한번 더 연습해보죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lorain, 'bomb_idle')
	character_util.remove_emotion(lorain)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_5', skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 7, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 8, 'normal' } })

	character_util.remove_anim(lorain)

	if choose_result == 1 then

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lorain)

		--로레인 : 이번에도 300코인만 모아보죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lorain, { key = 'short_story_dai_main_s5_7', skip = true })

		self:dai_mini_game_start_reaction()

		start_coroutine(self.start_cocktail_minigame, self)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lorain)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

		-- 로레인에게 다시 마커 마커

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.farm_house_event then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.farm_house_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.farm_house_start_scene, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, dai, 'main_s6_farm_house_exit_block_zone')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.farm_house_event and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start
			and not self.is_zone_enter then
		self.is_zone_enter = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			--이만 쉬러 들어가자, 다이.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_exit')

			local dai_wp = vector(dai.Position.x, 0, -81.5)
			wp_util.move_async(dai, dai_wp, 3, nil, { run = false })
			self.is_zone_enter = false

			self.current_section_state > self.section_state.farm_house_event and self.hyunckel_room_flag then
		self.hyunckel_room_flag = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.room_enter, self, 2)

			self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start and

		self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.failed_target_follow, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, dai, 'main_s6_hyunckel_follow_zone_2') and
			self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_end and
			self.current_follow_state ~= self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting then

			wp_util.move_async(dai, dai_wp, 3, nil, { run = false })
			self.is_zone_enter = false
		end)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, dai, 'main_s6_hyunckel_follow_zone_4') and
			self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_end then
		if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting then
			--게임오버 상황 조건 1개 추가
			--빨간색 존 진입시
			self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.detected_target_follow, self)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, dai, 'main_s6_farm_house_zone') then

			quest_marker_util.remove('hyunckel_follow')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'exit_farm_house', get_field_object('exit_farm_house'), true)

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, dai, 's6_sauna_block_zone') and not self.is_zone_enter then

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.spa_block_exit_scene, self)

		quest_marker_util.remove('exit_farm_house')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'hyunckel_follow', self.get_hyunckel(), true)

		return true
	end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local maam_room = get_field_object('main_s6_maam_rooom_interact')
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local farm_owner_door = get_field_object('main_s6_door_interact')

	for idx = 3, 4 do
		local bed = self.get_bed(idx)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bed) and
				self.current_section_state < self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_start
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.select_room, self)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, maam_room) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.room_enter, self, 1)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, gome) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s6_gome' })
		end)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, farm_owner_door) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02', 0.5)

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_dai_main_s6_door' })
		end)
	end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		if self.point_light_on then
			self.point_light.transform.localPosition = leader.Position + self.point_light_offset
			if not self.point_light_on then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 농장건물 진입하여 마암, 레오나 방 배정까지
function local_class:farm_house_start_scene()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	local farm_owner = get_character('farm_owner')

	local dai_party = { dai, popp, maam, leona, hyunckel, gome }
	character_util.set_position(get_character('s4_farm_staff_3'), vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(get_character('s4_farm_staff_4'), vector(999, 0, 999))

	camera_util.move(farm_owner.Position, 1)

	for i = 1, 6 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai_party[i], {
			self.get_party_align_marker(2, 1),
			self.get_party_align_marker(2, i + 1),
		}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'party_align')

	--주인(down,idle,release) : 자, 다들 들어온건가?
	scene_util.set_direction(farm_owner, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(farm_owner, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_owner, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_41')
	character_util.remove_anim(farm_owner)

	--마암(left,idle,idle)0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마암 (left,idle,dualgun_attack_left) 0.75 속도로 3회 이 후

	local anim_dur = spine_util.get_animation_duration(maam, 'dualgun_attack_left')
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_dur)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_dur)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_dur)
	end)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(maam,
			{ name = 'dualgun_attack_left', count = 2, scale = 0.75, sfx = '01_bubble_pop_01' })

	--(left,idle,idle) 0.5초 이 후 대사
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마암(up,release) : 네, 다 들어왔어요.
	scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_release_anim(maam)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_42')
	character_util.remove_anim(maam)

	--주인(down,idle,idle) : 푹 쉴 수 있게 방은 최상의 상태로 준비해 뒀다네!
	scene_util.set_direction(farm_owner, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_owner, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_43')

	--주인(down,smile,clap): 내일도 열심히 손님을 맞아야 될 거 아닌가! 하하하!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_owner, 'smile')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_owner, 'clap')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_owner, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_43_1')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')

	--주인(left,idle,idle) : 방은 많으니 각자 알아서 들어가 쉬게.
	scene_util.set_direction(farm_owner, 'left', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farm_owner, 'idle')
	character_util.remove_anim(farm_owner)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farm_owner, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_44')

	--농장주인이 왼쪽방으로 들어간다.
	wp_util.move(farm_owner, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_owner_pos_2_2'),
	}, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right', callback = function()
		farm_owner.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_dai_main_s6_44'
	end })

	--마암(left,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(maam, 'left', false)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_group_direction({ dai, popp, gome, hyunckel, leona }, 'right')
	--마암(left,idle,release) : 그럼 나랑 레오나는 저 쪽방에서 잘게.
	scene_util.set_release_anim(maam)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_45')
	character_util.remove_anim(maam)

	--마암(left,smile,idle)(jump1회) : 가자, 레오나.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(maam, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_46')

	--레오나(left,smile,cast2) : 그럼 내일봐 모두!
	scene_util.set_direction(leona, 'left', true)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leona, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leona, 'smile')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leona, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_47')
	character_util.remove_anim(leona)

	--마암과 레오나가 오른쪽으로 빠진다.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maam, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_maam_pos_2_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_maam_pos_2_2')
	}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leona, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_leona_pos_2_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_leona_pos_2_2') + vector(0, 0, -1)
	}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'party_align')

	--마암(left,tired,cross_arm) : 포프, 혹시라도 밤중에 방으로 기어들어올 생각은 마라?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(maam, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(maam, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maam, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_48')
	character_util.remove_anim(maam)

	--포프(right,attack,release) : 내… 내가 언제 그랬다고 그래!
	scene_util.set_direction(popp, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(popp)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_49')
	character_util.remove_anim(popp)

	--마암과 레오나가 오른쪽 방 방침대로 이동한다.
	--컨트롤 풀린상태 좌측과 우측 방에서 일행과 대화 가능 (원라인 상태)
	--마암(left,idle,idle) : 다들 푹 쉬도록 해.
	--레오나(left,idle,idle) : 모두들 수고 많았어.

function local_class:jump_bed(fo, direction)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(fo, 'get')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(fo, direction)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(fo, 1, 0.5)

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(fo)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(fo, 'seat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(fo, direction)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(fo, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(fo, 'sleep')
end

function local_class:select_room()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local gome = self.get_gome()

	for idx = 3, 4 do
		local bed = self.get_bed(idx)
		bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	local bed_1 = self.get_bed(3)
	bed_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_marker_util.remove(bed_1.Name)

	local bed_2 = self.get_bed(4)
	bed_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_marker_util.remove(bed_2.Name)

	--고메도 자는 자리로 정렬후 (left,sleep,sleep)
	wp_util.move(gome, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_party_align_pos_2_15'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_party_align_pos_2_15') + vector(0, 0, 3),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_gome_pos_2_1') + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_gome_pos_2_1') + vector(0, 1, -0.5),
	}, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'left', callback = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index + 1 == 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(gome, 0.5, 0.5)
		elseif wp_index + 1 == 4 then
			scene_util.set_direction(gome, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(gome, 'sleep')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(gome, 'sleep')
		end
	end })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dai, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_dai_pos_2_1') + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
	}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(popp, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_popp_pos_2_1') + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
	}, 4, nil, self, 'party_align', { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, 'party_align')

	--포프(right,idle,seat) 다이(left,idle,seat)

	wp_util.move(dai, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_dai_pos_2_1') + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
	}, 3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	--이후 포프(right,sleep_deep,sleep) 다이(left,sleep_deep,sleep)
	start_coroutine(self.jump_bed, self, dai, 'left')
	start_coroutine(self.jump_bed, self, popp, 'right')

	wp_util.move_async(popp, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_popp_pos_2_1') + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
	}, 3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	self.sleep_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc', parent = dai,
	})

	--이 후 페이드 인 페이드 아웃
	self:hyunckel_follow_event_1()
end

function local_class:night_lighting_setting(zone)
	if zone == 'inner' then
		-- 집 안은 그냥 어두운 틴트
		self.point_light_on = false
		self.point_light.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		field:Tint('darkness', unity_class.color.black, 0, 0.5)

	elseif zone == 'outer' then
		-- 어두운 틴트 해제
		field:RemoveTint('darkness', 0.5)

		self.point_light_on = true
		field:Tint('darkness', unity_class.color.black, 0, 0.8)
	end
end

function local_class:hyunckel_follow_start_scene()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	--빨간존에 진입시 파티정렬 포프(attack)표정 (jump1회) 둘다 (down,idle,idle) 파란원/포프 회색원/ 다이
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(popp, '01_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_emotion(popp)
	character_util.remove_emotion(dai)

	wp_util.move(dai, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s6_dai_pos_2_3')
	}, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.move_async(popp, {
		self.get_popp_marker(2, 8)
	}, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })

	if not self.saw_hyunckel_follow_start_scene then
		--흉켈쪽으로 카메라 이동
		camera_util.move_async(hyunckel.Position, 1)
		--빨간원에 흉켈이 서있다. (감시 표시가 생긴다.)
		--흉켈 (left) 1초 (right) 1초 (left) 1초 이 후 (right)
		scene_util.look_around(hyunckel, { 'left', 'right' }, nil, 1)

		--다시 카메라 복귀
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.8)

		--포프(down,attack,cast): 저기 흉켈이 있어, 이 밤에 대체 어디로 가려는 거지?
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(popp, 'cast')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_72')
	end

	--포프(down,attack,release) : 어서 따라가보자.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(popp)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_74')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

	--컨트롤 복귀 (다이 컨트롤)
	self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.none
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'hyunckel_follow', hyunckel, true)

	if not self.saw_hyunckel_follow_start_scene then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing', mix = 1 })

		self.saw_hyunckel_follow_start_scene = true
	end

	start_coroutine(self.set_sfx_volume, self, self.night_sound, 0.5, 1)

	start_coroutine(self.target_follow_phase_1, self)
end

	self:party_reset()
end

function local_class:target_follow_fail_check()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	local detection_dist_min = 1
	local detection_dist_max = 8 * 8

	if self.attack_range_renderer == nil then
		self.attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(hyunckel, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
		self.attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
	end

	while self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting do
		if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
			self.attack_range_renderer:Update(hyunckel)
		end

		-- 다이와 흉켈의 거리 계산
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - hyunckel.Position).sqrMagnitude

		-- 흉켈과 거리가 1만큼 가까워 졌을 때, 어택 레인지에 걸렸을 때 발각
		if self:is_in_sight(leader, hyunckel) or dist_to_player < detection_dist_min then
			self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.detected_target_follow, self)
			-- 흉켈과 거리가 8이상 멀어졌을 때 놓침
		elseif dist_to_player > detection_dist_max then
			self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.failed_target_follow, self)
		end

		if self.current_follow_state ~= self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	--게임오버시 연출
	--흉켈 (attack,idle)(jump1회) 다이를 바라본다.
	--다이,포프(surprise,idle)
	--페이드아웃 후 2번위치로 이동

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	character_util.look_at(dai, hyunckel)
	character_util.look_at(popp, hyunckel)

		self.attack_range_renderer:Update(hyunckel)

	character_util.normal_jump_async(hyunckel, '01_player_jump_01')

function local_class:party_reset()
	local dai = self.get_dai()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(popp)

	if self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_phase_1 then
		scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(dai, self.get_follow_reset_marker(2))

		scene_util.set_direction(popp, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(popp, self.get_follow_reset_marker(1))

		scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(hyunckel, self.get_hyunckel_marker(2, 9))

		if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
			self.attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			self.attack_range_renderer = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_phase_2 then
		scene_util.set_direction(dai, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(dai, self.get_follow_reset_marker(4))

		scene_util.set_direction(popp, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(popp, self.get_follow_reset_marker(3))

		scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', false)
		character_util.set_position(hyunckel, self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(6))

		if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
			self.attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			self.attack_range_renderer = nil
		end

		start_coroutine(self.target_follow_phase_2, self)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyunckel)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dai)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center
	local diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction)) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:target_follow_phase_1()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting

	start_coroutine(self.target_follow_fail_check, self)
	--흉켈의 이동속도는 기본 walk 속도

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(1)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(1)번 위치
	--흉켈 동작 (right) 1초 (up) 1초 (down) 1초 이 후 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'right', false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'down', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(3)번 위치
	--흉켈 패스따라 이동중 2번 위치에서는 정지만 1초
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(2)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(3)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--3번 위치에서 정지 1.5초 (left) 1초 이후 (right) 0.5초 패스따라 이동
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(4)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(5)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(4)번 위치까지 이동 시 스펙 변경됨
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(6)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	self:target_follow_phase_2()
end

function local_class:target_follow_phase_2()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_phase_2
	self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.follow_acting

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(self.target_follow_fail_check, self)

	--스펙변경) 재시작 위치 포프/다이는 R 위치 흉켈은 1위치로 변경
	--게임오버 상황 조건 1개 변경 (나머지는 유지)
	--흉켈보다 더 우측으로 이동시 ->흉켈보다 2타일 더 위에 있을 시

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(1)번 위치
	--흉켈 동작 (up) 1.5초 (down) 1초 (up) 0.5초 후 2번으로 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'down', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(2)번 위치
	--흉켈 (up) 1초 (left) 0.5초 (3)번으로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(7)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'up', false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(3)번 위치
	--흉켈 (4)번으로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(8)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--(4)번 위치
	--흉켈 (right) 0.5초 5번위치로 이동 속도 9
	--이 후 강제 이벤트
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(9)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(hyunckel, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	--5번 위치 도착하면 강제 이벤트
	wp_util.move_async(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(10)
	}, 4, nil, { run = false })

	if self.current_follow_state == self.hyunckel_follow_state.detected then
		return
	end

	self.current_follow_state = self.hyunckel_follow_state.ending
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.target_follow_ending, self)
end

function local_class:target_follow_ending()
	local hyunckel = self.get_hyunckel()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local dai = self.get_dai()

	--카메라가 흉켈을 비치도록 이동 후
	camera_util.move_async(hyunckel.Position, 1)

	if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
		self.attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
		self.attack_range_renderer = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(popp, hyunckel)
	character_util.look_at(dai, hyunckel)

	--흉켈(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm) (...) silence 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(hyunckel, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(hyunckel, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(hyunckel, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyunckel)

	wp_util.move(hyunckel, {
		self.get_hyunckel_follow_marker(11)
	}, 7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, callback = function()
		character_util.set_active_state(hyunckel, 'disabled')
	end })

	--(5)번-> 위쪽으로 쭉 (run)으로 이동 하는 것 보여주고 다이로 카메라 복귀
	camera_util.move_async(dai.Position, 1, { end_target = dai })

	--포프(attack 표정)(jump1회) : 빠… 빨리 쫒아가자!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(popp, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(popp, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(popp, 'short_story_dai_main_s6_77')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(popp)

	--메인 퀘스트 마커 연못 중앙으로
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hyunckel_follow_end
	self:set_spa_scene()
	local maam_shadow = self.spa_shadow_maam['spa_maam']
	quest_marker_util.remove('hyunckel_follow')
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, vector(125.5, 1.2, 1.19), true)
end

function local_class:set_sfx_volume(sound, volume, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_volume = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(duration, volume, progress)

		sound.Volume = cur_volume

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))

		if self.popp_box_item_list[i] ~= nil then

	elseif self.house_outside_interact_name == interact_handle_name then
		self.teleport_to_house = false
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.quest_marker_point)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:popp_box_item_setting()

	self.popp_box_item_list = {}

	local box_first_y_value = 0.7

	for i = 1, self.box_item_num do
		local item_pos = popp.Position + vector(0, (i * 0.7) + box_first_y_value, 0)

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = item_pos, itemid = self.popp_box_item_index_list[i],
												  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
												  sprscale = 1, showoncharacter = true })

		item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		table.insert(self.popp_box_item_list, item)
	end
end

--region section_event

function local_class:start_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 초기에 포프가 뒤에 있어 파티 위치 재배치 (리더 제외)
	for i = 2, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0.65, 0, 0))
	end

	-- 환경음 재생
	self.ambient_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_amb_village_02", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	--  스테이지 시작, 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 시작 이벤트 - 다이 일행 물품 사고 돌아오는 이벤트
	self:party_arrival_at_bar()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 시작 이벤트 종료 후 다음 이벤트 지점 마커 표시
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name,
			self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	self.quest_marker_point = self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide false
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	self.ambient_sound:FadeOut(3)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:popp_moving(arrival_pos)

	self.popp_box_sprite_parent_list[1] = self.popp_box_item_list[1].SpriteTransform.parent
	self.popp_box_sprite_parent_list[2] = self.popp_box_item_list[2].SpriteTransform.parent
	self.popp_box_sprite_parent_list[3] = self.popp_box_item_list[3].SpriteTransform.parent
	self.popp_box_item_list[1].SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.popp.transform)
	self.popp_box_item_list[2].SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.popp.transform)
	self.popp_box_item_list[3].SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.popp.transform)

	local walk_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_dash_04', parent = self.popp,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})

	character_util.shake(self.popp, 0.04, 9999)
	for i = 1, self.box_item_num do
		drop_item_util.shake(self.popp_box_item_list[i], self.drop_item_shake_key, 0.04, 9999)
	end
	character_util.move_to_async(self.popp, arrival_pos, 6.5, nil, true, false, false)

	self.popp_moving_end_check = true
	character_util.remove_anim(self.popp)
	walk_sound:Stop()
	walk_sound = nil
end

function local_class:popp_boxes_moving(box_index, end_pos_x)
	local end_pos = vector(end_pos_x, self.popp_box_item_list[box_index].Position.y, self.popp_box_item_list[box_index].Position.z)
	drop_item_util.move_to_async(self.popp_box_item_list[box_index], end_pos, 6.5,
			nil, { shadow_active = false })
end

function local_class:put_popp_boxes(box_index, dir)
	local dir_x = 0
	local dir_z = 0
	if dir == 'right' then
		dir_x = 1
	elseif dir == 'up' then
		dir_z = 1
	elseif dir == 'left' then
		dir_x = -1
	elseif dir == 'up' then
		dir_z = -1
	end
	local item_pos_y = 0

	-- 아이템 y축 셋팅
	if box_index == 3 then
		item_pos_y = 0.5
	elseif box_index == 1 then
		item_pos_y = 1.2
	elseif box_index == 2 then
		item_pos_y = 1.9
	end
	local end_pos = self.popp_box_item_list[box_index].Position + vector(dir_x, 0, dir_z)
	end_pos.y = item_pos_y
	sp_util.sine_move(self.popp_box_item_list[box_index],
			{ from = self.popp_box_item_list[box_index].Position,
									 to = end_pos,
									 duration = 0.5, height = 0.8 })

	-- sound
	if box_index == 2 and dir == 'right' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')
	end
	if box_index == 1 and dir == 'up' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')
	end
end

function local_class:maam_hold_up_boxes(box_index)
	local end_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local box_first_y_value = 0.7
	-- 아래부터 위 순서로 박스 인덱스
	if box_index == 3 then
		end_pos = self.maam.Position + vector(0, (1 * 0.7) + box_first_y_value, 0)
	elseif box_index == 1 then
		end_pos = self.maam.Position + vector(0, (2 * 0.7) + box_first_y_value, 0)
	elseif box_index == 2 then
		end_pos = self.maam.Position + vector(0, (3 * 0.7) + box_first_y_value, 0)
	end
	sp_util.sine_move(self.popp_box_item_list[box_index],
			{ from = self.popp_box_item_list[box_index].Position,
			  to = end_pos,
			  duration = 0.3, height = 0.8 })
end

function local_class:popp_knock_back(anim_duration)
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.75)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')

	camera_util.shake(0.075, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.popp.Position + vector(0.35, 0.5, 0))

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.popp)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.popp)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'confused')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.popp, 'prostrate')

	-- 마암, 포프 공격 시, 다이, 레오나(left, surprise,jumpx1) 고메(left, surprise, jumpx1)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.leona, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	start_coroutine(function()

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(self.gome, false)

		--이후 고메 하단 동선으로 빠르게 이동 후 (left, tired) shake 상태
		local wp_1 = vector(self.gome.Position.x, 0, self.leona.Position.z + 1)
		local wp_2 = vector(self.leona.Position.x + 1, 0, wp_1.z)
		local wp_3 = vector(wp_2.x, 0, self.leona.Position.z)
		local wp_4 = vector(self.leona.Position.x + 0.5, 0, wp_3.z)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.gome, { wp_1, wp_2, wp_3, wp_4 }, 4.5, false,
				nil, nil, 'left')
		character_util.shake(self.gome, 0.04, 9999)
		-- 이동 후 (left, tired, sleep)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.gome, 'sleep')

	end)

	local move_end_anim_func = function()
		character_util.shake(self.popp, 0.02, 9999)
	end
	start_coroutine(self.move_field_object, self, self.popp, 0.3, self.popp.Position,
			self.popp.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0, move_end_anim_func, 0.28)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.popp_knock_back_end = true
end

function local_class:party_member_moving(fo, arrival_pos)

end

function local_class:party_arrival_at_bar()
	-- 다이, 마암, 레오나 오른쪽 4칸 이동
	local arrival_pos = self.dai.Position + vector(self.party_first_move_distance_x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to(self.dai, arrival_pos, nil, 2, true, true, false)

	arrival_pos = self.maam.Position + vector(self.party_first_move_distance_x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to(self.maam, arrival_pos, nil, 2, true, true, false)

	arrival_pos = self.leona.Position + vector(self.party_first_move_distance_x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to(self.leona, arrival_pos, nil, 2, true, true, false)

	arrival_pos = self.gome.Position + vector(self.party_first_move_distance_x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.gome, arrival_pos, nil, 2, true, true, false)

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.maam, 'bow_idle')

	local buy_list_paper = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.maam.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		itemid = self.buy_list_paper_item_index, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true
	})

	buy_list_paper.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')

	-- 마암 (right,idle, bow_idle) : …레몬 샀고, 탄산수 샀고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 마암 (right,idle, bow_idle) : 얼음, 컵, 빨대…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 하단 대사 시작하면 화면 좌측에서 포프 등장
	-- 포프(right, blush, cast2) 상태로 박스를 3개 들고 있음
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'blush')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.popp, 'walk')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.popp, 'hold', { upper = true })
	local s6_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start')
	arrival_pos = s6_start_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	for i = 1, self.box_item_num do
		start_coroutine(self.popp_boxes_moving, self, i, arrival_pos.x)
	end
	start_coroutine(self.popp_moving, self, arrival_pos)


	-- 마암 (right,idle, victory_get) : 좋아, 오늘 영업에 필요한 건 다 산 것 같네!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.maam, 'victory_get')
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(buy_list_paper)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)

	-- 마암(left, attack, release) : 뭐하고 있는 거야, 포프! 빨리빨리 따라오란 말이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.maam, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_field',
										 state = 'field', volume = 0.5, mix = 4 })

	-- 마암(left, attack, cross_arm) : 그렇게 꼼지락거려서 제시간에 가게 오픈할 수 있겠어?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.maam, 'cross_arm')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })

	while not self.popp_moving_end_check do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 포프(right, mad, bomb_idle) : …이걸 다 들고 어떻게 빨리 가?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.popp, 'bomb_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })
	-- 포프(right, mad, bomb_idle) : 애초에 왜 짐을 나 혼자 들어야 하는 건데!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'right', false)

	-- 마암(left, attack, release) : 고작 그 정도로 힘들어하긴…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.maam, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)

	-- 마암(right, attack, cross_arm) : 어제 그런 짓을 한 벌이니까 투덜대지마.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.maam, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'right', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.dai)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.maam)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leona)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.gome)

	-- 포프(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 그, 그건 오해라고 했잖아…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'tired')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 포프(right ) : 연못에서 수상한 짓을 하고 있길래 흉켈인 줄 알고…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'left', true)
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[1], 'left')
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[2], 'left')
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[3], 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'right', true)
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[1], 'right')
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[2], 'right')
	self:item_sprite_invert_left_right(self.popp_box_item_list[3], 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 포프(right, attack, bomb_idle)  : …잠깐, 흉켈이 또 안 보이는데?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'attack')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 12, skip = true })

	-- 다이(left, idle, release)) : 흉켈은 균열에 대해 조사해보겠다면서 아침 일찍 나갔어.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 13, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

	-- 다이(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 지금쯤 숲 쪽에 있지 않을까?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.dai, 'bomb_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 14, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

	-- 포프(right, attack, bomb_idle) : …정말 조사하러 간 거 맞아? 지금이라도 뒤를 밟아보는게…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 15, skip = true })

	-- 마암(left, attack, jingak) : [shout] 정말, 그만 좀 해!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.maam, 'jingak')
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.maam, 'jingak')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.75)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	-- 아래 대사로 인해 놀라는 연출
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.leona, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.gome, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'surprise')

	local box_fell_off_func = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')

		local end_pos = self.popp.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		sp_util.sine_move(self.popp_box_item_list[3],
				{ from = self.popp_box_item_list[3].Position,
				  to = end_pos,
				  duration = 0.4, height = 0.9 })

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.dai)

	wp_2 = wp_2 + vector(1, 0, 0)

function local_class:talk_with_princess()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lorain)

	-- 파티, 공주 앞으로 정렬
	local party_wp_key = 'move_around_princess'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, self.get_s7_dai_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.popp, self.get_s7_popp_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, self.get_s7_maam_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.leona, self.get_s7_leona_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.gome, self.get_s7_gome_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lorain, self.controller)

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		-- 공주(right, idle, jumpx1) : 다들 빨리 왔네?!
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

		-- 공주(right, smile, idle) : 재료는 다 샀어?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'smile')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

function local_class:start_cocktail_minigame()
	-- 미니게임 불러옴
	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.mini_game_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 미니게임 시작
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:end_cocktail_minigame(success)
	-- 미니게임 성공 시 다음 섹션 이동

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame('CocktailMiniGame')
	if success then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

function local_class:move_field_object(moving_obj, duration, start_pos, end_pos, height, call_func, call_func_time)
	local time_passed = 0
	-- 카메라 이동을 실행했는지 체크
	local camera_move_start = false
	local cur_y = 0
	local check_call_func = false

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

		if cur_y <= 0 then cur_y = 0 end

		moving_obj.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		if not check_call_func then
			if call_func_time < time_passed then
				start_coroutine(call_func, self)
				check_call_func = true
			end
		end

		-- loop escape
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:item_sprite_invert_left_right(item, dir)
	if dir == 'left' then
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-90, 180, 0)
	elseif dir == 'right' then
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	end
end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name,
			quest_marker_point, true)
end

function local_class:enter()

function local_class:start()

	-- bgm setting
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_field',
											 state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })
	else
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)
	end

	start_coroutine(function()

		self:load_inner_section_progress()

		if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s1 then
			self:s1_setting()
			self:start_s1_event()
		elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2 then
			self:s2_setting()
			self:start_s2_event()
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hyunckel) and self.interacted == false then
		self.interacted = true
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_with_dolf
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.talk_with_magician_dolf, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.princess)
			and self.interacted == false then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 공주 : 여긴 위험하니까, 창고 쪽으로 몸을 숨겨…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 25, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.talk_with_dolf then
			self.interacted = true
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.second_princess_event
			start_coroutine(self.return_to_princess, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.leona) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 레오나 : 조금만 참으세요…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.leona, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 23, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_with_dolf then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.leona, { key = self.oneline_string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 2, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lorain) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 로레인 : 발목을 심하게 접질렀네요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lorain, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 24, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_with_dolf then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lorain, { key = self.oneline_string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 1, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(1)) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 농장 직원 1 : 으으…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(1), { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 26, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(8)) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 농장 직원 8 : 차, 창고가 어딘데?!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(8), { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 27, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(9)) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 농장 직원 9 : 설마 농장까지 쳐들어오진 않겠지…?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(9), { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 28, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(10)) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 농장 직원 10 : 모, 몬스터… 몬스터가…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(10), { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 29, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(11)) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.battle_2_end then
			-- 농장 직원 11 : 대체 어디서 저런 놈들이…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(11), { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 30, skip = false })

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if not self.interacted then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.s8_save_civil_zone_name and
					self.current_section_state == self.section_state.first_princess_event then
				self.interacted = true
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.save_civil
				start_coroutine(self.enter_save_civil_zone, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s8_battle_2_enter_zone_name then
				if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_end then
					self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2_start
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.battle_2_area_enter_event, self)
					return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s8_battle_2_zone_name then
				-- 시민 구출 이벤트를 진행 한 후 일반 전투 후 이벤트 가능
				if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_end and not self.send_battle_2_notice then
					--self.send_battle_2_notice = true
					--start_coroutine(self.monster_notice_in_battle_zone, self, e.Zone.Name)
					--return true
				end
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s8_runaway_civil_zone_name then
				if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_end then
					if not self.s8_run_runaway_civil then
						self.s8_run_runaway_civil = true
						self.on_runaway_civil_event = true
						start_coroutine(self.run_away_civil_group_1_run, self)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- 소원을 들어주는 마녀 서브퀘에서 집으로 순간이동했을때
		if not self.teleport_to_house then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.teleport_in_house_zone_name then
				self.teleport_to_house = true
				start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.get_house_outside_interact())
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 종료
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		start_coroutine(self.end_cocktail_minigame, self, e.Success)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	if e.BattleGroupName == 's8_battle1' then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1_end

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.gome)

		-- s8 시민 구출 이벤트 전투 종료 후 다음 이벤트 지점 마커 표시
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
				self.quest_marker_name,
				self.get_s8_battle_2_event_marker_pos())
		self.quest_marker_point = self.get_s8_battle_2_event_marker_pos()
		self:oneline_event_setting_before_second_battle()
		self:battle_2_monster_setting()
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 's8_battle2' then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2_end
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.gome)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.battle_2_end_event, self)
		self:oneline_event_disable_before_second_battle(false)

		-- change oneline npc state
		self.controller:change_oneline_npc_by_section_state(7, true)

		self:oneline_event_setting_after_second_battle()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		if self.qte_current_clear_count == 0 then
			scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'right', false)
			self.is_qte_success = true
		end
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		if self.qte_current_clear_count == 1 then
			scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', false)
			self.is_qte_success = true
		end
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name
		if self.on_runaway_civil_event then
			self.on_runaway_civil_event = false
			self:oneline_event_disable_before_second_battle(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	local interact_handle_name = e.ExitHandleName

	if self.house_inside_interact_name == interact_handle_name then
		self.teleport_to_house = true
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.get_house_outside_interact())
	elseif self.house_outside_interact_name == interact_handle_name then
		self.teleport_to_house = false
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.quest_marker_point)
	end
	return false
end

	self.controller:create_crack_effect('s10_crack_1', vector(14, 0, 30))

	self.lorain = self.controller.get_lorain()
	self.princess = self.controller.get_princess()
	self.magician = self.controller.get_magician()

end

function local_class:npc_setting()

	self:default_npc_setting()

	character_util.set_position(self.dai, self.get_s7_dai_align_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(self.popp, self.get_s7_popp_align_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(self.maam, self.get_s7_maam_align_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(self.leona, self.get_s7_leona_align_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(self.gome, self.get_s7_gome_align_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'smile')

	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(self.magician, self.get_s8_dolf_start_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.magician, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(self.maid, self.get_s8_amy_start_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maid, 'left', false)

	-- 다른 npc
	self.farm_workers = {}

	for i = 1, self.farm_workers_num do
		local worker_pos = self.get_farm_worker_runaway_pos(i, 1)

		local worker = self.get_worker(i)
		character_util.set_position(worker, worker_pos)

		local dir = 'right'
		-- 4, 5번 농작 직원만 아래서 올라옴
		if i == 4 or i == 5 then
			dir = 'up'
		elseif i >= 10 and i <= 11 then
			dir = 'left'
		end

		-- 1 ~ 7번 농장 직원들은 해상도 고려해서 끝에서 나타나게 해 처음부터 표정 설정
		if i < 8 then
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(worker, 'scared')
		else
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(worker, 0, 0)
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(worker, dir, false)

function local_class:character_black_tint_event(fo)
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.is_character_black_tint = true

	while self.is_character_black_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				character_util.remove_fade_color(fo, fo.Name, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				character_util.add_fade_color(fo, fo.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_fade_color(fo, fo.Name, 0.01)
end

	local worker_6 = self.get_worker(6)
	local worker_7 = self.get_worker(7)

	-- 주요 인원들 좌측 바라보고 ani, emo 초기화

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'surprise')
