	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.popp)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.popp, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.maam, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.leona)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.leona, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'left', false)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.gome, '01_player_jump_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.06, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 화면 좌측에서 shout 말풍선 출력
	-- 다들 도망쳐!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_worker(1),
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1,
			  bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-300, -100), scale = 1.5, skip = true })

	-------------------
	-- 1번 농장 직원
	local wp_list = {}
	for i = 2, self.farm_workers_runaway_route[1] do
		local route_point = self.get_farm_worker_runaway_pos(1, i)
		if i == self.farm_workers_runaway_route[1] then
			route_point = route_point + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		end
		table.insert(wp_list, route_point)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_suspense', state = 'field' })

	local worker_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	local party_wp_key_1 = 'meeting_first_worker'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.farm_workers[1], wp_list, 4.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key_1, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 다이, 포프 마암, 레오나, 공주, 로레인  1번 직원 바라봄
	local time_passed = 0
	local change_dir = false
	while self.wp_util_remaining_move_end[party_wp_key_1] > 0 do

		if time_passed > 1 and not change_dir then
			change_dir = true
			scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'down', false)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	worker_dash_sfx:Stop()
	worker_dash_sfx = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.farm_workers[1], 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.farm_workers[1], 'damaged')
	character_util.jump_move(self.farm_workers[1], self.farm_workers[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, 0.5, true)

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.farm_workers[1].Position)

	character_util.shake(self.farm_workers[1], 0.03, 9999)

	-- 직원1 넘어지면 고메(right, tired, sleep)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'tired')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.gome, false)

	-- 직원1 넘어지면 다이, 레오나(down, surprise, juimpx1) 후, 넘어진 농장 직원 주위로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'down', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'down', false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.leona, '01_player_jump_01')

	worker_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.dai, self.dai.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 3.5, true,

function local_class:change_party_look_dir_by_time()

	wait_for_sec(0.95)

	self.current_party_look_order = self.party_look_dir.down

	wait_for_sec(1.1)

	self.current_party_look_order = self.party_look_dir.right

end

function local_class:farm_workers_run_away()

	local farm_worker_moving = function(farm_worker_index, last)
		local wp_list = {}
		for i = 2, self.farm_workers_runaway_route[farm_worker_index] do
			local route_point = self.get_farm_worker_runaway_pos(farm_worker_index, i)
			table.insert(wp_list, route_point)
		end
		local last_worker_check = nil
		if last then
			last_worker_check = function()
				self.last_farm_worker_arrived_point = true
			end
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.farm_workers[farm_worker_index], wp_list, 4.5, true,
				nil, nil, 'right', false, 0, last_worker_check)

	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_npc_runaway_01')

	farm_worker_moving(2, false)

	farm_worker_moving(3, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	farm_worker_moving(4, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	farm_worker_moving(5, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	farm_worker_moving(6, false)

	farm_worker_moving(7, true)
end

function local_class:set_save_civil_zone_event()

	for i = 1, (self.up_side_civil_num + self.left_side_civil_num) do
		local civil = self.get_s8_civil(i)

		character_util.set_position(civil, self.get_s8_save_civil_pos(i))
		if i <= self.up_side_civil_num then
			scene_util.set_direction(civil, 'up', false)
		else
			scene_util.set_direction(civil, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civil, 'scared')
		end

		character_util.shake(civil, 0.05, 9999)
	end

	for i = 1, (self.up_side_monster_num + self.left_side_monster_num) do
		local monster = self.get_s8_monster(i)

		character_util.set_position(monster, self.get_s8_monster_pos(i))
		if i <= self.up_side_monster_num then
			scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'down', false)
		else
			scene_util.set_direction(monster, 'right', false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:up_side_npcs_moving()
	-- 상단 움직임
	for i = 1, self.up_side_monster_num do
		local monster = self.get_s8_monster(i)
		character_util.move_to(monster, monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1,
				nil, true, true, false)
	end

	--wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, self.up_side_civil_num do
		local civil = self.get_s8_civil(i)

		character_util.stop_shake(civil)
		character_util.move_to(civil, civil.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1,
				nil, false, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = 1, self.up_side_civil_num do
		character_util.shake(self.get_s8_civil(i), 0.05, 9999)
	end
end

function local_class:left_side_npcs_moving()
	-- 좌측 움직임
	for i = self.up_side_monster_num + 1, (self.up_side_monster_num + self.left_side_monster_num) do
		local monster = self.get_s8_monster(i)
		character_util.move_to(monster, monster.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1,
				nil, true, true, false)
	end

	--wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- left, scared, idle 상태로 뒷걸음질
	for i = self.up_side_civil_num + 1, (self.up_side_civil_num + self.left_side_civil_num) do
		local civil = self.get_s8_civil(i)

		character_util.stop_shake(civil)
		character_util.move_to(civil, civil.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1,
				nil, false, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = self.up_side_civil_num + 1, (self.up_side_civil_num + self.left_side_civil_num) do
		character_util.shake(self.get_s8_civil(i), 0.05, 9999)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_save_civil_zone()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 파티, 시민 구하는 이벤트 존 진입 시 정렬
	local party_wp_key = 'enter_save_civil_zone'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(1, 1), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.popp, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(1, 2), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(1, 3), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.gome, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(1, 4), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- holdup state인지 체크
	local holdup_object
	if self.dai.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(self.dai.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		holdup_object = self.dai.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if holdup_object ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(self.dai, holdup_object, vector(-1, 0, 0),
					self.dai.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 4, false)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_s8_save_civil_zone_marker_pos(), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.up_side_npcs_moving, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.left_side_npcs_moving, self)
	})

	start_coroutine(self.civil_shake, self)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.dai.Position, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 고메(left, attack, jumpx1)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.gome, false)

	-- 마암(left, attack, idle) : 바, 발록…?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 마암(left, attack, release) : 저건 우리 세계에 있는 몬스터잖아?!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.maam, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)

	-- 포프(left, attack, bomb_idle) : 저놈들이 어떻게 여기에 있는 거지…?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.popp, 'bomb_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 포프(left, attack, cross_arm) : 설마 우리를 따라서…
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.popp, 'cross_arm')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 다이(right, attack, jumpx1) : 지금은 그런 거 따질 시간이 없어!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })

	local stop_shake_and_restart_shake = function(fo)
		character_util.stop_shake(fo)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.shake(fo, 0.05, 9999)
	end

	-- 하단 대사 출력 시. 주민1~6 right, scraed, jumpx1, 이후 shake 상태
	for i = 1, (self.up_side_civil_num + self.left_side_civil_num) do
		local civil = self.get_s8_civil(i)

		scene_util.set_direction(civil, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civil, 'scared')

		character_util.normal_jump(civil, false)
		start_coroutine(stop_shake_and_restart_shake, civil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.popp)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.maam)

	-- 카메라 고정을 위해
	camera_util.move_async(self.dai.Position, 0.01)

	-- 다이(left, attack, release) : [shout] 모두 이쪽이야!
	-- 03_dialogue_negative_01 + 01_crowd_shout_05
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 6,
			  bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

	-- 파티, 시민 구하는 이벤트 존 진입 시 두번째 정렬
	party_wp_key = 'enter_save_civil_2'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(2, 1), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.popp, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(2, 2), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(2, 3), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.gome, self.get_s8_party_member_pos(2, 4), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- 다이(right, attack, release) : [shout]이쪽으로 도망쳐!!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 7,
			  bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	start_coroutine(self.civil_run_away_outside, self)

	party_wp_key = 'monster_move'

	local monster = self.get_s8_monster(1)
	local wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x, 0, 5)
	local wp_2 = vector(wp_1.x + 2, 0, wp_1.z)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, { wp_1, wp_2 }, nil,
			1.5, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	monster = self.get_s8_monster(2)
	wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x, 0, 6)
	wp_2 = vector(wp_1.x + 1, 0, wp_1.z)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, { wp_1, wp_2 }, nil,
			1.5, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	monster = self.get_s8_monster(3)
	wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x + 5, 0, monster.Position.z)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, wp_1, nil,
			1.5, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	monster = self.get_s8_monster(4)
	wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x + 5, 0, monster.Position.z)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, wp_1, nil,
			1.5, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 몬스터와의 전투 시작
	start_coroutine(self.battle_1_start, self)
end

function local_class:civil_shake()
	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	for i = 1, (self.up_side_civil_num + self.left_side_civil_num) do
		character_util.shake(self.get_s8_civil(i), 0.05, 9999)
	end
end

function local_class:battle_1_start()
	for i = 1, self.battle_1_gate_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_1_gate_key .. i))
	end

	for i = 1, (self.up_side_monster_num + self.left_side_monster_num) do
		local monster = self.get_s8_monster(i)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, 's8_battle1', 's8_battle_zone_1')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')

	self.interacted = false
end

	self:battle_2_end_event_npc_setting()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 다이(right, tired, idle) :  …마법을 쓸 수 없으니 역시 힘들어…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'tired')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })

	character_util.stop_shake(self.dai)
	character_util.stop_shake(self.popp)
	character_util.stop_shake(self.maam)

	-- 마암(left, attack, cross_arm) : 발록이랑 머드핸드... 모두 요마사단의 몬스터들인데…

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.maam, 'cross_arm')

	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'down', false)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 13, skip = true })

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'attack')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(self.popp)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 포프(down, attack, bomb_idle) : 몬스터가 나타난 후에는 갑자기 균열이 사라졌고...

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.popp, 'bomb_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 15, skip = true })

	-- 포프 : 분명 이것들 사이에 뭔가 연관이 있는 것 같은데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 16, skip = true })

	-- 하단 이모티콘 출력 시, 고메(left, sleep,idle)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'sleep')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 18, skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.maam, 'bomb_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 포프(down, attack, idle) :응. 그 사람이라면 이 현상에 대해 알고 있지 않을까?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 20, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.popp)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.maam)

	-- 다이(right, attack, release) : 좋아, 빨리 가보자! 아직 광장에 있을 지도 몰라.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s2

	self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)

	-- 흉켈, 돌프, 에이미 이벤트를 위한 흉켈 셋팅
	character_util.set_position(self.hyunckel, self.get_s8_hyunckel_start_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.hyunckel, 'right', false)
	character_util.add_listener(self.hyunckel, self.controller)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- s8 흉켈과 재회 이벤트 종료 후 다음 이벤트 지점 마커 표시

			self.quest_marker_name,
			self.hyunckel.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	self.quest_marker_point = self.hyunckel.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
end

function local_class:talk_with_magician_dolf()

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.magician, true)
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.maid, true)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	-- 하단 대사 시, 고메(흉켈 방향, surprise, jumpx2)
	character_util.look_at(self.gome, self.hyunckel)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'surprise')

function local_class:return_to_princess()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lorain)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.leona)

	-- 공주
	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

		start_coroutine(self.lorain_leona_done_helping, self)

		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)

		-- 로레인
		scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)

		-- 레오나
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.leona)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(self.leona, false)
	end

	-- 로레인도 덤으로 방향 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 파티, 공주에게 상호작용 시 정렬
	local party_wp_key = 'move_around_princess'

	if self.asked_bar_open then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.leona, self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 3,
				nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, self.get_s8_dai_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.popp, self.get_s8_popp_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, self.get_s8_maam_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.gome, self.get_s8_gome_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leona)

	if not self.asked_bar_open then

		-- 공주(right, tired, idle) : 다들 괜찮은 거야?! 몬스터들은 어떻게 됐어?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'tired')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

		-- 다이(left, attack, victory) : 걱정 하지 마! 우리가 모두 무찔렀으니까!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.dai, 'victory')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

		-- 마암(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 마을 사람들도 안전해.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.maam, 'bomb_idle')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)

		-- 공주(right, smile, idle) : 다행이다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'smile')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })

		-- 공주(right, smile, jumpx1) : 여기 사람들도 모두 무사해!
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })

		-- 레오나(right, idle, release) : 다들 수고했어. 오늘은 이만 쉬고 내일 다시…
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.leona)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.leona, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.leona, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.leona)

		-- 다이(left, sleep_deep, idle) : …아냐, 흉켈은 우리 대신 몬스터를 막으러 갔는데, 쉬고 있을 순 없지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'sleep_deep')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })

		-- 다이(left, attack, release) :  더 연습해서 한시라도 빨리 무지개 칵테일 주스를 만들고 싶어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'attack')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.dai)

		-- 포프(left, sleep_deep, nodx2) : …그래..
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'sleep_deep')
		character_util.nod_twice(self.popp)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })

		-- 마암(left, smile, idle): 나도 동감이야.
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'smile')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })

		-- 공주(right, smile, idle) : 그럼… 계속 이어서 영업해볼까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })

		-- 상단 대사 이후 고메(left, smile, jumpx2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(self.gome, true)
	else
		-- 공주(right, smile, idle) : 그럼… 계속 이어서 영업해볼까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 15, skip = true })
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 12, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 13, 'normal' } })

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)

	if choose_result == 1 then

		-- 공주 가리키는 마커 삭제
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		if not (self.minigame_failed_count > 0) then
			-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번에는 800코인을 목표로 해보자!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 14, skip = true })
		else
			-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번엔 {0}코인을 목표로 해보자!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			local required_coins = self.controller:get_current_target_slime_coins('intermediate', self.minigame_failed_count)
			local formatted_str = game_string:Format('short_story_dai_main_minigame_retry', required_coins)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = formatted_str, skip = true })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.dai, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		start_coroutine(self.start_cocktail_minigame, self)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		character_util.set_position(self.leona, backup_leona_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	else

		-- 공주(right, idle, jumpx1) : 알았어! 준비되면 알려줘!
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 5 .. '_' .. 16, skip = true })

		scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'down', false)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		if not self.asked_bar_open then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
		end

		if not self.leona_included_in_party then
			self:align_party_order( { self.popp, self.maam }, true )
			self.leona_included_in_party = true
		end

		-- 파티 무기 Hide false
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)

	self.interacted = false

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		self.asked_bar_open = true
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lorain, self.controller)

		character_util.set_position(self.get_s8_injured_civil(), vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:start_cocktail_minigame()
	-- 미니게임 불러옴
	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.mini_game_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('mini game key : '..stage.Name..acting_area)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 미니게임 시작
	self.minigame:set_current_level_failed_count(self.minigame_failed_count)
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:end_cocktail_minigame(success)
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame('CocktailMiniGame')

	-- 미니게임 성공 시 다음 섹션 이동
	if success then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.failed_cocktail_minigame, self)
	end
end

function local_class:failed_cocktail_minigame()

	self.minigame_failed_count = self.minigame_failed_count + 1

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.gome, self.get_s8_battle_2_pre_event_party_pos() + vector(0, 0, -2), 2, false,
			nil, nil, 'up')


	local stage_camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_s8_crack_pos(1) + self.add_crack_pos + self.add_mob_arrive_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 02_impact_lightning_01 + 01_portal_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_01')
	local crack_effect = self.get_fx_cracked_portal_start():Instantiate(self.get_s8_crack_pos(1) + self.add_crack_pos)

	self.controller:remove_crack_effect('s8_crack_1')
	local event_crack_interact_obj = self.get_event_crack_interact(1)
	if event_crack_interact_obj ~= nil then
		event_crack_interact_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.06, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 몬스터 출현
	local monster = nil

	local party_wp_key = 'come_muddyhand'

	-- 몹 레이어 이펙트보다 위에 있는 것으로 보이게 수정
	for i = 1, self.battle_2_monster_max_count do
		monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(i)
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(monster, 'Default', 10)
	end

	-- 발록
	for i = 1, self.battle_2_balrog_max_count do
		monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(i)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
		start_coroutine(function()
			local backup_monster = monster
			local monster_pos = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster_pos(i) + self.add_crack_pos + self.add_mob_arrive_pos
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(function()
					scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(backup_monster, 'jingak')
					character_util.jump_move(backup_monster, monster_pos, 3, 0.5, true, 'down')
					character_util.remove_anim(backup_monster)
				end),
			})

			camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.2)
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(monster_pos)
		end)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	-- 머드 핸드

	monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(4)
	local arrive_pos = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster_pos(4) + self.add_crack_pos + self.add_mob_arrive_pos
	local wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x, 0, arrive_pos.z)
	local wp_2 = vector(arrive_pos.x, 0, wp_1.z)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, { wp_1, wp_2 }, 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'down' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(6)
	arrive_pos = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster_pos(6) + self.add_crack_pos + self.add_mob_arrive_pos
	wp_1 = vector(monster.Position.x, 0, arrive_pos.z)
	wp_2 = vector(arrive_pos.x, 0, wp_1.z)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, { wp_1, wp_2 }, 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'down' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	arrive_pos = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster_pos(5) + self.add_crack_pos + self.add_mob_arrive_pos
	wp_1 = arrive_pos
	monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monster, wp_1, 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	crack_effect:Dispose()
	self.get_fx_cracked_portal_end():Instantiate(self.get_s8_crack_pos(1) + self.add_crack_pos)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera_pos, 0.5, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 다이, 포프, 마암, 고메(up, jumpx1)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.popp, false)
	character_util.normal_jump(self.maam, false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.gome, '01_jump_01')

	-- 포프(left, scared, release) : 바, 방금 봤어?! 균열에서 몬스터가…!
	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'scared')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.popp, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.popp)

	-- 마암(right, attack, cast2) : 지금 구경하고 있을 때야?!
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.maam, 'cast2')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 다이(up) :마을로 가기 전에  빨리 막아야 돼!
	scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'up', false)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 이후 컨트롤 풀리고 일반 전투 진행

	scene_util.set_direction(self.popp, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'up', false)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	self.send_battle_2_notice = true
	start_coroutine(self.monster_notice_in_battle_zone, self, self.s8_battle_2_zone_name)

	-- 몹 레이어 원복
	for i = 1, self.battle_2_monster_max_count do
		monster = self.get_s8_battle_2_monster(i)
		character_util.set_sorting_layer(monster, 'Default', 0)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:monster_notice_in_battle_zone(zone_name)
	local monster = nil

	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')

	if self.s8_battle_2_zone_name == zone_name then
		for i = 1, self.battle_2_monster_max_count do
			monster = get_character('s8_battle_2_monster_' .. i)

			if monster ~= nil then
				character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, 's8_battle2', 's8_battle_zone_2')
				command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
			end
		end

		for i = 1, self.battle_2_gate_count do
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_2_gate_key .. i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:align_party_order(add_character_list, add_leona)
	-- 다이 - 포프 - 마암 - 레오나 - 흉켈(여기선 할일 없음) - 고메
	if add_character_list ~= nil then
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		end

		for i = 1, #add_character_list do
			party_util.add_member(add_character_list[i])
		end
	end

	if add_leona then
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.leona, user_party, false,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.InBattleZone)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.gome, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.InBattleZone)
end

function local_class:is_pos_in_camera(pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if math.abs(camera_pos.x - pos.x) > cam_half_width + 0.7 or
			-- 카메라의 y값도 보정해서 계산
			math.abs(camera_pos.y / 1.414 + camera_pos.z - pos.z) > cam_half_height + 0.5 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('MagicCircle_AppearIdle')

	self.controller:crack_effects_on(3, 4)

	self.controller:create_crack_effect('s10_crack_1', vector(14, 0, 30))

	self.controller:change_oneline_npc_by_section_state(8, false)

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()

	-- 농장 직원들 각각의 도망 루트 포인트 갯수 셋팅
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[1] = 3
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[2] = 3
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[3] = 3
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[4] = 3
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[5] = 2
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[6] = 2
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[7] = 2
	self.farm_workers_runaway_route[8] = 2
end

function local_class:start()
	self:event_setting()

	start_coroutine(self.start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))

	self.loop_escape = true


	if self.sub_bgm ~= nil then
		self.sub_bgm:Stop()
		self.sub_bgm = nil
	end

	if self.leona_release_swing_sfx ~= nil then
		self.leona_release_swing_sfx:Stop()
		self.leona_release_swing_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.lorain_eat_sfx ~= nil then
		self.lorain_eat_sfx:Stop()
		self.lorain_eat_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if not self.interacted then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.s9_battle_1_name or e.Zone.Name == self.s9_battle_2_name then
				start_coroutine(self.monster_notice_in_battle_zone, self, e.Zone.Name)
				return true
			end
		end
		if not self.teleport_to_house then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.teleport_in_house_zone_name then
				self.teleport_to_house = true
				start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.get_house_outside_interact())
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 종료
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		start_coroutine(self.end_cocktail_minigame, self, e.Success)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_suspense', state = 'event' })
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's9_battle1' then
		-- s8 시민 구출 이벤트 전투 종료 후 다음 이벤트 지점 마커 표시
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
				self.quest_marker_name,
				self.get_s9_battle_zone_pos(2))
		self.quest_marker_point = self.get_s9_battle_zone_pos(2)
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1_end

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.gome)

		-- 현재 섹션 상태에 맞게 배튼 존의 몬스터 활성화
		self:monster_setting()
		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 's9_battle2' then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.post_battle_2_event

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.gome)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.post_battle_2_event, self)

		-- change oneline npc state
		self.controller:change_oneline_npc_by_section_state(8, true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.princess) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.first_princess_event_end then
			-- 응! 나만 믿어!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 20, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state > self.section_state.first_princess_event_end and self.interacted == false then
			self.interacted = true
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.second_princess_event
			start_coroutine(self.return_to_princess, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.leona) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event_end and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- 공주님은 이쪽으로 대피하는 사람들이 있으면 창고로 안내해주세요!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.leona, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 19, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- left, smile, cast : 이제 몬스터는 더 안 보이는 것 같아요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.leona, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 24, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lorain) then
		if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.first_princess_event_end and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- 아까 응급 상자를 여기 어디 놨는데…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lorain, { key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 21, skip = false })
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- up, idle : 뭐, 마무리된 것  같으니 안심들 하세요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lorain, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 25, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(1)) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- 회색1(down, tired, idle) : 농장 밖이 조용한데…?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(1), { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 26, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(2)) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- 회색2(right, smile, idle) : 궁정 마법사님이 모두 처리해주셨나본데?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(2), { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 27, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker(3)) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.post_battle_2_event then
			-- 회색3(right, idle, cross_arm) : 온 김에 칵테일 주스나 한 잔 사갈까…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_worker(3), { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 28, skip = false })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		if self.qte_current_clear_count == 0 then
			self.is_qte_success = true
		end
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		if self.qte_current_clear_count == 1 then
			self.is_qte_success = true
		end
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		if self.qte_current_clear_count == 2 then
			character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)
			self.is_qte_success = true
		end
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	local interact_handle_name = e.ExitHandleName

	if self.house_inside_interact_name == interact_handle_name then
		self.teleport_to_house = true
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.get_house_outside_interact())
	elseif self.house_outside_interact_name == interact_handle_name then
		self.teleport_to_house = false
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.quest_marker_point)
	end
	return false
end

--region section_event

function local_class:start_event()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 8 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_field', state = 'field' })
	end

	--  스테이지 시작, 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.first_princess_event

	-- 시작 이벤트 - 다이 일행 물품 사고 돌아오는 이벤트
	self:retry_to_make_rainbow_slime_cocktail_event()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 8 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide false
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:retry_to_make_rainbow_slime_cocktail_event()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')

	-- 공주 (right, smile,success) : 이번에도 모두 잘해줬어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.popp)

-- 카메라에 해당 위치 좌표가 보이는지 리턴
function local_class:is_pos_in_camera(pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if math.abs(camera_pos.x - pos.x) > cam_half_width + 0.7 or
			-- 카메라의 y값도 보정해서 계산
			math.abs(camera_pos.y / 1.414 + camera_pos.z - pos.z) > cam_half_height + 0.5 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:meet_hyunckel_event()

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.hyunckel_armor, true)

	-- 하단 말풍선 시, 다이, 포프,마암, 레오나, 고메(down, attack, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.dai)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leona)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.gome)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'down', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)

	-- 흉켈 : 미안하지만, 더 급한 일이 있다.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	self.sub_bgm = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_event_castle_04', volume = 0.5, loop = true, fade_in_time = 4 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hyunckel_armor,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1,
			  screen_pos = vector(200, 0), skip = true })

	character_util.set_position(self.hyunckel_armor, vector(999, 0, self.get_s9_hyunckel_start_pos().z))

	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	character_util.set_position(self.hyunckel_armor, vector(camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1, 0, self.hyunckel_armor.Position.z))

	-- 흉켈 등장 이동
	local party_wp_key = 'hyunckel_move_to_bar'

	local wp_1 = self.get_s9_hyunckel_bar_align_pos()
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.hyunckel_armor, wp_1, 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 다이, 포프 마암 흉켈 따라서 방향 이동(right -> down ->  left)
	local hyunckel_enter_in_camera = false
	while self.wp_util_remaining_move_end[party_wp_key] > 0 do
		if not hyunckel_enter_in_camera then
			if self:is_pos_in_camera(self.hyunckel_armor.Position) then
				-- 화면 우측에서 흉켈 등장하면 다이, 마암, 레오나, 공주(right, surprise, jumpx1), 포프(right, attack, idle)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'surprise')
				character_util.normal_jump(self.dai, '01_player_jump_01')

				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'attack')

				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'surprise')
				character_util.normal_jump(self.maam, '01_player_jump_01')

				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'surprise')
				character_util.normal_jump(self.leona, '01_player_jump_01')

				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'surprise')
				character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, '01_player_jump_01')

				hyunckel_enter_in_camera = true
			end
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 흉켈 위치 정렬하면, 다이 일행 이동할때 고메(right, tired, jumpx2)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'tired')

	-- 파티, 흉켈 등장 후 흉켈 주위로 정렬

	wp_1 = vector(self.dai.Position.x, 0, self.get_s9_dai_hyunckel_near_pos().z)
	local wp_2 = self.get_s9_dai_hyunckel_near_pos()

	local dai_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, { wp_1, wp_2 }, 4.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right', callback = function(waypoint_index)
				if waypoint_index == 1 then
					dai_dash_sfx:Stop()
				end

	wp_1 = self.get_s9_maam_hyunckel_near_pos()

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, wp_1, 4.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 돌프 퇴장 시작 후 1초 후, 흉켈 대사 출력
	-- 흉켈(down, attack, cross_arm) : [small]기회가 얼마 남지 않았군... 조심해야겠어.
	scene_util.set_direction(self.hyunckel_armor, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.hyunckel_armor, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.hyunckel_armor, 'cross_arm')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.hyunckel_armor, self.string_key .. '3_30', true, { scale = 0.7 })

	-- 하단 대사 시, 다이, 포프, 마암, 고메(right)
	character_util.set_group_direction({ self.dai, self.popp, self.maam, self.gome }, 'right')

	-- 흉켈(left, attack, idle) : ...나는 혹시 모를 상황에 대비해서 마을에 방어선을 만들도록 하지.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.hyunckel_armor)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.hyunckel_armor, self.string_key .. '3_31')

	-- 다이(right,, attack, release) : ...응, 마을 사람들을 부탁할게 흉켈.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'attack')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dai, self.string_key .. '3_32')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.hyunckel_armor)

	-- 흉켈 퇴장
	start_coroutine(function()
		local offset_pos_x = 1
		local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
		local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
		wp_1 = vector(camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + offset_pos_x, self.hyunckel_armor.Position.y, self.hyunckel_armor.Position.z)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.hyunckel_armor, wp_1, 4, false, nil, nil,
				'right', false)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 하단 대사 시, 포프, 고메, 마암(left)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_group_direction({ self.popp, self.maam, self.gome }, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')

	-- 다이(right, attack,idle) : 우리도 이러고 있을 시간이 없어…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dai, self.string_key .. '3_33')

	-- 다이(right, attack, release) : 더 늦었다간 정말 영영 돌아가지 못할 거야.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dai, self.string_key .. '3_34')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

	-- 하단 대사 시, 고메(left, attack, jumpx2)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')
	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.normal_double_jump(self.gome, true)
	end)

	-- 마암(up) : 다이 말이 맞아. 이젠 정말 서둘러서 무지개 칵테일 주스를 완성해야 돼.
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'up', true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.maam, self.string_key .. '3_35')

	-- 마암(right, release) : 빨리 농장으로 돌아가자!
	scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.maam, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.maam, self.string_key .. '3_36')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)

	character_util.set_position(self.hyunckel_armor, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.magician, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.maid, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.magician, false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.hyunckel_armor, false)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	self:oneline_npc_setting_in_bar()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 이후 공주 마커
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name,
			self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	self.quest_marker_point = self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:oneline_npc_setting_in_bar()
	-- 농장 일꾼 활성화
	local worker = nil
	for i = 1, self.oneline_farm_workers_num do
		worker = self.get_worker(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(worker, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(worker, self.get_s9_worker_oneline_in_bar_pos(i))
		character_util.add_listener(worker, self.controller)
	end

	worker = self.get_worker(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(worker, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(worker, 'tired')

	worker = self.get_worker(2)
	scene_util.set_direction(worker, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(worker, 'smile')

	worker = self.get_worker(3)
	scene_util.set_direction(worker, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(worker)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(worker, 'cross_arm')

	-- 레오나 left, smile, cast
	character_util.set_position(self.leona, self.get_s9_leona_oneline_in_bar_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.leona, 'cast')

	-- 로레인 바 왼쪽으로 배치, right, attack, eat
	character_util.set_position(self.lorain, self.get_s9_lorain_oneline_in_bar_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lorain)

	character_util.set_position(self.princess, self.backup_princess_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'tired')

	character_util.add_listener(self.princess, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.lorain, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.leona, self.controller)
end

function local_class:disable_oneline_workers_npc_in_bar()
	-- 농장 일꾼 비활성화
	local worker = nil
	for i = 1, self.oneline_farm_workers_num do
		worker = self.get_worker(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(worker, self.controller)

		character_util.set_position(worker, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(worker, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:return_to_princess()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 파티 무기 Hide true
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	self.party_member_move_completion_count = 0
	local move_around_princess = function(character, wp_list, last_dir)
		local move_end_func = function()
			self.party_member_move_completion_count = self.party_member_move_completion_count + 1
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint(character, wp_list, 3, false, nil, nil,
				last_dir, false, 0, move_end_func)
	end

	-- 원라인 말풍선 제거
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_worker(1))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_worker(2))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_worker(3))
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.leona)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lorain)

	-- 공주
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'right', false)

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)

		scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.lorain)

		-- 레오나
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_direction(self.leona, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.leona)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(self.leona, false)
	end

	-- 로레인도 덤으로 방향 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'right', false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 파티, 흉켈 등장 후 흉켈 주위로 정렬
	local party_wp_key = 'move_around_princess'

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		local wp_1 = vector(self.leona.Position.x, 0, self.princess.Position.z - 2)
		local wp_2 = vector(self.princess.Position.x, 0, wp_1.z)
		local wp_3 = self.get_s9_leona_bar_align_pos()
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.leona, { wp_1, wp_2, wp_3 }, 3,
				nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_1 = vector(self.princess.Position.x - 1, 0, self.lorain.Position.z)
		wp_2 = vector(wp_1.x, 0, self.princess.Position.z)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.lorain, { wp_1, wp_2 }, 3,
				nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	else
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.leona, self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 3,
				nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	end


	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.dai, self.get_s9_dai_bar_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.popp, self.get_s9_popp_bar_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.maam, self.get_s9_maam_bar_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.gome, self.get_s9_gome_bar_align_pos(), 3,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'left' })


	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	if not self.asked_bar_open then

		-- 공주(right, tired, jumpx1) : 다, 다이! 포프!
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'tired')
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

		-- 공주(right, tired, release) : 다들 괜찮아?!
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

		-- 레오나(right, tired, idle) : 다들 다친데는 없는 거지?
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.leona, 'tired')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.leona, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })

		-- 다이(left, smile, victory_get) : 당연하지! 우리가 누군데!
		scene_util.victory_get(self.dai, 'smile')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })

		-- 다이(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 이 정도로는 끄떡 없어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.dai, 'bomb_idle')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.dai)

		-- 상단 대사 이후 고메(left, smile, jumpx2), 이후 하단 대사 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(self.gome, true)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 하단 대사 시, 고메(right , tired, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'tired')

		-- 마암(left, tired, idle) :하지만... 이젠 정말 시간이 얼마 없어.
		character_util.remove_anim(self.maam)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_direction(self.maam, 'left', false)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })

		-- 마암(left, attack, cross_arm) :늦지 않게 돌아가려면 이번이 마지막이라 생각해야 돼...!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.maam, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.maam, 'cross_arm')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.maam, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.maam)

		-- 하단 대사 시, 다이 right
		scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'right', false)

		-- 포프(left, mad, jingak) : 쳇, 몬스터만 아니었으면 벌써 무지개 칵테일 주스는 만들고도 남았을 텐데…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.popp, 'mad')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(self.popp, 'jingak', { sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.popp, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.popp)

		-- 다이(right, tired, release) : 너무 그러지 마, 포프.
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'tired')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

		-- 다이(right, sleep_deep, cast) : 우리가 돌아가는 것도 중요하지만… 마을 사람들이 다치지 않는 것도 중요하니까.
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.dai, 'cast')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })

		-- 하단 대사 시, 고메(left , idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.gome)

		-- 다이(left, attack, release) : 다들 마지막까지 도와줄 수 있겠어?.
		scene_util.set_direction(self.dai, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.dai, 'attack')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.dai, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.dai, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.dai)

		-- 공주(right, smile, jumpx1) : .당연하지!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'smile')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 12, skip = true })

		-- 공주(right, idle, release) : 그럼 바로 영업 시작해볼까?
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 13, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

		-- 상단 대사 이후 고메(left, smile, jumpx2)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(self.gome, true)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	else
		-- 공주(right, smile, jumpx1) : 다들 준비 됐어?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 18, skip = true })
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 14, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 15, 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then

		-- 공주 가리키는 마커 삭제
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		if not (self.minigame_failed_count > 0) then
			-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번에는 마지막이라고 생각하고 100000코인을 목표로 해보자!
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 16, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)
		else
			-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번엔 {0}코인을 목표로 해보자!
			local required_coins = self.controller:get_current_target_slime_coins('senior', self.minigame_failed_count)
			local formatted_str = game_string:Format('short_story_dai_main_minigame_retry', required_coins)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = formatted_str, skip = true })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.dai, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		start_coroutine(self.start_cocktail_minigame, self)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

	else

		-- 공주(right, idle, jumpx1) : 알았어! 준비되면 알려줘!
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 17, skip = true })

		scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'down', false)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		if not self.leona_included_in_party then
			self:align_party_order( { self.popp, self.maam }, true )
			self.leona_included_in_party = true
		end

		-- 파티 무기 Hide false
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
		end

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)

	self.interacted = false

	if not self.asked_bar_open then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.leona, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lorain, self.controller)
		self.asked_bar_open = true
	end
end

function local_class:start_cocktail_minigame()
	-- 미니게임 불러옴
	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.mini_game_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 미니게임 시작
	self.minigame:set_current_level_failed_count(self.minigame_failed_count)
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:end_cocktail_minigame(success)
	self:disable_oneline_workers_npc_in_bar()

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame('CocktailMiniGame')

	-- 미니게임 성공 시 다음 섹션 이동
	if success then
		self:section_end_setting()
	else
		start_coroutine(self.failed_cocktail_minigame, self)
	end
end

function local_class:failed_cocktail_minigame()
	self.controller:mini_game_exit_routine()
	self.minigame_failed_count = self.minigame_failed_count + 1

	-- 공주(right, tired, idle) : 슬라임 코인이 조금 모자라네….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'tired')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 공주 (right, tired, release): 이 정도로 연습해서는 실력이 늘지 않을 것 같아…
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 20, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

	-- 공주(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 우리 한번 더 도전해볼까?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.princess, 'bomb_idle')
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 21, skip = true })

	-- 공주(right, smile, jumpx1) : 이번엔 성공할 수 있을 거야!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.princess, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 22, skip = true })

	-- 상단 대사 이후 고메(left, smile, jumpx2)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.gome, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(self.gome, true)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 14, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 15, 'normal' } })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

	if choose_result == 1 then

		-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번에도 1500코인을 목표로 해보자!
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.princess, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		-- 공주(right, idle, release): 이번엔 {0}코인을 목표로 해보자!
		local required_coins = self.controller:get_current_target_slime_coins('senior', self.minigame_failed_count)
		local formatted_str = game_string:Format('short_story_dai_main_minigame_retry', required_coins)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = formatted_str, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.dai, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		start_coroutine(self.start_cocktail_minigame, self)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()
	else
		-- 공주(right, idle, jumpx1) : 알았어! 준비되면 알려줘!
		character_util.normal_jump(self.princess, false)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = self.string_key .. 4 .. '_' .. 17, skip = true })

		scene_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.lorain, 'down', false)

		if not self.leona_included_in_party then
			self:align_party_order( { self.popp, self.maam }, true )
			self.leona_included_in_party = true
		end

		-- 파티 무기 Hide false
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
		end

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
				self.quest_marker_name,
				self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
		self.quest_marker_point = self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.princess)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lorain)

	self.interacted = false
end

function local_class:section_end_setting()

	character_util.set_position(self.princess, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(self.princess, 'disabled')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_princess_bat(), 'enabled')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.hyunckel_armor, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(self.hyunckel_armor, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.leona)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.gome)

	-- 다이 포프 마암 꼬마공주 레오나 고메
	party_util.add_member(self.popp)
	party_util.add_member(self.maam)
	party_util.add_member(self.get_princess_bat())

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.leona, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.gome, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep)

	-- 미니게임 프로토타입 연결 전까지 바로 8섹션으로 넘김
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:monster_notice_in_battle_zone(zone_name)
	local monster = nil
	local battle_group = nil

	if self.s9_battle_1_name == zone_name then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.first_princess_event_end then
			if self.send_battle_1_notice then
				return
			end
			-- (임시)프로토타입에서는 한마리지만 나중에 수정

			battle_group = 's9_battle1'
			self.send_battle_1_notice = true

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')

			for i = 1, self.s9_battle_1_monster_max_count do
				monster = get_character('s9_battle_1_monster_' .. i)

				if monster ~= nil then
					character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, battle_group, zone_name)
					command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.s9_battle_2_name == zone_name then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_end then
			if self.send_battle_2_notice then
				return
			end
			-- (임시)프로토타입에서는 한마리지만 나중에 수정
			battle_group = 's9_battle2'
			self.send_battle_2_notice = true

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(self.gome, 'attack')

			for i = 1, self.s9_battle_2_monster_max_count do
				monster = get_character('s9_battle_2_monster_' .. i)

				if monster ~= nil then
					character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, battle_group, zone_name)
					command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:align_party_order(add_character_list, add_leona)
	-- 다이 - 포프 - 마암 - 레오나 - 흉켈(여기선 할일 없음) - 고메
	if add_character_list ~= nil then
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		end

		for i = 1, #add_character_list do
			party_util.add_member(add_character_list[i])
		end
	end

	if add_leona then
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.leona, user_party, false,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.InBattleZone)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.gome, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.InBattleZone)
end

function local_class:change_main_quest_marker(quest_marker_point)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name,
			quest_marker_point, true)
end

--endregion
return local_class

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_civilian(1)) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.intro then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.civilian_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.get_intro_zone_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.intro
		start_coroutine(self.intro_enter_scene, self)
		self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true,
													  min_distance = 2.5, max_distance = 5,
													  play_pos = self.get_civilian_pos(1) })
		return true
	end
	local object_scenes = {
		self.pot_scene,
		self.prop_scene,
		self.book_scene,
	}

	if not self.is_playing and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.interact then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if e.Zone.Name == self.get_thrown_zone_name and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_hold_object(i)) then
				self.is_playing = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(object_scenes[i], self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	--들고 있는 아이템을 던지면 안되기 때문에 play_normal_screenplay 사용
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, get_party_leader()) and not self.is_playing and self.is_zone then
		self.is_playing = true
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hold_object(1)) then
			self.is_playing = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pot_scene, self)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hold_object(2)) then
			self.is_playing = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prop_scene, self)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hold_object(3)) then
			self.is_playing = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.book_scene, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--오브젝트 물로 던지고 공통으로 처리해주는 함수
function local_class:drown_object(box, ara_pos, sfx_name)
	if sfx_name == nil then
		sfx_name = '01_water_splash_02'
	end

	while box.Position.y > 1.8 do
		-- Respawn되며 여길 못 빠져나가는 경우도 있으므로 방어코드 추가
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(box, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local fall_duration = 0.25

	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(box.Position)
	local end_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(start_pos, ara_pos.x + 0.7)
	--local end_pos = start_pos + vector(1,0,0)

	local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, box.Position.y, 0)
	fall_calculator:ScaleTime(0.7)

	local current_y = box.Position.y

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < fall_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / (fall_duration + 0.5))

		fall_calculator:Proceed(dt)
		current_y = fall_calculator:GetDistance()

		local current_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		box.Position = current_xz + current_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:set_npc_by_data(npcs_data)
