			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data.dir)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, data.anim)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, data.emo, { scale = data.scale })
			if data.talk ~= nil then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = data.talk
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:align_dai_member(pos, dir, duration, is_arc)
	local align_default = pos
	if is_arc == nil or false then
		local align_list = {
			align_default,
			align_default + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			align_default + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			align_default + vector(-3, 0, 0),
			align_default + vector(-2, 0, 1),
			align_default + vector(-3, 0, 1),
		}
		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			wp_util.move(user_party[i - 1], { align_list[i] }, nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
		end
	else
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local popp = self.get_popp()
		local maam = self.get_maam()
		local leona = self.get_leona()
		local gome = self.get_gome()
		wp_util.move(leader, align_default, nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
		wp_util.move(popp, align_default + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
		wp_util.move(maam, align_default + vector(-1, 0, -1), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
		--레오나가 파티 멤버일 때만
		if user_party:Contains(leona) then
			wp_util.move(leona, align_default + vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
		end
		wp_util.move(gome, align_default + vector(-1, 0, 1), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	end
	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

--바다마녀 첫 조우시 align
function local_class:align_dai_member_new(pos, dir, duration)
	local align_default = pos

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local popp = self.get_popp()
	local maam = self.get_maam()
	local leona = self.get_leona()
	local gome = self.get_gome()
	wp_util.move(leader, align_default, nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	wp_util.move(popp, align_default + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	wp_util.move(maam, align_default + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	--레오나가 파티 멤버일 때만
	if user_party:Contains(leona) then
		wp_util.move(leona, align_default + vector(-2, 0, 0.5), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	end
	wp_util.move(gome, align_default + vector(-1, 0, 1), nil, duration, { last_direction = dir })
	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

function local_class:fade_ara(fade_out)
	local ara = self.get_sea_witch()
	local ara_tentacle = self.get_sea_witch_tentacle()

	if fade_out then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')
		self.water_in_fx():Instantiate(ara_tentacle.Position)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ara, 0, 0)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ara)
		character_util.set_active_state(ara, 'disabled')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_octo_summon_02')
		self.water_in_fx():Instantiate(ara_tentacle.Position)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(ara_tentacle, { name = 'out', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tentacle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(ara_tentacle, 'in')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.set_active_state(ara, 'enabled')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')
		self.water_in_fx():Instantiate(ara.Position)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ara, 1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_weapon_and_untouchable()
	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 리더 무적 처리
	local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end
end

function local_class:show_weapon_and_normal()
	local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	-- 리더 무적 해제
	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 무기 다시 보이게
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end
end

return local_class
